cards.title: Contact Energy
cards.metadata: Infratil (Follow-On) · Integrated Energy · New Zealand
cards.description: Infratil participated pro rata in Contact Energy’s NZ$525mm equity raise, announced alongside half-year results showing a 44% jump in net profit to NZ$205mm. Proceeds will fund a 200 MW battery at Glenbrook, a 150 MW Glorit solar farm joint venture with Lightsource bp, and pre-FID drilling for the Tauhara 2 geothermal project to explore upsizing capacity from 50 MW to 60–70 MW. Infratil holds a 14.3% stake in New Zealand’s second-largest power generator.

cards.title: Utility Global
cards.metadata: Ara Partners / APG Asset Management (Growth Equity) · Energy Transition · US
cards.description: Ara Partners and APG Asset Management co-led a $100mm first close of Utility Global’s Series D financing. The capital will fund global deployment of the company’s proprietary H2Gen technology, which converts water into clean hydrogen using industrial off-gases without electricity, targeting hard-to-abate sectors including steel, refining, and petrochemicals.

cards.title: Duffy BESS Project
cards.metadata: DESRI (Preferred Equity) · BESS · US
cards.description: DESRI provided preferred equity financing to Linea Energy, an EnCap Investments portfolio company, for the 235 MWac Duffy battery energy storage system in Matagorda County, Texas. The two-hour duration BESS will participate in the ERCOT wholesale energy and ancillary services market.

cards.title: One Power Company
cards.metadata: Basalt Infrastructure / OnSite Partners (Bolt-On) · Distributed Energy · US
cards.description: Basalt Infrastructure, acting through portfolio company OnSite Partners, acquired Ohio-based One Power Company in an add-on transaction. The deal broadens OnSite Partners’ behind-the-meter distributed generation portfolio and customer base while adding construction and operational expertise in energy infrastructure for commercial and industrial clients.

cards.title: Substantial Group (Netomnia)
cards.metadata: nexfibre (Buyout) · Fiber/Broadband · UK
cards.description: InfraVia, Liberty Global, and Telefónica, acting through their joint venture nexfibre, agreed to acquire Substantial Group from DigitalBridge, Advencap, and Soho Square Capital for an enterprise value of £2bn. Netomnia is the UK’s second-largest alternative fiber provider, currently passing approximately 3mm premises and expected to reach 3.4mm by transaction close in Q3 2026. The combination will create a scaled challenger to BT Openreach targeting approximately 8mm premises by end-2027.

cards.title: ATC Europe
cards.metadata: Commerz Real (Minority Stake) · Telecom Towers · Europe
cards.description: Commerz Real, in partnership with Allianz Global Investors, acquired a minority stake in ATC Europe from Allianz insurance companies on behalf of its newly launched Infravest infrastructure fund. ATC Europe owns more than 30,000 wireless communication towers across Germany, France, and Spain as the European arm of American Tower Corporation.

cards.title: Qube Holdings
cards.metadata: Macquarie Asset Management (Buyout) · Ports & Logistics · Australia
cards.description: A Macquarie Asset Management–led consortium including UniSuper and Pontegadea entered a binding scheme implementation deed to acquire Qube Holdings at A$5.20 cash per share, implying an enterprise value of approximately A$11.7bn and a 28% premium to the undisturbed price. Qube is Australia’s largest ports and terminal infrastructure provider, operating across 29 ports with a 10,000-strong workforce.

cards.title: Fraport Greece
cards.metadata: Blackstone Infrastructure (Minority Stake) · Airports · Greece
cards.description: Blackstone Infrastructure acquired the Marguerite Fund’s 10% stake in Fraport Greece for a reported approximately €200mm. Fraport Greece operates 14 regional airports under a 40-year concession that began in April 2017, having handled over 12mm more passengers in 2025 than in the 2016 baseline year. Fraport AG retains a 73.4% controlling stake.

cards.title: Kalfresh Bioenergy Facility
cards.metadata: QIC / Wollemi Capital (Co-Investment) · Waste-to-Energy · Australia
cards.description: QIC and Wollemi Capital co-invested A$80mm in the Kalfresh Bioenergy Facility, the centerpiece of a A$291mm agricultural-industrial precinct at Kalbar, Queensland. The facility will use anaerobic digestion to convert food waste and crop residues into renewable natural gas, producing enough energy to power up to 31,000 homes and abating up to 430,000 tonnes of CO₂ annually. First energy production is scheduled for mid-2027.

cards.title: Reload
cards.metadata: Scale Microgrids (Bolt-On) · Distributed Energy · US
cards.description: Scale Microgrids, backed by EQT Transition Infrastructure, acquired Reload, a Chicago-based platform that sites, designs, and permits gigawatt-scale data center campuses paired with rapidly deployable on-site power infrastructure. The acquisition expands Scale’s growing data center business and is supported by a material capital commitment from EQT to deploy multi-gigawatts of capacity for hyperscale data center growth.

cards.title: Cleanwatts
cards.metadata: DWS Infrastructure (Buyout) · Distributed Energy · Portugal
cards.description: An infrastructure fund managed by DWS acquired 100% of Portuguese renewable energy communities platform Cleanwatts from Verdane. As part of the transaction, DWS committed approximately €150mm by 2030 to scale Cleanwatts’ decentralized solar and energy communities model, which provides commercial and residential users with shared solar generation with no upfront capital costs.

cards.title: Andion CH4 Renewables
cards.metadata: Equitix (Growth Equity) · Energy Transition · Europe
cards.description: Equitix led a considerable equity contribution into Andion CH4 Renewables, a European biogas developer, owner, and operator, alongside a €67mm private credit facility provided by Goldman Sachs Alternatives. The financing will accelerate the development of Andion’s short-term pipeline of biomethane projects across Italy and the Nordic region.

cards.title: Cella Dati Biomethane Plant
cards.metadata: Andion CH4 Renewables (Bolt-On) · Energy Transition · Italy
cards.description: Andion CH4 Renewables, a European biomethane platform backed by Equitix’s Next Generation Fund, announced a binding agreement to acquire 100% of the share capital of the Cella Dati biomethane plant from IREN and Santini Agricoltura Rinnovabile. The acquisition adds immediate operating capacity to Andion’s expanding footprint in Italy.

cards.title: HyCC (Hydrogen Chemistry Company)
cards.metadata: Macquarie Asset Management (Divestiture) · Energy Transition · Europe
cards.description: Macquarie Asset Management and Nobian agreed to sell their joint venture equity interest in HyCC, a large-scale green hydrogen developer, to Dutch e-fuels firm Power2X. Founded in 2021, HyCC holds a 1 GW development pipeline of green hydrogen projects across the Netherlands and Germany, including the 20 MW Djewels electrolyser project in Delfzijl.

cards.title: 83MW Indian Solar Energy Projects
cards.metadata: Digital Edge (Minority Stake) · Renewables · India
cards.description: Digital Edge, an APAC data center platform backed by Stonepeak, acquired a substantial minority equity stake in an 83 MW solar project portfolio from Hexa Climate Solutions. The direct investment into the renewable generation assets ensures captive user status under Indian regulations to power Digital Edge’s BOM data center campus.

cards.title: atNorth
cards.metadata: CPP Investments / Partners Group / Equinix (Buyout & Reinvestment) · Data Centers · Europe
cards.description: CPP Investments and Equinix signed a definitive joint agreement to acquire a controlling 60% equity stake in atNorth from Partners Group for a $4.0bn enterprise value. CPP Investments will commit approximately $1.6bn to the transaction, while Equinix takes 40%. Concurrently, Partners Group will reinvest for up to a 10% minority equity stake in the high-density, pan-Nordic colocation platform. The deal includes a provisionally agreed $4.2bn financing package.

cards.title: Ori Industries
cards.metadata: Brookfield Asset Management (Platform Acquisition / Merger) · AI Infrastructure · UK
cards.description: Brookfield Asset Management officially launched Radiant, a vertically integrated AI infrastructure company, through the acquisition and merger of UK-based distributed AI cloud provider Ori Industries. Valued at $1.3bn post-merger, Radiant serves as the first compute deployment vehicle for Brookfield’s $10bn AI Infrastructure Fund (BAIIF). Built on the NVIDIA DSX reference design, Radiant will deliver utility-scale, purpose-built “AI factories” under long-term contracts.

cards.title: Sandy Farms & Eternal Rings Data Centers
cards.target: Sandy Farms & Eternal Rings Data Centers
cards.metadata: Harrison Street (Divestiture) · Data Centers · US
cards.description: Harrison Street sold two powered-shell data centers in the Baltimore, Maryland metro area to GI Partners for $221.9mm. The transaction includes the 109,455-square-foot Sandy Farms facility in Severn and the 110,336-square-foot Eternal Rings facility in Laurel. The acquisition by GI Partners was supported by a $113.4mm acquisition loan from Capital One Bank.

cards.title: Skellefteå Data Center Site
cards.metadata: EdgeConneX (Bolt-On) · Data Centers · Sweden
cards.description: EQT-backed EdgeConneX agreed to acquire a data center development site in Skellefteå, Sweden, from battery manufacturer Lyten. Co-located at the newly formed Lyten Industrial Hub at the former Northvolt Ett battery plant, the EdgeConneX campus has the potential to scale up to 1 GW of capacity. The facility will be primarily powered by local renewable hydroelectricity to support intensive AI and cloud computing workloads.

cards.title: Digital Sense
cards.metadata: 11:11 Systems (Bolt-On) · Cloud & Managed Services · Australia
cards.description: Tiger Infrastructure Partners-backed 11:11 Systems acquired Digital Sense, a Brisbane-based cloud and managed services provider, from Aussie Broadband. The carve-out represents 11:11 Systems’ seventh acquisition of a former VMware Cloud Service Provider and expands its sovereign cloud capabilities and footprint in the Australian and wider APAC markets.

cards.title: Macquarie AirFinance
cards.metadata: Macquarie Asset Management (Divestiture) · Aviation Leasing · Global
cards.description: Macquarie Asset Management (MAM) announced the sale of its 50% stake in Macquarie AirFinance (MAF) to Dubai Aerospace Enterprise (DAE) as part of an all-cash transaction valuing the lessor at a $7.0bn enterprise value. The seller consortium also included PGGM Infrastructure Fund and the Australian Retirement Trust. The acquisition adds 191 airline customers and pushes DAE’s combined pro forma fleet to 1,029 aircraft.

cards.title: Lower Lakes Towing & 6 Canadian-flagged Lakers
cards.metadata: Mainstay Maritime (Divestiture) · Maritime Logistics · Canada
cards.description: Mainstay Maritime, an Oaktree Transportation Infrastructure Investing Group portfolio company formerly known as Rand Logistics, agreed to sell its Canadian operating companies, including Lower Lakes Towing, to Algoma Central Corporation. The transaction includes six Canadian-flagged Laker vessels with capacities ranging up to 33,824 tons. The divestiture allows Mainstay Maritime to focus exclusively on its US-flagged, Jones Act-compliant fleet.

cards.title: 321 Precision Conversions
cards.metadata: ATSG (Divestiture) · Aviation Services · US
cards.description: Air Transport Services Group (ATSG), an aviation logistics portfolio company recently taken private by Stonepeak, sold its 49% minority stake in 321 Precision Conversions to its joint venture partner, Erickson Group Ltd. The JV was formed in 2017 to engineer passenger-to-freighter conversions for Airbus A321 aircraft. The divestiture gives Erickson full ownership of the business as ATSG refocuses on core aircraft leasing operations.

cards.title: DTG Recycle
cards.metadata: Macquarie Infrastructure Partners (Divestiture) · Waste Management · US
cards.description: Macquarie Infrastructure Partners exited its investment in DTG Recycle, Washington State’s largest independent vertically integrated construction and demolition (C&D) waste recycling business. Founder Dan Guimont repurchased the core operations, while select Pierce County assets, including a C&D recycling facility in Tacoma, were divested to Waste Connections.

cards.title: AES Corporation | GIP & EQT Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Take-Private · Diversified Power · US
cards.description: A consortium led by Global Infrastructure Partners (a BlackRock subsidiary) and EQT Infrastructure VI agreed to acquire AES Corporation in an all-cash take-private at $15.00 per share (~$10.7bn equity value, ~$33.4bn EV), a 40.3% premium to the 30-day VWAP. AES operates ~34 GW of generation capacity across the Americas. CalPERS and Qatar Investment Authority are participating as co-underwriters.

cards.title: 11 German BESS Projects | Allianz Global Investors
cards.metadata: Equity Stake (50%) · BESS · Germany
cards.description: TotalEnergies agreed to sell a 50% stake in 11 battery energy storage projects under construction in Germany to Allianz Global Investors, representing €500mm of total project investment. The portfolio has 789 MW / 1,628 MWh of capacity, developed by Kyon Energy (a TotalEnergies subsidiary). This marks AllianzGI’s first direct equity investment in utility-scale battery storage; all projects are expected to be operational by 2028.

cards.title: SK Eternix | KKR
cards.metadata: Minority Stake (43.5%) · Renewables · South Korea
cards.description: KKR agreed to acquire a combined 43.5% minority stake in SK Eternix from SK Discovery and Hahn & Company for KRW348bn (~$235mm). SK Eternix is a South Korean renewable energy platform spun off from SK D&D in 2024, operating across solar, onshore wind, energy storage systems, and fuel cell power generation. The company is Korea’s largest ESS operator and holds supply rights for Bloom Energy fuel cell equipment.

cards.title: 50 MW Onshore Wind Project (Gia Lai) | Actis / Levanta Renewables
cards.metadata: Add-On (80%) · Wind · Vietnam
cards.description: Levanta Renewables, Actis’s pan-Southeast Asia renewable platform, acquired an 80% stake in a 50 MW operating onshore wind farm in Gia Lai Province, Vietnam, from Super Energy Corporation for $31.78mm. The asset generates >150 GWh annually under long-term PPAs with Vietnam Electricity, bringing Levanta’s total operating capacity to ~400 MW.

cards.title: Northview Energy | BCI, NBIM & Brookfield
cards.metadata: Platform Launch · Renewables · North America
cards.description: BCI, Norges Bank Investment Management, and Brookfield launched Northview Energy, a renewable energy platform to acquire contracted, operating assets in the U.S. and Canada. The seed portfolio comprises 22 sites (17 solar, 5 onshore wind) totaling ~2.3 GW across six U.S. power markets, with PPAs averaging 16 years remaining. The three investors will fund equally, with a $1.5bn framework for future acquisitions.

cards.title: Calisen | HarbourVest Partners
cards.metadata: Secondary · Smart Metering · UK
cards.description: HarbourVest Partners acquired a stake in Calisen, the UK’s leading independent smart metering company with an installed base of approximately 16mm meters, via a secondary transaction from Equitix. Calisen owns, finances, and installs smart metering infrastructure across the UK on behalf of energy suppliers. EQT and GIC hold the majority stake, acquired in 2024.

cards.title: 79.2 MW DG BESS Portfolio | Bimergen Energy
cards.metadata: Buyout · BESS · US
cards.description: Bimergen Energy completed the acquisition of a portfolio of eight late-stage 9.9 MW distributed generation battery energy storage projects totaling 79.2 MW in ERCOT South from Aggreko’s IPP Solutions business (owned by I Squared Capital). The projects will provide frequency regulation, voltage support, energy arbitrage, and peak capacity support to the Texas grid, with commissioning expected from late 2026 through early 2027.

cards.title: Maaselänkangas Onshore Wind Farm | DWS Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Buyout · Wind · Finland
cards.description: DWS Group acquired the Maaselänkangas onshore wind farm, a 41.3 MW project comprising seven turbines located in Oulainen, Finland, from wpd Group. The acquisition was made on behalf of DWS’s European infrastructure investment strategy, which has been progressively building a portfolio of renewable energy assets across the continent.

cards.title: Gabia Data Centre | Macquarie Asset Management
cards.metadata: JV Platform · Data Centers · South Korea
cards.description: Macquarie Asset Management, through MAIF4, and Gabia Inc. announced a strategic partnership to develop a hyperscale data center platform in South Korea, with a total investment of ~KRW600bn (~$420mm) over four to six years targeting >100 MW of capacity. The first project is a 40 MW facility in Ansan, ~30 km south of Seoul. Gabia’s subsidiary KINX, South Korea’s only neutral internet exchange operator, will provide connectivity infrastructure.

cards.title: Arqiva | Polus Capital Management
cards.metadata: Minority Stake (26.5%) · Broadcast Infra · UK
cards.description: Polus Capital Management agreed to acquire a 26.5% shareholding in Arqiva from Macquarie Asset Management for GBP16.5mm, ending Macquarie’s 20-year investment in the UK broadcast and telecommunications infrastructure company. Arqiva operates the UK’s terrestrial television and radio transmission network and has a growing smart utilities networks business with an order book of approximately GBP2.8bn.

cards.title: Drogheda Energy Park | Schroders Greencoat
cards.metadata: JV / Platform · Data Centers · Ireland
cards.description: Greencoat Renewables and Schroders Greencoat’s SCSL Global Energy Infrastructure vehicle launched a 50:50 green digital infrastructure JV, with Drogheda Energy Park as its inaugural investment. The platform acquired the former Premier Periclase site in Drogheda, County Louth, at an advanced stage of planning consent for an initial 36 MW data centre combining on-site generation, storage, and grid services.

cards.title: Valokuitunen Oy | Brookfield Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Equity Stake (51%) · Fiber/Broadband · Finland
cards.description: CapMan Infra agreed to sell its 60% stake in Valokuitunen Oy, Finland’s largest independent FTTH operator, to Brookfield Infrastructure Structured Solutions (51%) and Telia (9%, increasing its ownership to 49%). The platform, established in 2020 as a Telia-CapMan JV, has built an open-access network reaching >400,000 homes.

cards.title: TCR | Global Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Secondary Buyout (71%) · Ground Support · Europe
cards.description: Global Infrastructure Partners (BlackRock) agreed to acquire TCR, the world’s largest independent lessor of airport ground support equipment, from 3i Infrastructure plc. TCR manages ~44,000 assets at >200 airports globally. 3i expects net proceeds of ~€1.14bn from its 71% stake, a 22% uplift to its September 2025 valuation.

cards.title: Gosport Ferry | Northleaf Capital / Thames Clippers
cards.metadata: Bolt-On · Ferry · UK
cards.description: TC Gosport Bidco, an indirect subsidiary of Uber Boat by Thames Clippers (backed by Northleaf Capital Partners), acquired the Portsmouth Harbour Ferry Company from FIH Group plc for GBP11.62mm. The ferry company operates the Gosport Ferry service, providing a pedestrian and cyclist link between Gosport and Portsmouth.

cards.title: Aura Holdings | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Platform Equity · Retirement Villages · Australia
cards.description: Stonepeak announced a platform equity investment in Aura Holdings, a leading retirement village developer in Queensland, Australia. The investment, together with committed development facilities, provides up to A$1bn to support Aura’s pipeline of >10 projects. This marks Stonepeak’s second platform commitment in the ANZ retirement village sector, following its acquisition of Arvida Group in November 2024.

cards.title: Naturgy Energy Group | CriteriaCaixa
cards.metadata: Block Trade (11.4%) · Gas & Power · Spain
cards.description: BlackRock, through GIP, divested its remaining 11.4% stake in Naturgy Energy Group via an accelerated bookbuild, placing 110.8mm shares at €25.20 each (€2.79bn, ~5.8% discount to prior close). The sale completes GIP’s full exit from Naturgy, a position originally established in 2016.

cards.title: Invenergy AMPCI Thermal Power (IATP) | ArcLight Capital
cards.metadata: ArcLight Capital (Stake Acquisition) · Thermal Power · US
cards.description: ArcLight Capital Partners signed a definitive agreement to acquire InfraBridge’s (DigitalBridge) 50% stake in Invenergy AMPCI Thermal Power, a diversified portfolio of 11 power infrastructure assets totaling ~5.4 GW of generation capacity across seven North American markets. Invenergy will retain its existing ownership interest and continue managing operations of the portfolio, which includes highly efficient combined-cycle facilities such as Grays Harbor (WA), Nelson (IL), Lackawanna (PA), and St. Clair (ON). BofA Securities advised InfraBridge; Morgan Stanley advised ArcLight.

cards.title: Gate City Power / Gate City Renewable Fuels / JET | Ara Partners
cards.target: Gate City Power / Gate City Renewable Fuels / JET
cards.metadata: Ara Partners (Platform Acquisition) · Power & Fuels · US
cards.description: Ara Energy, a portfolio platform of Ara Partners, agreed to acquire Gate City Power, Gate City Renewable Fuels, and an interest in the JET retail network from HF Capital for ~$875mm. Gate City Power owns thermal generation assets totaling ~2.2 GW across NYISO and ISO-NE, while Gate City Renewable Fuels comprises U.S. ethanol production assets; the JET retail network will be acquired in partnership with Ara Infrastructure.

cards.title: TAKKION | Apollo
cards.metadata: Apollo (Divestiture Exit) · Infrastructure Services · US
cards.description: Siris agreed to acquire a majority stake in TAKKION from funds managed by Apollo Global Management. TAKKION, founded in 2019 and headquartered in Centennial, Colorado, is the premier integrated logistics, O&M, and technical services provider to the renewable energy industry, comprising Transportation Partners & Logistics, Global Specialized Services, RENEW Energy, and Airway Services (~$600mm revenue in 2025). Siris plans to expand TAKKION’s service offerings across wind, solar, battery, and transmission sectors.

cards.title: Steel River Solar and Storage Project | EQT Infrastructure
cards.target: Steel River Solar and Storage Project
cards.metadata: EQT Infrastructure (Project Acquisition) · Solar & Storage · US
cards.description: Cypress Creek Renewables, a portfolio company of EQT Infrastructure, acquired the Steel River solar and storage project in Northeast Arkansas from Swift Current Energy (backed by IFM Investors). The facility combines 2,450 MWdc (1,500 MWac) of solar generation with 2,900 MWh (720 MW) of battery storage across three equal phases, making it one of the largest solar and energy storage projects in the United States. The project is expected to be placed in service in 2029.

cards.title: Nighthawk Energy Storage Project | Goldman Sachs AM
cards.metadata: Goldman Sachs AM (Preferred Equity) · BESS · US
cards.description: Goldman Sachs Alternatives committed a $169mm preferred equity investment in Arevon Energy’s 300 MW / 1,200 MWh Nighthawk Energy Storage Project in Poway, California, as part of a broader $920mm financing package. The total financing comprises a $482mm debt facility led by CIBC, the Goldman Sachs preferred equity tranche structured to simplify tax credit monetization, and a $268mm tax credit transfer commitment. The lithium iron phosphate battery facility will provide resource adequacy capacity to PG&E under a long-term contract and is expected to become operational later in 2026.

cards.title: TPI Composites (Wind Blade Manufacturing) | Energy Capital Partners
cards.metadata: Energy Capital Partners (Carve-Out) · Wind Manufacturing · US
cards.description: Energy Capital Partners, through ECP Blade Holdings, agreed to acquire TPI Composites’ global wind blade manufacturing and services operations via a Section 363 bankruptcy sale for $20mm in cash plus assumed liabilities. TPI, the only independent wind blade manufacturer with a global footprint, filed for Chapter 11 and secured $82.5mm in DIP financing as it navigates the restructuring process. The transaction is subject to bankruptcy court approval, Oaktree lender consent, and regulatory approvals, with a drop-dead date of June 30, 2026.

cards.title: 70.4 MWp Brandenburg Solar Park | Nuveen Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Nuveen Infrastructure (Asset Acquisition) · Solar · Germany
cards.description: Nuveen’s European Core Renewable Infrastructure Strategy fund acquired a 70.4 MWp solar park in Brandenburg, Germany from Trianel Energieprojekte, a subsidiary of municipal utility cooperative Trianel GmbH. The solar park, located along the Berlin-Halle railway line, was commissioned in April 2025 and meets EU Taxonomy requirements. Trianel, backed by 53 municipal shareholders, develops wind, solar, and battery storage projects across Germany and Austria.

cards.title: Maaselänkangas Onshore Wind Farm | DWS Infrastructure
cards.metadata: DWS Infrastructure (Asset Acquisition) · Wind · Finland
cards.description: DWS Group acquired the Maaselänkangas onshore wind farm in Oulainen, Finland from wpd Group on behalf of its European infrastructure investment strategy. The facility comprises seven Nordex turbines with 41.3 MW of installed capacity, has been operational since September 2024, and is expected to generate ~128.6 GWh of annual net energy output. The acquisition underscores DWS’s systematic expansion into European renewable energy assets.

cards.title: Dandelion Partnership | CVC DIF / Diverso Energy
cards.metadata: CVC DIF / Diverso Energy (Joint Venture) · Geothermal · US
cards.description: Diverso Energy, majority-owned by CVC DIF (~€23bn infrastructure AUM), announced a strategic partnership with Dandelion Energy to accelerate geothermal heat pump deployment across new U.S. residential housing developments. Under a “Geo-as-a-Service” model, Diverso and Dandelion will finance, install, and own geothermal systems, providing homebuilders with a zero-upfront-cost turnkey solution. The partnership targets three to four initial U.S. states, addressing a market where only ~1% of U.S. homes currently have geothermal heat pumps.

cards.title: GFiber / Astound Broadband | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak (Platform Combination) · Fiber/Broadband · US
cards.description: Stonepeak and Alphabet announced the combination of GFiber (formerly Google Fiber) with Stonepeak’s Astound Broadband, creating a leading independent fiber broadband provider with a combined footprint of ~7.1mm locations across the U.S.. Stonepeak will hold majority ownership of the combined entity, with Alphabet retaining a significant minority stake; the combined platform will be led by GFiber’s existing executive team. The transaction enables GFiber to operate independently while pairing its high-growth metropolitan fiber networks with Astound’s established infrastructure and customer base.

cards.title: Lefdal Mine Datacenter | 3i Infrastructure
cards.metadata: 3i Infrastructure (Majority Stake) · Data Centers · Norway
cards.description: 3i Infrastructure agreed to invest ~€300mm to acquire a majority stake in Lefdal Mine Datacenter, a Norwegian data center campus located in a former mine with 37 MW of operational capacity and 43 MW under construction. The site leverages Norway’s low-cost, reliable power supply and a closed-loop seawater cooling system for high energy efficiency, with significant expansion potential across five undeveloped mine levels. The total investment, including growth capital, is expected to reach ~€400mm.

cards.title: Advanced Cooling Technologies (ACT) | Blackstone
cards.metadata: Blackstone (Majority Stake) · Data Center Cooling · US
cards.description: Blackstone Energy Transition Partners agreed to acquire a majority stake in Advanced Cooling Technologies, a Pennsylvania-based manufacturer of highly-engineered thermal management and energy efficiency solutions serving data center, defense, space, and energy applications. ACT’s product suite, including two-phase liquid cooling, heat pipes, and cold plates, is well-positioned to benefit from rising power density and cooling requirements driven by AI infrastructure buildout. ACT’s executive team will remain in place and continue as significant shareholders.

cards.title: Arqiva | IFM Investors
cards.metadata: IFM Investors (Divestiture) · Broadcast Infra · UK
cards.description: Funds managed by IFM Investors agreed to divest their 14.84% minority stake in Arqiva, the UK’s leading broadcast and telecommunications infrastructure operator, to Polus Capital Management for GBP8.9mm. The sale follows Polus’s earlier acquisition of Macquarie Asset Management’s 26.54% stake, bringing Polus’s combined equity interest in Arqiva to 41.38%. Arqiva’s revenue base is underpinned by long-term, RPI-linked contracts with investment-grade counterparties including the BBC and major mobile network operators.

cards.title: Sierra Railroad Company | Ridgewood Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Ridgewood Infrastructure (Platform Acquisition) · Rail · US
cards.description: Ridgewood Infrastructure acquired a controlling interest in Sierra Railroad Company, a California-based shortline rail platform providing freight rail, switching, storage, and transloading services across ~130 miles of track. Founded in 1897, Sierra’s network is strategically positioned near major agricultural and dairy production regions, key West Coast ports, and major industrial centers, with interconnections to both Union Pacific and BNSF Class I networks. The platform also includes Railpower, Inc., which owns the only FRA-approved hydrogen-powered locomotive in the U.S.

cards.title: Central Valley Ag Transport (CVAT) | Ridgewood Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Ridgewood Infrastructure (Bolt-On) · Rail · US
cards.description: Simultaneously with Ridgewood’s acquisition of Sierra Railroad, Sierra acquired Central Valley Ag Transport, an agricultural products transload facility owner and operator serving customers along Sierra’s rail network. The bolt-on vertically integrates agricultural transload capabilities essential to California’s dairy and broader agricultural industry, enabling efficient movement of feed and agricultural products while deepening customer relationships and increasing rail utilization.

cards.title: Kelda Holdings (Yorkshire Water) | EQT Infrastructure & GIC
cards.metadata: EQT Infrastructure & GIC (Minority Stake) · Water · UK
cards.description: EQT Active Core Infrastructure agreed to acquire a 42% shareholding in Kelda Holdings, the parent company of Yorkshire Water, which provides essential water and wastewater services to ~5.5mm customers across over two million homes and 140,000 businesses in the UK. The transaction sees DWS Infrastructure and Corsair Capital exit their minority positions while GIC increases its stake to 42% and TCorp to 16%, positioning the new shareholder group to support an GBP8.3bn investment program between 2025 and 2030. EQT has also committed to contributing further equity to strengthen the balance sheet.

cards.title: Gorgon LNG / Ichthys LNG | EIG / MidOcean Energy
cards.metadata: EIG / MidOcean Energy (Minority Stake) · LNG · Australia
cards.description: MidOcean Energy, a globally diversified LNG platform formed and managed by EIG Global Energy Partners, entered into definitive agreements to acquire JERA’s 0.417% interest in the Chevron-operated 15.6 mtpa Gorgon LNG project, increasing MidOcean’s stake to 1.417%. The transaction perimeter also includes JERA’s 0.735% interest in the Inpex-operated 8.9 mtpa Ichthys LNG project, which will be transferred to an existing Ichthys JV participant upon closing. UBS served as financial advisor and White & Case as legal advisor to MidOcean.

cards.title: Plenitude (Eni) | Ares Management
cards.metadata: Ares Management (Growth Equity) · Renewables · Italy
cards.description: Eni announced a ~€1.5bn capital increase for Plenitude, its renewables and retail energy unit, with at least €1bn from Ares (€10.75bn pre-money equity valuation). The transaction establishes joint control between Eni (~65%) and Ares, deconsolidating Plenitude.

cards.title: Bayonne Energy Center | Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners (Divestiture) · Thermal Power · US
cards.description: MSIP agreed to sell its stake in Thermal Bayonne Holdings, a 660 MW dual-fuel peaking facility in Bayonne, NJ, to Jupiter Energy Investor. The plant serves NYC via a dedicated subsea cable. Jefferies served as financial advisor.

cards.title: Spanish Hybridisation Platform | Equitix
cards.metadata: Equitix / COFIDES (Co-Investment) · Renewables · Spain
cards.description: COFIDES committed up to €150mm through Spain’s FOCO co-investment fund to join Equitix’s renewable hybridisation platform, co-owned with Australia’s TCorp. The platform targets 1.4 GW of wind, solar, and storage by 2030, with 330 MW operational or under construction.

cards.title: 174 MW Wind Portfolio (France) | Axium Infrastructure Europe
cards.metadata: Axium Infrastructure Europe (Minority Stake) · Wind · France
cards.description: Axium Infrastructure Europe, a Canadian infrastructure fund, acquired a 49.9% interest in a 174 MW operational wind portfolio from la Banque des Territoires, with ENGIE Green retaining 50.1%. The 22-project portfolio spans three French regions with revenues under government FiT and CfD contracts.

cards.title: 48.4 MW Community Solar Portfolio (New Mexico) | Brookfield
cards.metadata: Brookfield / Standard Solar (Bolt-On) · Solar · US
cards.description: Standard Solar, a Brookfield portfolio company, acquired a 48.4 MW, eight-project community solar portfolio in New Mexico from Pluma Construction and ForeFront Power — among the first projects delivered under the state’s Community Solar Program.

cards.title: Porterbrook | CBRE Investment Management
cards.metadata: CBRE Investment Management (Minority Stake) · Rolling Stock · UK
cards.description: CBRE IM’s Private Infrastructure division agreed to acquire a 10% stake in Porterbrook, the UK’s second-largest rolling stock lessor with ~4,300 rail vehicles (~25% of the national fleet).

cards.title: Cube Highways Trust (4 Highway Assets) | I Squared Capital
cards.metadata: I Squared Capital / Cube Highways (Asset Acquisition) · Highways · India
cards.description: Cube Highways Trust, backed by I Squared Capital, executed a binding commitment to acquire four highway entities from its sponsor via equity swap. The Trust manages 27 road assets spanning 2,000+ km across 12 Indian states and filed with SEBI for public InvIT conversion.

cards.title: PMI Electro / Allfleet | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR (Growth Equity) · EV Fleet · India
cards.description: KKR agreed to invest up to $310mm for a majority stake in Allfleet and a minority stake in PMI Electro Mobility, India’s leading e-bus manufacturer (2,900+ buses, 31 cities). Capital will fund 5,000+ e-buses under long-term concessions.

cards.title: Revolv | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR / Zenōbē (Bolt-On) · EV Fleet · US
cards.description: Zenōbē (KKR, Infracapital, Mubadala) acquired California-based Revolv to enter the US commercial e-truck market, adding 13 operational sites and 100+ electric trucks to its 3,400+ global vehicle fleet.

cards.title: NorthC Datacenters | APG Asset Management
cards.metadata: APG Asset Management (Co-Investment) · Data Centers · Netherlands
cards.description: APG Asset Management, the Dutch pension investor, co-invested in NorthC Datacenters alongside Antin Infrastructure Partners’ platform buyout from DWS (Antin Fund V). NorthC operates 25 colocation data centers across the Netherlands, Germany, and Switzerland with 140+ MW of secured grid capacity.

cards.title: Amprion | Allianz Global Investors
cards.metadata: AllianzGI (Minority Stake) · Electricity Grid · Germany
cards.description: AllianzGI agreed to acquire an indirect stake in Amprion from Talanx; Amprion’s extra-high-voltage grid spans 11,000+ km and serves ~29mm people. Amprion plans to invest more than €36bn by 2029 to construct or upgrade 9,300 km of power lines to support the energy transition.

cards.title: OnStream | Igneo Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Igneo Infrastructure Partners (Acquisition) · Smart Metering · UK
cards.description: Igneo entered a binding agreement to acquire OnStream, the UK’s second-largest smart meter asset provider, with ~7mm installed meters and a ~3mm-meter pipeline. OnStream also operates ~60,000 meters in Germany.

cards.title: Lestari Cooling Energy Sdn. Bhd. | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak / KJTS / KWAP (Growth Equity / Minority Stake) · District Cooling · Malaysia
cards.description: KJTS and Stonepeak added KWAP as an investor in Lestari Cooling Energy, with KWAP expected to commit up to ~RM190mm. The platform develops energy-efficient district cooling systems across Malaysia, targeting up to 50% reductions in energy consumption and over 70,000 tCO2 in annual emissions savings at full deployment.

cards.title: Boralex Inc. | Brookfield / La Caisse
cards.metadata: Brookfield / La Caisse (Take-Private) · Renewables · Canada
cards.description: Brookfield and La Caisse agreed to acquire Boralex for $37.25/share in cash, implying ~$3.8bn of equity value and ~$9.0bn EV, with La Caisse owning 30% post-close. Boralex operates ~3,783 MW of installed wind, solar, hydro, and storage capacity across Canada, the US, France, and the UK, with an 8.2 GW development pipeline.

cards.title: Akira Portfolio (6 Italian Solar PV Plants) | J.P. Morgan Asset Management
cards.target: Akira Portfolio (6 Italian Solar PV Plants)
cards.metadata: Sonnedix / J.P. Morgan Asset Management (Bolt-On) · Solar · Italy
cards.description: Sonnedix acquired the 194 MW Akira portfolio from EOS Investment Management and Capital Dynamics, comprising six solar PV projects in Lazio, including five operating plants and one 12 MW project under construction. All six assets benefit from long-term PPAs, and the transaction lifted Sonnedix’s operating capacity in Italy above 1 GW.

cards.title: Tamil Nadu Solar Project (100 MW) | ADIA Infrastructure
cards.metadata: ReNew Energy Global (Divestiture) · Solar · India
cards.description: ReNew agreed to sell its 100 MW / 117.5 MWp Tamil Nadu solar project to Technique Solaire at ~$49mm EV; the asset has a 25-year TANGEDCO PPA. The project was commissioned in 2019 and operates under a PPA priced at ₹3.47/kWh.

cards.title: Safeway Concessions (9 Indian Toll Highways) | Macquarie Asset Management
cards.metadata: Macquarie Asset Management (Divestiture) · Toll Roads · India
cards.description: VINCI Highways agreed to acquire Safeway Concessions from Macquarie Asia Infrastructure Fund 2 at ~INR150bn EV; the portfolio comprises nine toll concessions spanning nearly 700 km. The concessions are operated under TOT contracts with NHAI in Andhra Pradesh and Gujarat, with maturities ranging from 2048 to 2058.

cards.title: A63 Motorway | InfraRed Capital Partners / CVC DIF
cards.metadata: InfraRed Capital Partners / CVC DIF (Divestiture) · Toll Road · France
cards.description: Abertis acquired the remaining 49% of the A63 motorway from HICL Infrastructure, CVC DIF and NGE Autoroutes, taking ownership to 100%. The A63 is a 104 km toll motorway connecting Salles to Saint-Geours-de-Marenne, a strategic corridor between Bordeaux and the Basque Country.

cards.title: All American Grease Services | Goldman Sachs Asset Management
cards.metadata: LES / Goldman Sachs Asset Management (Bolt-On) · Waste Services · US
cards.description: LES acquired All American Grease Services Companies, a non-hazardous liquid waste company offering grease trap and used cooking oil collection services across the Gulf Coast and Southeast US. The acquisition added five service branches and three wastewater treatment facilities to LES’s network of 300+ vacuum trucks and 24 treatment plants.

cards.title: Equinox Growers Greenhouse Facility | Generate Capital
cards.metadata: Generate Capital (Divestiture) · Controlled-Environment Agriculture · US
cards.description: Generate sold Equinox Growers to Taylor Farms, monetizing a 10-acre Virginia greenhouse capable of producing approximately 6mm pounds of leafy greens annually for East Coast markets. Developed in 2022 and operating at scale, the facility supports year-round regional food supply and highlights controlled-environment agriculture as a critical form of agricultural infrastructure.

cards.title: Desktop S.A. | H.I.G. Capital
cards.metadata: H.I.G. Capital (Divestiture) · Fiber Broadband / ISP · Brazil
cards.description: H.I.G. signed a definitive agreement to sell Desktop to Claro at R$4.0bn (~$750mm, including debt); Desktop serves 1.2mm+ subscribers through 58,000+ km of fiber. Desktop is a leading fiber-based ISP in São Paulo state, where it operates as the dominant broadband provider across the interior.

cards.title: Mattingly Cold Storage | Igneo Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: ChillCo Logistics / Igneo Infrastructure Partners (Platform Acquisition) · Cold Storage Logistics · US
cards.description: Igneo agreed to acquire Mattingly Cold Storage, a 275k sq. ft. multi-temperature, post-production focused cold storage business in Zanesville, Ohio, as the foundation of ChillCo Logistics. The deal marks Igneo’s inaugural U.S. cold-storage investment and extends its transportation and logistics exposure.

cards.title: I-4 Ultimate Project (50% stake from Skanska) | Equitix / John Laing
cards.target: I-4 Ultimate Project (50% stake from Skanska)
cards.metadata: Equitix / John Laing (Stake Acquisition) · Road PPP · US
cards.description: John Laing Investments Limited, jointly owned by Equitix and John Laing, reached financial close on the acquisition of Skanska’s 50% stake in I-4 Ultimate, securing full ownership of the asset. The project covers approximately 21 miles of Interstate 4 in central Florida and serves more than 200,000 motorists daily under a 40-year availability-based P3 concession.

cards.title: Cross London Trains | InfraRed Capital Partners
cards.metadata: InfraRed Capital Partners / HICL (Minority Stake Acquisition) · Rail Rolling Stock · UK
cards.description: HICL agreed to acquire a further 6.65% interest in Cross London Trains for approximately £52mm, taking its total economic interest to 13.13%. XLT owns the fleet of 115 Siemens Class 700 electric trains operating on Thameslink, one of the UK’s most important transport corridors linking St Pancras, Gatwick Airport and Luton Airport.

cards.title: 24H Frost | I Squared Capital
cards.metadata: CubeCold / I Squared Capital (Bolt-On) · Cold Storage Logistics · France
cards.description: CubeCold entered the French market through the acquisition of 24H Frost, adding a fully automated cold-storage facility in the port of Loon-Plage, Dunkirk. The site offers more than 12,000 frozen pallet positions, and the acquisition expands CubeCold’s network to over 700,000 pallet spaces across six European markets.

cards.title: UK social infrastructure PPP portfolio | Equitix
cards.metadata: Equitix (Portfolio Acquisition) · Social Infrastructure PPP · UK
cards.description: Equitix completed the acquisition of 100% of the equity and subordinated debt interests in a UK social infrastructure PPP portfolio from Sir Robert McAlpine Capital Ventures for Equitix Fund VII. The assets include Gateshead Schools PPP, Redcar Primary Care Hospital PPP and an additional 50% interest in City of Glasgow College PPP, serving more than 6,500 students and providing more than 30 community hospital beds.

cards.title: Orbis Protect | Tiger Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Tiger Infrastructure Partners (Growth Capital Investment) · Security Infrastructure · UK
cards.description: Tiger agreed a transformational growth capital investment in Orbis Protect, a UK-based owner and operator of dynamic security solutions. The capital is intended to fund further technology investment, expansion across the UK and Europe, and continued international growth, while facilitating Synova’s exit.

cards.title: Northside East Cobb Medical Center | Harrison Street
cards.metadata: Harrison Street / Stonemont (Acquisition) · Outpatient Healthcare · US
cards.description: Harrison Street partnered with Stonemont on the acquisition of Northside East Cobb Medical Center, a 103,184 sq. ft., 100%-leased medical office building in Marietta, Georgia. Anchored by Northside Hospital, the four-story facility houses imaging, orthopedics, primary care, urgent care, and physician specialty services.

cards.title: Mercia Power Response + Balance Power Projects | InfraVia Capital Partners
cards.target: Mercia Power Response + Balance Power Projects
cards.metadata: InfraVia Capital Partners (Platform Creation) · Flexible Power · UK
cards.description: InfraVia acquired majority stakes in Mercia Power Response and Balance Power and will merge the two businesses into Supernova Power, a UK-focused flexible power platform. Mercia operates 262MW of gas peaking and battery storage assets with more than 400MW in development, while Balance adds a battery storage pipeline of over 1.4GW.

cards.title: Three 5MW biomass plants in Croatia | Ancala Partners
cards.metadata: Croatian Biomass Platform / Ancala Partners (Bolt-On) · Biomass · Croatia
cards.description: Ancala’s Croatian Biomass Platform acquired three 5MW biomass plants from The Sherif Group, more than doubling renewable generation capacity to 25MW. The five-site platform now generates approximately 200,000 MWh annually, equivalent to powering more than 45,000 homes, with the newly acquired plants backed by long-term feed-in tariffs and biomass supply agreements.

cards.title: Nxtra Data Limited | Carlyle
cards.metadata: Carlyle / Airtel (Growth Equity / Minority Stake) · Data Centers · India
cards.description: Carlyle participated in Airtel’s US$1.0bn funding round for Nxtra, which values the data-center platform at around US$3.1bn post-closing. Carlyle is committing US$240mm, and Nxtra plans to deploy the capital to expand its network across India, scaling from roughly 300MW today toward 1GW over time.

cards.title: Selected Data Center Assets from NEC Corporation | DigitalBridge
cards.target: Selected Data Center Assets from NEC Corporation
cards.metadata: DigitalBridge / JEXI (Carve-Out / Acquisition) · Data Centers · Japan
cards.description: DigitalBridge and JEXI completed the acquisition of selected NEC data-center assets in the Greater Tokyo and Kansai regions. The assets will operate as a new standalone platform, with NEC retained as anchor customer under contract as the business seeks to add third-party colocation demand.

cards.title: Sapphire Gas Solutions | Antin Infrastructure Partners / Apollo Global Management
cards.sponsor: Antin Infrastructure Partners / Apollo Global Management
cards.metadata: Antin Infrastructure Partners / Apollo (Platform Buyout / Divestiture) · CNG / LNG Infrastructure · US
cards.description: Antin, through Flagship Fund V, acquired Sapphire Gas Solutions from Apollo-managed funds. Sapphire owns and operates infrastructure to compress, liquefy, transport and store CNG and LNG, operates across 30 U.S. states, and serves more than 120 customers.

cards.title: Rowan Digital Infrastructure | Quinbrook / Blackstone
cards.metadata: Blackstone (Minority Stake Acquisition) · Data Centers · US
cards.description: Quinbrook announced a strategic recapitalization of Rowan Digital Infrastructure through the sale of a 49% significant minority stake to funds affiliated with Blackstone. The transaction monetizes part of Quinbrook’s ownership while retaining control, partnering with Blackstone to support Rowan’s next phase of growth and continued hyperscale data center expansion serving cloud and AI-driven demand.

cards.title: DataBank / Goodman Los Angeles JV (32 MW) | Swiss Life AM / IMCO / AustralianSuper
cards.target: DataBank / Goodman Los Angeles JV (32 MW)
cards.metadata: DataBank / Goodman (Joint Venture) · Data Centers · US
cards.description: DataBank and Goodman formed a 50/50 joint venture to develop a 32 MW AI-ready data center in Vernon, California. The arrangement advances sponsor-backed digital infrastructure development in a supply-constrained Los Angeles market and adds to DataBank’s broader U.S. expansion pipeline.

cards.title: Hemel Hempstead Data Center | DWS
cards.metadata: DWS / Stellanor (Bolt-On) · Data Centers · UK
cards.description: DWS, through portfolio company Stellanor, acquired a purpose-built data center in Hemel Hempstead from Imagination Technologies in a sale-and-service-back structure. The add-on expands Stellanor’s UK footprint while keeping the seller as a continuing service customer at the site.

cards.title: EnergySolutions | ECP
cards.metadata: ECP (Buyout) · Nuclear Services · US
cards.description: ECP agreed to acquire EnergySolutions in a full platform buyout, returning the nuclear services provider to infrastructure ownership. The deal adds exposure to essential decommissioning, waste management, and broader nuclear lifecycle services as electricity demand and energy security priorities continue to reshape the sector.

cards.title: Canales Sur Wind Project (120 MW) | Equitix
cards.metadata: Equitix (Majority Stake Acquisition) · Onshore Wind · Spain
cards.description: Equitix acquired a majority equity stake in the 120 MW Canales Sur onshore wind project in Spain, extending its partnership with Capital Energy. The deal adds another renewables asset to Equitix’s Iberian hybridisation strategy, with future solar and storage expansion expected alongside the wind platform.

cards.title: Sedron Technologies | Ara Partners
cards.metadata: Ara Partners (Growth Equity) · Wastewater / Resource Recovery · US
cards.description: Ara committed up to $500mm to Sedron Technologies to scale infrastructure that converts wastewater and organic waste streams into reusable resources and clean electricity. The investment reflects continuing sponsor interest in circular infrastructure platforms with both environmental services and energy outputs.

cards.title: Nordic Ferry Infrastructure | EQT
cards.metadata: EQT (Minority Stake Sale) · Ferry / Maritime Transport · Nordics
cards.description: EQT agreed to sell a 30% minority stake in Nordic Ferry Infrastructure to a consortium of long-term investors while retaining a 70% majority interest. The transaction broadens the platform’s investor base following its transformation into a pan-Nordic maritime transportation infrastructure business.

cards.title: Summerfield Battery Energy Storage Project (240 MW / 960 MWh) | CIP
cards.target: Summerfield Battery Energy Storage Project (240 MW / 960 MWh)
cards.metadata: CIP (Divestiture) · Battery Storage · Australia
cards.description: CIP divested its 100% equity stake in the Summerfield Battery Energy Storage Project to Palisade Investment Partners. The asset is a utility-scale 240 MW / 960 MWh lithium-ion battery system located in South Australia.

cards.title: Sustainable Energy Infrastructure (SEI) | Patrizia
cards.metadata: Patrizia (Divestiture) · Distributed Solar & Storage · Australia
cards.description: Patrizia signed a binding agreement to fully divest its 100% equity stake in Sustainable Energy Infrastructure (SEI) to CleanPeak Energy. SEI owns, develops and operates a distributed portfolio of sub-5 MW solar arrays and battery energy storage systems.

cards.title: Insplorion Hydrogen Sensor Business | Antin
cards.metadata: Antin / Consilium Safety Group (Bolt-On) · Hydrogen Sensors · Europe
cards.description: Consilium Safety Group, a portfolio company of Antin Infrastructure Partners, acquired Insplorion’s hydrogen sensor technology business, including related intellectual property and physical assets for advanced hydrogen detection sensors.

cards.title: Züm | TPG
cards.metadata: TPG (Growth Equity) · Student Mobility · US
cards.description: TPG made a $100mm strategic growth equity investment into Züm, an operator of electric school bus fleets and mass student mobility networks, valuing the specialized transportation infrastructure company at $1.7bn.

cards.title: Berland Resource Road & Home Creek Road | CBRE
cards.target: Berland Resource Road & Home Creek Road
cards.metadata: CBRE / Canadian Resource Roadways (Bolt-On) · Resource Roads · Canada
cards.description: Canadian Resource Roadways, a portfolio company of CBRE Investment Management, signed a definitive agreement to acquire a 90% equity stake in a 134-kilometer industrial access road network that supports regional forestry and energy operations.

cards.title: Spire Storage | I Squared
cards.metadata: I Squared (Asset Acquisition) · Natural Gas Storage · US
cards.description: I Squared Capital agreed to acquire the midstream natural gas storage assets of Spire Inc. for $650mm in cash and deferred payments. The assets provide up to 72 Bcf of combined working gas capacity.

cards.title: Evryo Group (Distribuție Energie Oltenia) | Macquarie
cards.metadata: Macquarie (Divestiture) · Electricity Distribution · Europe
cards.description: Macquarie Asset Management agreed to divest its 100% equity interest in Evryo Group to Premier Energy Group. Evryo operates a regulated electricity distribution network in Romania spanning 80,000 kilometers and connecting 1.5mm customers.

cards.title: Green Energy Storage Initiative (GESI) | Allianz
cards.metadata: Allianz (Majority Stake) · Battery Storage · Europe
cards.description: Allianz Global Investors acquired a 51% stake in GESI on behalf of Allianz insurance companies, marking the firm’s second direct equity investment in German battery storage following its March partnership with TotalEnergies. GESI develops, builds and operates large utility-scale battery storage and is currently advancing three projects across Bavaria and Lower Saxony with an aggregate grid connection capacity of approximately 2.6 GW.

cards.title: Cordelio Power’s 6GW Joint Venture Interest | CPP Investments
cards.metadata: CPP Investments / Cordelio Power (Divestiture) · Renewable Energy · US
cards.description: BrightNight bought out JV partner Cordelio Power’s interest in 6 GW of US solar and storage development projects, taking full ownership and control of the assets and leaving four operating/construction-stage projects within the legacy JV. The transaction follows BrightNight’s recent $850mm corporate credit facility close and reinforces the AI-focused IPP’s western US footprint; Cordelio is the renewables platform owned by CPP Investments.

cards.title: Alliance Energy Group Portfolio | Partners Group
cards.metadata: Partners Group / PowerTransitions (Bolt-On) · Power Generation · US
cards.description: PowerTransitions agreed to acquire a five-plant, 323 MW portfolio — comprising the Batavia, Hillburn, Massena, Shoemaker and Sterling assets — along with associated pipeline infrastructure from Alliance Energy Group, marking the Partners Group-backed platform’s entry into the New York market. The transaction will lift PowerTransitions’ total operating fleet to roughly 550 MW across seven stations supplying multiple NYISO zones.

cards.title: FPH2’s Los Angeles County Renewable Hydrogen Project | Quinbrook
cards.target: FPH2’s Los Angeles County Renewable Hydrogen Project
cards.metadata: Quinbrook / Elemental Clean Fuels (Bolt-On) · Renewable Hydrogen · US
cards.description: Elemental Clean Fuels will acquire one of FPH2’s priority renewable hydrogen projects in Los Angeles County and lead its development, financing and construction as part of its growing North American clean fuels platform. The solar-powered electrolytic facility is designed to supply zero-emission hydrogen to data centers, microgrids, hydrogen-capable turbines, transit fleets and port operations; Elemental is backed by Quinbrook following a strategic transaction closed in late 2025.

cards.title: Vertical Bridge | KKR, DigitalBridge & CDPQ
cards.metadata: KKR, DigitalBridge & CDPQ (Growth Equity) · Telecom Towers · US
cards.description: KKR is making a $1.5bn strategic equity investment in Vertical Bridge, joining existing sponsors DigitalBridge and La Caisse (formerly CDPQ), who both rolled into the new structure to establish a fully funded, long-term capital base. Vertical Bridge is the largest private owner and operator of communications infrastructure in the United States, with a portfolio of more than 17,000 towers; KKR has now deployed over $40bn of equity into digital infrastructure globally.

cards.title: EdgeConneX | EQT
cards.metadata: EQT (Seed Transfer) · Data Centers · Global
cards.description: EQT launched a dedicated AI Infrastructure strategy fully seeded by portfolio company EdgeConneX, transferring the data center platform from EQT Infrastructure into the new vehicle to support its growth trajectory. Since EQT’s 2020 acquisition, EdgeConneX has scaled capacity nearly 20x and plans to develop more than 10 GW of additional data center capacity, leveraging EQT’s broader infrastructure platform of 100+ GW energy pipeline, 90+ data centers and 29mm miles of fiber.

cards.title: Spectrotel & AireSpring | Charlesbank
cards.metadata: Charlesbank (Strategic Investment) · Fiber Networks · US
cards.description: Charlesbank will make a new strategic investment in Grain Management portfolio company Spectrotel, with Grain reinvesting alongside, and concurrently combine the company with AireSpring to form a leading managed network services platform. The Lonstein family, AireSpring’s founders, will remain significant minority investors; together the two businesses combine Spectrotel’s distributed enterprise reach with AireSpring’s global connectivity and managed services capabilities.

cards.title: SiFi Networks America LLC | Patrizia
cards.metadata: Patrizia (Buyout) · Fiber Networks · US
cards.description: Patrizia’s Smart City Infrastructure Fund — a partnership with Dutch pension investor APG — took over SiFi Networks America from co-founder Mike Harris’s Ubuntu Business Holdings, consolidating the FiberCity platform under its existing infrastructure backers. SiFi designs, builds and operates open-access municipal fiber networks across the US under its FiberCity model, with active deployments spanning California, Wisconsin and other markets.

cards.title: Pembina Gas Infrastructure (PGI) | Apollo & KKR
cards.metadata: Apollo (Stake Acquisition) & KKR (Divestiture) · Gas Processing · Canada
cards.description: Apollo-managed funds agreed to acquire KKR’s 40% interest in Pembina Gas Infrastructure, with Pembina Pipeline retaining its 60% stake and existing governance unchanged; the deal is expected to close by the end of Q2 2026. PGI — formed as a JV between Pembina and KKR in 2022 — operates roughly 5 Bcf/d of processing capacity across 23 plants, ~3,900 km of gathering pipelines and ~330,000 bpd of NGL extraction serving Montney and Duvernay producers in Alberta and British Columbia.

cards.title: Teréga S.A.S. | GIC
cards.metadata: GIC (Divestiture) · Gas Transmission & Storage · Europe
cards.description: Spanish gas TSO Enagás agreed to acquire GIC’s 31.5% stake in French operator Teréga for €573mm, with closing expected during 2026 subject to French and Spanish regulatory approvals. Teréga operates approximately 5,100 km of gas transmission pipelines and two underground storage facilities in southwestern France, representing roughly 16% of the national transmission network and 27% of French storage capacity.

cards.title: Southern Marinas | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak (Platform Acquisition) · Marinas · US
cards.description: Stonepeak recapitalized Southern Marinas via a buyout of affiliates of KSL Capital Partners, with the transaction closing simultaneously with announcement; PJT Partners and Lazard advised the buy-side and sell-side respectively. Founded in 2018, Southern Marinas owns and operates 16 marinas across eight US states with more than 6,700 slips, complemented by fuel, boat rentals and service operations.

cards.title: F3 Marina | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak / Southern Marinas (Bolt-On) · Marinas · US
cards.description: Southern Marinas acquired F3 Marina Fort Lauderdale on the same day as its Stonepeak recapitalization, adding the 59,000-square-foot facility to its portfolio in a deal facilitated by Colliers. Billed as the world’s tallest dry stack marina at 130 feet, F3 houses 254 vessels across six tiers and operates a first-of-its-kind automated overhead crane system that retrieves boats up to 47 feet in under five minutes — with roughly 90% of revenue derived from storage.

cards.title: Park Properties Housing Association (PPHA) | Sixth Street
cards.metadata: Sixth Street (Growth Equity) · Affordable Housing · UK
cards.description: Sixth Street will provide the majority of equity capital for a new strategic partnership with HSPG and PPHA, with HSPG continuing to lead asset management and platform strategy; the venture targets more than £1bn of investment in UK affordable housing delivery. PPHA is one of the UK’s largest For-Profit Registered Providers, with a contracted pipeline of c.1,100 homes and 4,000+ additional units identified across Affordable Rent, Social Rent, Shared Ownership and Grant-Led tenures.

cards.title: Spire Mississippi | Bernhard
cards.metadata: Bernhard / Delta Utilities (Bolt-On) · Natural Gas Utilities · US
cards.description: Bernhard-backed Delta Utilities agreed to acquire Spire’s Mississippi local distribution company for $75mm in cash — representing a 1.4x multiple of 2025 rate base — with closing targeted for fiscal Q1 2027 subject to Mississippi PSC approval. Spire Mississippi operates approximately 745 miles of distribution pipelines serving roughly 18,000 customers in south-central Mississippi including Hattiesburg; Spire will redeploy proceeds into infrastructure investments across its Alabama, Missouri and Tennessee gas utilities.

cards.title: Saavi Energía & Grupo México Power Assets | GIP
cards.target: Saavi Energía & Grupo México Power Assets
cards.metadata: GIP (Joint Venture) · Power Generation · Mexico
cards.description: Global Infrastructure Partners, part of BlackRock, entered into a definitive agreement to combine its Saavi Energía portfolio company with Grupo México’s power generation assets. The resulting platform will have 4,510 MW of combined output and an approximately 5,000 MW project pipeline, with Grupo México owning 70% and GIP retaining a 30% minority stake.

cards.title: Eurowind Energy | Blackstone
cards.metadata: Blackstone (Growth Equity) · Renewable Energy · Europe
cards.description: Funds managed by Blackstone Infrastructure entered into a definitive agreement to invest up to €2bn in Eurowind Energy, a pan-European renewables developer and independent power producer. The perpetual capital will support Eurowind’s onshore wind, solar, battery storage, and biogas development activity across 16 European markets.

cards.title: Non-core U.S. Hydro Assets | Brookfield
cards.metadata: Brookfield (Divestiture) · Hydroelectric Power · US
cards.description: Brookfield Renewable agreed to sell its remaining 50% interest in a portfolio of non-core U.S. hydroelectric assets, fully monetizing the investment after last year’s initial 50% stake sale at the same valuation. Total proceeds upon closing are expected to be approximately $1bn, including roughly $500mm net to Brookfield Renewable.

cards.title: Nala Renewables | IFM
cards.metadata: IFM (Buyout) · Renewable Energy · Europe
cards.description: Funds managed by IFM Investors agreed to acquire the remaining 50% equity stake in London-based Nala Renewables from Trafigura, bringing IFM to full ownership. Nala manages a multi-technology portfolio of more than 2 GW across solar PV, onshore wind, and battery energy storage systems in strategic European markets.

cards.title: Perigus Energy | CIP
cards.metadata: CIP (Platform Acquisition) · Renewable Energy · Europe
cards.description: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners completed its acquisition of Ørsted’s European onshore business through CI V and launched the platform as Perigus Energy. The company operates across Ireland, Germany, the UK, and Spain with 826 MW of installed and under-construction capacity and a multi-GW pipeline spanning wind, solar, and battery storage.

cards.title: Oriden | I Squared
cards.metadata: I Squared (Platform Acquisition) · Renewable Energy · US
cards.description: I Squared’s Energy Transition Fund acquired Oriden, a Pittsburgh-based renewable energy developer, from Mitsubishi Power Americas. Oriden has a 5+ GW solar PV and battery storage pipeline concentrated in MISO and PJM, and I Squared plans to invest approximately $300mm to scale the platform into a next-generation IPP.

cards.title: 104 MW Community Solar Portfolio | Generate
cards.metadata: Generate (Joint Venture) · Community Solar · US
cards.description: Generate Capital and Monarch Private Capital closed a joint equity investment in a 104 MW community solar portfolio spanning more than 15 projects. The projects are expected to commence operations in the second and third quarters of 2026 and generate approximately $200mm of investment tax credits while expanding local clean power supply.

cards.title: Cleco Group | Stonepeak & Bernhard
cards.metadata: Stonepeak & Bernhard (Buyout) · Electric Utilities · US
cards.description: Stonepeak and Bernhard Capital Partners agreed to acquire Cleco Group from a consortium comprising Macquarie Asset Management, BCI, and Manulife Investment Management. Cleco is a regulated electric utility serving approximately 298,000 customers in Louisiana, with eight generating units totaling 2,676 MW of capacity.

cards.title: Axius Water | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR (Divestiture) · Water Utilities · US
cards.description: CRH agreed to acquire U.S.-based water treatment platform Axius Water from KKR for $700mm. KKR’s Global Impact Fund originally co-established the platform, which provides water quality and nutrient removal infrastructure, and the sale advances CRH’s expansion as a North American water infrastructure provider.

cards.title: UGI PA Electric Utility | Argo
cards.metadata: Argo (Carve-out) · Electric Utilities · US
cards.description: Argo Infrastructure Partners reached a definitive agreement to acquire UGI Utilities’ Electric Division for approximately $470mm. The regulated electric utility operates roughly 2,700 miles of transmission and distribution lines and 14 substations in Pennsylvania’s Luzerne and Wyoming counties, representing Argo’s fourth utility investment in the state.

cards.title: Seven Brazilian Transmission Assets | GIC
cards.metadata: GIC (Minority Stake) · Power Transmission · Brazil
cards.description: GIC and Neoenergia expanded their Brazilian transmission partnership through a R$2.4bn transaction involving a 49% stake in seven transmission assets. The agreement strengthens the platform’s regulated transmission footprint, which is expected to include 16 assets totaling approximately 6,710 km of lines after completion.

cards.title: Elea Data Centers | I Squared
cards.metadata: I Squared (Platform Acquisition) · Data Centers · Brazil
cards.description: I Squared agreed to acquire Elea Data Centers, one of Brazil’s largest carrier-neutral data center platforms. Elea operates nine interconnected campuses across key Brazilian markets with more than 300 MW of powered land and over 1 GW in development, requiring more than US$10bn of capital to fully deliver.

cards.title: i3 Broadband | Wren House
cards.metadata: Wren House (Joint Venture) · Fiber/Broadband · US
cards.description: T-Mobile entered into a definitive agreement to form a 50/50 joint venture with Wren House to acquire i3 Broadband, with T-Mobile expected to invest approximately $700mm for its 50% equity interest. i3 Broadband is a fiber-to-the-premises operator serving customers across Illinois, Missouri, and Rhode Island.

cards.title: Rover Pipeline | Blackstone & Ares
cards.metadata: Ares (Minority Stake) & Blackstone (Divestiture) · Midstream · US
cards.description: Ares Infrastructure Opportunities acquired a 32.4% minority equity stake in the Rover Pipeline from funds managed by Blackstone Energy Transition Partners. The 700-mile transmission pipeline provides 3.425 Bcf/d of Appalachian Basin takeaway capacity to Midwest demand centers and remains substantially contracted under long-term agreements.

cards.title: Inter Terminals | Brookfield
cards.metadata: Brookfield (Divestiture) · Liquid Storage · Europe
cards.description: Brookfield Infrastructure disclosed a signed definitive agreement to sell its Scandinavian bulk liquid storage business, Inter Terminals. The Nordic platform operates terminal locations across Denmark and Sweden with access to transport links and transhipment services, continuing Brookfield’s capital recycling program.

cards.title: TrueNoord | Arcus & Patria
cards.metadata: Arcus (Buyout) & Patria (Divestiture) · Aviation Leasing · Global
cards.description: Arcus Infrastructure Partners entered into definitive documentation to acquire an approximately 74% majority stake in specialist regional aircraft lessor TrueNoord. The transaction facilitates an exit for previous investors including Patria, while founding investor Freshstream will reinvest alongside Arcus to support future fleet growth.

cards.title: Briggs Equipment UK | IFM
cards.metadata: IFM (Platform Acquisition) · Logistics & Equipment · UK
cards.description: IFM Investors agreed to acquire 100% of Briggs Equipment UK from Sammons Enterprises. Briggs is one of the largest independent materials handling platforms in the UK and Ireland, with more than 40 depots, over 850 engineers, and a managed fleet of approximately 53,000 assets serving infrastructure and industrial customers.

cards.title: Power Factors | Mubadala
cards.metadata: Mubadala (Minority Investment) · Renewable Energy Software · Global
cards.description: Mubadala announced a significant minority investment in Power Factors alongside existing investor Vista Equity Partners. Power Factors provides a renewable energy management suite for wind, solar, and storage operators, supporting more than 600 customers across 18,000 sites in over 70 countries and managing approximately 310 GW of capacity.

cards.title: Air Liquide Biogas Assets | Mobius Renewables / IFM
cards.metadata: IFM (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · RNG / Biogas · US & Europe
cards.description: Air Liquide agreed to divest its biogas production activities in the United States, France, Norway, and Sweden to Mobius Renewables, the low-carbon fuels platform established by IFM-managed funds. The carve-out includes production units and distribution assets and expands Mobius beyond its initial GreenGasUSA platform.

cards.title: Nordergründe Offshore Wind Farm | Skyborn / GIP
cards.metadata: GIP (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Offshore Wind · Germany
cards.description: Public merger-control disclosure showed Skyborn Renewables, a Global Infrastructure Partners portfolio company, seeking the indirect acquisition of a 70% stake and sole control of OWP Nordergründe GmbH & Co. KG. Nordergründe is an operating offshore wind project in Germany with 111 MW of capacity.

cards.title: 117 MWp Sicily Agrivoltaic Portfolio | Verdian / Nuveen Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Nuveen Infrastructure (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Solar / Agrivoltaics · Italy
cards.description: Verdian, a clean-energy IPP controlled by Nuveen Infrastructure, acquired a 117 MWp portfolio of three ready-to-build agrivoltaic projects in Sicily from Genertec International Holding. The projects are located in Ramacca and Paternò, have secured FER X contracts under a CfD structure with GSE, and are expected to begin construction toward the end of 2026 with operations targeted between mid- and late-2027.

cards.title: BayWa r.e. Power Solutions | Fervo / Energy Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: EIP (Portfolio Company Divestiture) · Solar EPC / Energy Services · Italy
cards.description: Fervo acquired BayWa r.e. Power Solutions from BayWa r.e. AG, an EIP-linked renewable-energy platform. The Verona-based business develops and builds rooftop and ground-mounted PV systems, storage systems, and integrated energy solutions for industrial customers, utilities, and IPPs, with more than 120 MWp installed and annual revenue exceeding €20mm.

cards.title: Accelerate Infrastructure Opportunities | Mubadala / CBRE IM
cards.metadata: CBRE IM / Mubadala (Primary Capital Raise) · Infrastructure Sites · US
cards.description: CBRE Investment Management-backed Accelerate Infrastructure Opportunities closed a $630mm primary capital raise, bringing total equity commitments to $1.26bn. The round included additional investments from funds managed by CBRE IM and new capital from Mubadala, Australian Retirement Trust, and other global investors to support a site platform across digital, renewable, and transportation infrastructure.

cards.title: NEXTDC | CPP Investments
cards.metadata: CPP Investments (Minority Stake) · Data Centers · Australia
cards.description: CPP Investments disclosed a substantial holding in NEXTDC Limited, Australia’s listed data-center operator, representing 36,750,320 ordinary shares and 5.09% voting power. The position follows NEXTDC’s recent equity issuance and capital plan to support accelerated data-center development.

cards.title: Americold North American Cold Storage JV | EQT
cards.target: Americold North American Cold Storage JV
cards.metadata: EQT (Joint Venture) · Cold Storage / Logistics · North America
cards.description: Americold and EQT formed a $1.3bn North American cold-storage joint venture backed by EQT’s Active Core Infrastructure fund. Americold will contribute 12 facilities totaling approximately 124mm cubic feet of temperature-controlled capacity and more than 400,000 pallet positions, with EQT acquiring a 70% interest and Americold retaining 30% and day-to-day management.

cards.title: Textainer / Seaco | Mubadala / Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Mubadala / Stonepeak (Co-Investment) · Container Leasing · Global
cards.description: Mubadala announced a $300mm co-investment alongside Stonepeak to support Textainer’s acquisition of Seaco. The investment backs the combination of two container leasing businesses and creates one of the world’s largest container leasing platforms, with the combined fleet serving shipping lines across global trade routes.

cards.title: Axius Water | KKR / XPV
cards.metadata: KKR / XPV (Sale) · Water Infrastructure · North America
cards.description: KKR and XPV Water Partners signed a definitive agreement to sell Axius Water to CRH. KKR and XPV formed Axius in 2019 to unify specialized nutrient-management and water-quality businesses, and the transaction provides CRH with a scaled platform in advanced water-quality solutions.

cards.title: bestUV | H2O Innovation / Ember Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Ember Infrastructure (Portfolio Company Bolt-On) · Water Treatment · Netherlands
cards.description: H2O Innovation, an Ember Infrastructure portfolio company, acquired bestUV, a Dutch manufacturer of ultraviolet water-disinfection systems. The bolt-on expands H2O Innovation into UV disinfection and adds proprietary reactors serving municipal, industrial, maritime, and other water-treatment applications.

cards.title: Siruai Wind and Storage Project | Meridiam
cards.metadata: Meridiam (Platform Launch) · Wind + Battery Storage · Kenya
cards.description: Meridiam and Craftskills Energy launched the Siruai Wind and Storage project in Kenya, combining 100 MW of wind generation with a 50 MWh battery energy storage system. The project is located near the Kipeto wind farm in Kajiado County and is backed by more than EUR200mm of investment.

cards.title: Hornsea 3 Offshore Wind Farm | Apollo
cards.metadata: Apollo (Minority Stake) · Offshore Wind · United Kingdom
cards.description: Mubadala announced a US$325mm investment in Ørsted's Hornsea 3 offshore wind farm alongside a consortium led by Apollo-managed funds. Hornsea 3 is expected to deliver 2.9 GW of capacity off the Norfolk coast in the United Kingdom, with Ørsted retaining 50% ownership and leading development, construction and operation.

cards.title: 187 MW Taiwan Solar Portfolio | GIP
cards.metadata: GIP (Sale - Buyout) · Solar · Taiwan
cards.description: J&V Energy agreed to acquire a 187 MW operational solar portfolio in Taiwan from a fund managed by Global Infrastructure Partners, part of BlackRock. The operating portfolio expands J&V Energy's renewable power platform in Taiwan.

cards.title: Kao Data Park Royal Site | Infratil
cards.metadata: Infratil (Bolt-On) · Data Centers · United Kingdom
cards.description: Kao Data acquired a 4.7-acre brownfield site on the former Frogmore Industrial Estate in Park Royal, West London, from ReAssure Limited for a planned data center development. The facility is expected to support AI and advanced computing workloads and go live in 2029, subject to planning.

cards.title: QScale | GSAM
cards.metadata: GSAM (Buyout) · Data Centers · Canada
cards.description: Infrastructure at Goldman Sachs Alternatives closed the acquisition of QScale, a Canadian developer and operator of next-generation, AI-ready data centers. QScale's founders and management are reinvesting alongside Goldman Sachs Alternatives and will continue to lead the business.

cards.title: BMO Transportation and Vendor Finance | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak (Buyout) · Transportation Asset Finance · United States / Canada
cards.description: Stonepeak reached an agreement to acquire BMO's Transportation Finance and Vendor Finance businesses, including related loan portfolios in the United States and Canada. BMO will reinvest for a 19.9% minority interest, while the platform continues to provide financing for trucks, trailers and other transportation and vendor equipment.

cards.title: R.E.L.A.M. | Basalt
cards.metadata: Basalt (Buyout) · Rail Equipment Leasing · United States / Canada
cards.description: Funds advised by Basalt Infrastructure Partners agreed to acquire R.E.L.A.M., a North American lessor of maintenance-of-way and hi-rail equipment, from Paceline Equity Partners. The company operates a scaled fleet of specialized rail maintenance assets serving railroads, contractors and other rail infrastructure operators.

cards.title: Corporate Air | Igneo
cards.metadata: Igneo (Bolt-On) · Aviation FBO · United States
cards.description: Infinity Aviation Group acquired Corporate Air at Vero Beach Regional Airport in Florida, expanding its fixed-base-operator network into South Florida. The facility includes eight hangars, a large ramp area, a passenger terminal and on-site customs clearance.

cards.title: Dysons | TPG / Foresight
cards.metadata: TPG / Foresight (Bolt-On) · Bus Transit · Australia
cards.description: Kinetic entered into an agreement to acquire 100% of Dysons, an Australian bus and coach operator serving Victoria and New South Wales. The transaction expands Kinetic's bus network and zero-emissions transport strategy and is expected to complete in the second half of 2026 subject to approvals.
