cards.title: International Aerospace Coatings | H.I.G. / Tiger
cards.metadata: H.I.G. / Tiger (Buyout / Sale - Buyout) · Aviation Services · United States / Ireland
cards.description: H.I.G. Capital completed the acquisition of International Aerospace Coatings from Tiger Infrastructure Partners. IAC provides aircraft painting and aviation technical services from a global footprint of 25 hangars across 11 sites in the United States and Europe.

cards.title: Terrafame Sotkamo Electrical Grid Assets | Equitix
cards.metadata: Equitix (Bolt-On) · Industrial Power Networks · Finland
cards.description: Aurora Infrastructure entered into a strategic partnership with Terrafame by acquiring the high- and medium-voltage electrical grid assets at Terrafame's Sotkamo industrial site in Finland. The transaction is structured as a buy-and-lease-back arrangement supporting industrial-site power infrastructure.

cards.title: Verene Energia S.A. | La Caisse
cards.metadata: La Caisse (Joint Venture) · Power Transmission · Brazil
cards.description: La Caisse and Grupo Energía Bogotá entered into a final agreement to create a jointly controlled 50/50 power transmission platform in Brazil under the Verene Energia S.A. name. The combined platform will include 26 electric transmission concessions and more than 9,000 km of transmission lines across 17 Brazilian states.

cards.title: Caturus / Commonwealth LNG | Ares
cards.metadata: Ares (Platform Launch) · LNG Export · United States
cards.description: Caturus made a positive final investment decision for the Commonwealth LNG project in Louisiana, including the successful closing of $9.75bn in project financing for a 9.5 mtpa LNG export facility. Mubadala Energy is an equity participant, CPP Investments is increasing its stake, and major financial partners include an Ares Infrastructure Opportunities fund.

cards.title: Noble Environmental | Apollo
cards.metadata: Apollo (Majority Stake) · Waste / Renewable Natural Gas · United States
cards.description: Apollo-managed funds acquired a majority interest in Noble Environmental, a vertically integrated waste-management platform headquartered in Pittsburgh. Noble provides waste collection, hauling, transfer and disposal services and operates renewable natural gas facilities at landfill gas locations.

cards.title: Casa dos Ventos Renewable-Power Assets | Patria
cards.metadata: Patria / Omnia (Joint Venture) · Renewable Power / Data Center Energy · Brazil
cards.description: Omnia, Patria's data center platform, signed a $2bn, 20-year renewable energy supply agreement with Casa dos Ventos to power its Pecem data center for ByteDance. The self-production structure gives Omnia a stake in wind assets including the 630 MW Ibiapaba complex, tying renewable generation to a large hyperscale development.

cards.title: North Star Renewable Energy Platform | CIP
cards.metadata: CIP (Platform Launch) · Solar / Wind / Storage · India
cards.description: CIP and British International Investment launched North Star, a $300mm India renewables platform with each party committing up to $150mm. The platform will invest in solar, wind, hybrid renewable and storage projects, addressing development-capital bottlenecks in India's clean-power buildout.

cards.title: FirstLight U.S. Clean-Power Portfolio | PSP Investments
cards.metadata: PSP Investments (Sale) · Hydro / Storage / Renewables · United States
cards.description: PSP agreed to sell FirstLight's U.S. operations to Hull Street Energy. The portfolio includes about 1.4 GW of hydroelectric generation, energy storage and renewable assets in Massachusetts, Connecticut and Pennsylvania, while PSP retains FirstLight's Canadian platform.

cards.title: Birdseye Battery Storage Project | GSAM
cards.metadata: GSAM (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Battery Storage · United States
cards.description: GridStor acquired the 199 MW / 796 MWh Birdseye battery energy storage project in Adams County, Colorado from Accelergen. Backed by GSAM, GridStor expects construction as early as 2027 and commercial operations by the end of 2028.

cards.title: 132 MW Saxony Onshore Wind Portfolio | Ardian
cards.metadata: Ardian (Buyout) · Onshore Wind · Germany
cards.description: Ardian Clean Energy Evergreen Fund acquired a greenfield onshore wind project portfolio in Saxony totaling 132 MW once constructed. The deal is ACEEF's first German investment and anchors a broader renewables platform in Europe's largest renewable-energy market.

cards.title: Barrow Green Hydrogen Project | Schroders Greencoat
cards.metadata: Schroders Greencoat (Joint Venture) · Green Hydrogen · United Kingdom
cards.description: Schroders Greencoat and Carlton Power reached FID through GHECO for the 30 MW Barrow Green Hydrogen Project in Cumbria. The project will use Plug electrolyzers to supply industrial green hydrogen to Kimberly-Clark and is one of the first UK renewable hydrogen projects to reach FID.

cards.title: APF Energy | Schroders Greencoat
cards.metadata: Schroders Greencoat (Buyout) · Biomethane · Netherlands
cards.description: Schroders Greencoat acquired 100% of APF Energy from SWEN Capital Partners' impact strategy and APF BV. APF is a Dutch biomethane platform producing renewable gas from agricultural manure and food by-products, with assets positioned for the renewable-molecules market.

cards.title: Lind Marine | Tallvine Partners
cards.metadata: Tallvine (Buyout) · Marine Infrastructure Services · United States
cards.description: Tallvine acquired Lind Marine, expanding its North American marine infrastructure platform to the West Coast following its Donjon Marine acquisition. Lind provides dredging, towing, salvage, shipyard, environmental remediation and harbor and waterway services from its Mare Island base in the San Francisco Bay.

cards.title: Equans Infra & Mobility / Velian | DigitalBridge / InfraBridge / Aberdeen
cards.metadata: DigitalBridge / InfraBridge / Aberdeen (Buyout) · EV Charging / E-Mobility · Netherlands
cards.description: A DigitalBridge-controlled vehicle and Aberdeen Investments acquired Equans' Dutch asset-based e-mobility activities, which will operate as Velian. The platform designs, finances, builds and operates public and private EV charging infrastructure for government, real estate and logistics customers in the Netherlands.

cards.title: Cube Grid | I Squared Capital
cards.metadata: I Squared (Platform Launch) · Power Transmission · India
cards.description: I Squared launched Cube Grid, a power transmission platform in India, with plans to deploy up to $1bn of equity capital. The platform has signed definitive agreements for seed assets totaling more than 1,450 circuit kilometers of transmission lines alongside Dineshchandra Group.

cards.title: Kalmar Energi 50% Stake | Igneo
cards.metadata: Igneo / Nordion Energi (Buyout) · Electricity Grids / District Heating · Sweden
cards.description: Nordion Energi, owned by EDIF II and managed by Igneo, signed an agreement to acquire E.ON Sverige's 50% stake in Kalmar Energi. The integrated utility operates across electricity grids, district heating and fiber, with Kalmar Municipality continuing as joint owner.

cards.title: Seraya Partners Fund I Interest | GenZero
cards.metadata: GenZero / Temasek (Secondaries) · Energy Transition / Digital Infrastructure · Asia-Pacific
cards.description: GenZero acquired a secondary interest in Seraya Partners Fund I from AIIB, gaining exposure to an Asia-focused infrastructure fund targeting energy transition and digital infrastructure. The portfolio includes Cyan Renewables, a marine energy-transition operator, and Empyrion Digital, a pan-Asia low-carbon data center platform.

cards.title: Exolum | OMERS Infrastructure
cards.metadata: OMERS Infrastructure (Sale) · Energy Logistics · Europe
cards.description: OMERS agreed to sell its roughly 25% stake in Exolum, with Stoneshield Capital acquiring 15% and another global investor buying the remaining 10%. Exolum operates refined-products and aviation-fuel logistics infrastructure, including pipeline networks in Spain and the UK, 68 storage terminals and service to more than 48 airports.

cards.title: Information Services Corporation | La Caisse
cards.metadata: La Caisse / Plenary Americas (Buyout) · Public Registry Services · Canada
cards.description: Plenary Americas signed an all-cash arrangement agreement to acquire Information Services Corporation for C$51.00 per share, valuing ISC at about C$1.2bn enterprise value. ISC provides registry and information management services for public data and records, including land and business registry functions.

cards.title: Eixo SP Co-Investment | Patria
cards.metadata: Patria (Co-Investment) · Road Concession · Brazil
cards.description: Patria concluded an R$1.19bn asset-specific co-investment for Eixo SP, with Silk Road Fund as the sole investor and capital routed through a co-investment vehicle linked to Patria Infraestrutura IV. Eixo SP operates a 1,273 km Sao Paulo road concession spanning 12 highways and 62 municipalities, with a 30-year concession and R$14bn investment plan.

cards.title: Maple Infrastructure Trust Units | Macquarie Asset Management / La Caisse
cards.metadata: Macquarie Asset Management / La Caisse (Secondary Acquisition) · Road InvIT · India
cards.description: Macquarie Asset Management’s MAIF 4 vehicle agreed to acquire up to 177,289,950 Maple Infrastructure Trust units, alongside related Maple IM and Maple PM equity interests, from La Caisse’s CDPQ Infrastructures Asia III. Maple owns and operates Indian road assets through government concessions, giving the transaction a direct roads-infrastructure exposure.

cards.title: Voltera / Revel Combined EV Charging Platform | EQT Infrastructure / GIP
cards.target: Voltera / Revel Combined EV Charging Platform
cards.metadata: EQT Infrastructure / GIP (Business Combination) · EV Charging / E-Mobility · United States
cards.description: EQT-backed Voltera and GIP-backed Revel entered into a definitive agreement to combine their businesses into an urban fast-charging infrastructure platform. The combined company is expected to include more than 1,000 charging stalls operational and under development across 11 major U.S. metro markets, with EQT as majority owner and GIP retaining a minority stake.

cards.title: Five Indian Road SPVs | Actis
cards.metadata: Actis (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Roads / Toll Bridge · India
cards.description: Nxt-Infra Trust’s investment manager approved execution of securities purchase agreements covering shareholdings and beneficial ownership in Darah Jhalawar Highways, Vadodara Kim Expressway, Calicut Expressway, Vindhyachal Expressway, and Second Vivekananda Bridge Tollway. The assets add a five-asset roads and bridge package to the Actis-sponsored long-life infrastructure vehicle.

cards.title: 76 MWp Uruguay Solar Portfolio | Ardian
cards.metadata: Ardian (Buyout) · Solar · Uruguay
cards.description: Ardian Clean Energy Evergreen Fund acquired two operating solar PV plants in Uruguay with a combined capacity of 76 MWp. The assets mark ACEEF’s entry into Uruguay and expand Ardian’s Latin American renewable-power footprint, with AGR-AM managing the portfolio.

cards.title: Stoneworthy BESS Project | Equitix
cards.metadata: Equitix (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Battery Storage · United Kingdom
cards.description: Eelpower Energy, the Equitix-led battery-storage platform backed with Aware Super and the UK National Wealth Fund, acquired the 50 MW / 100 MWh Stoneworthy BESS project in Devon from RES. Construction is slated to begin in 2027, with commercial operations planned for 2028.

cards.title: Cogent Fiber Data Center Portfolio | I Squared Capital
cards.metadata: I Squared Capital (Buyout) · Data Centers · United States
cards.description: I Squared Capital entered into a definitive purchase and sale agreement to acquire ten data center facilities from Cogent Fiber for $225mm in cash. The 53 MW, 259,000-square-foot seed portfolio spans nine U.S. markets and anchors a new AI inference and edge colocation platform, with I Squared committing up to $1bn for expansion and follow-on acquisitions.

cards.title: Lexington Data Center Campus | NOVA Infrastructure
cards.metadata: NOVA Infrastructure (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Data Centers · United States
cards.description: NOVA-backed DartPoints acquired a Lexington, Kentucky data center campus spanning approximately 343,000 square feet on 29.5 acres, including about 81,000 square feet of existing raised-floor data center space and an owned on-site substation. The campus has a 20-30 MW initial path and longer-term expansion potential to 70 MW for AI, neo-cloud, hyperscale, and enterprise workloads.

cards.title: Naturgy Energy Group | CVC
cards.metadata: CVC (Sale) · Integrated Gas / Power Utility · Spain
cards.description: CVC sold its entire 13.8% stake in Naturgy Energy Group through an accelerated bookbuild and related derivative settlement. The exit covered a Spanish integrated gas and power utility stake worth around €4bn at prevailing market prices and followed GIP / BlackRock’s earlier full exit from Naturgy.

cards.title: Estia Health | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak (Majority Stake) · Residential Aged Care · Australia
cards.description: A Stonepeak-led consortium agreed to acquire a majority stake in Estia Health from Bain Capital, extending Stonepeak’s Volarae Living social-infrastructure platform in Australia and New Zealand. Estia is one of Australia’s largest residential aged-care operators, with more than 90 homes across four states and approximately 9,000 residents.

cards.title: Vena Energy India | Global Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Global Infrastructure Partners / Vena Group (Portfolio Company Divestiture) · Renewable Power / Battery Storage · India
cards.description: Vena Group entered into a definitive agreement to sell 100% of Vena Energy India Holdings to Inox Clean Energy. The India platform includes 5.4 GW of solar and wind assets and a 2.5 GWh BESS renewable-energy pipeline tied to GIP III's original infrastructure acquisition of Equis Energy.

cards.title: Pathway Power | Igneo Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Igneo Infrastructure Partners (Preferred Equity Investment) · Renewable Power / Battery Storage · United States
cards.description: Igneo completed a preferred equity investment in Pathway Power, a U.S. utility-scale renewable and storage development platform. Pathway has assembled more than 1 GW of projects expected to begin construction in 2026-2027, plus approximately 1,000 MW of early-stage hybrid interconnection positions across SPP and MISO.

cards.title: Enderby Battery Storage Project | EIG
cards.metadata: EIG / Fidra Energy (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Battery Storage · United Kingdom
cards.description: EIG-backed Fidra Energy acquired the Enderby battery storage project from Innova. The Leicestershire project is expected to deliver up to 1,025 MW once operational and increases Fidra's UK BESS pipeline to more than 4 GW.

cards.title: Mountain Peak / Canyon Peak Power | Blackstone
cards.metadata: Blackstone (Sale) · Gas-Fired Power · United States
cards.description: TransAlta signed a purchase and sale agreement to acquire Mountain Peak Power and Canyon Peak Power from indirect subsidiaries of Blackstone. The transaction covers two fully contracted gas-fired peaking facilities in Colorado, adding dispatchable power capacity under existing contracts.

cards.title: ACME Solar Holdings | ADIA
cards.metadata: ADIA (Primary Capital Raise / QIP) · Utility-Scale Solar · India
cards.description: ACME Solar completed an INR 2,800 crore qualified institutional placement with ADIA named among participating investors. ACME develops, owns, operates, and maintains utility-scale renewable-energy projects across India.

cards.title: GS Power Community Solar Portfolio | CVC DIF
cards.metadata: CVC DIF / GS Power Partners (Tax Equity Financing) · Community Solar · United States
cards.description: CVC DIF-backed GS Power Partners secured $51mm of tax equity financing for a 41 MWdc community solar portfolio across New York, Maryland, and Illinois. The portfolio-company financing close adds equity capital to distributed solar infrastructure within DIF Infrastructure VII lineage.

cards.title: Broadway Proper | Harrison Street
cards.metadata: Harrison Street (Sale) · Senior Living · United States
cards.description: Harrison Street sold Broadway Proper, a 232-unit independent and assisted living community in Tucson, Arizona. Berkadia announced the completed sale during the target period, marking a realized social-infrastructure exit rather than a financing transaction.

cards.title: Teleconsult and Meditecs | EQT Infrastructure
cards.metadata: EQT Infrastructure / Evidia (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Healthcare Diagnostics · Europe
cards.description: EQT Infrastructure-backed Evidia acquired Teleconsult and Meditecs as bolt-ons to its diagnostic imaging and radiology services platform. Evidia traces to EQT Infrastructure Fund V, and the acquisitions expand healthcare-services infrastructure in Europe.

cards.title: LineoX | Asterion Industrial Partners
cards.metadata: Asterion Industrial Partners / Axion (Sale) · Rural Microwave Backhaul · Spain
cards.description: Telefonica reached an agreement to acquire LineoX, a rural microwave backhauling platform, from Asterion-backed Axion / LineoX. The transaction traces to Asterion Industrial Infra Fund I and adds digital connectivity infrastructure to Telefonica's rural network footprint.

cards.title: CLI | Macquarie Asset Management
cards.metadata: Macquarie Asset Management / MIP V (Sale) · Port / Logistics Infrastructure · Brazil
cards.description: Macquarie Asset Management and IG4 signed a definitive agreement to sell a controlling stake in CLI - Corredor Logistica e Infraestrutura S.A. to AD Ports Group. The transaction values the Brazilian infrastructure and logistics operator at approximately US$835mm.

cards.title: Delfin FLNG 1 | Global Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Global Infrastructure Partners (Growth Investment / Project JV Equity Commitment) · LNG Export / FLNG · United States
cards.description: Delfin Midstream announced a $5bn final investment decision for Delfin FLNG 1, the first offshore LNG export facility in the United States. GIP, part of BlackRock, led the investor group committing equity alongside Vitol and other partners for the first phase of the project.
cards.transactionType: Growth Investment / Project JV Equity Commitment

cards.title: Mitsubishi HC Capital / Brookfield Renewables Platform | Brookfield Asset Management
cards.target: Mitsubishi HC Capital / Brookfield Renewables Platform
cards.metadata: Brookfield Asset Management (Joint Venture) · Renewable Power · Europe
cards.description: Brookfield and Mitsubishi HC Capital launched a renewable-energy company seeded with 570 MW of contracted European wind and solar assets. Brookfield will operate the platform alongside Mitsubishi HC Capital, with the transaction carrying an initial equity value of approximately €400mm.

cards.title: Vietnam Renewable Energy Partnership | Brookfield Asset Management
cards.metadata: Brookfield Asset Management (Joint Venture / Strategic Partnership) · Wind / Solar / Battery Storage · Vietnam
cards.description: Brookfield and Foxconn formed a renewable-energy partnership in Vietnam targeting up to 1 GW of wind, solar, and battery storage. The platform is intended to support power supply for Foxconn and broader industrial customers as Vietnam adds contracted clean-power capacity.

cards.title: Repsol Spanish Renewables Portfolio | Mubadala
cards.metadata: Mubadala / Masdar (Minority Stake) · Renewable Power · Spain
cards.description: Masdar agreed to acquire a 49.99% stake in a 705 MW operating Spanish renewables portfolio from Repsol. The transaction creates a partnership around mature wind and solar assets and links Mubadala through Masdar ownership lineage.

cards.title: Devilla BESS Project | Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (Minority Stake Sale) · Battery Storage · United Kingdom
cards.description: CIP agreed to sell minority stakes in the 500 MW Devilla battery energy storage project to Scottish National Investment Bank and Nuclear Liabilities Fund. CIP remains the majority owner through Copenhagen Infrastructure IV while recycling capital into a large-scale UK storage project.

cards.title: Illinois Community Solar Portfolio | EQT Infrastructure
cards.metadata: EQT Infrastructure / Cypress Creek Renewables (Portfolio Company Divestiture) · Community Solar · United States
cards.description: EQT-backed Cypress Creek Renewables sold a 104 MW Illinois community solar portfolio to 38 Degrees North. The portfolio comprises 16 projects across 14 counties and reflects continued sponsor portfolio rotation in distributed solar assets.

cards.title: SK Group Renewable Energy JV | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR (Joint Venture / Business Transfer) · Renewable Power · South Korea
cards.description: SK and KKR signed a renewable-energy business transfer agreement covering solar and wind assets, with KKR expected to participate through asset acquisitions and capital contributions into an integrated renewable-energy entity. The deal adds sponsor capital to a Korean renewable platform with operating and development exposure.

cards.title: Groupe Santé Sedna | Axium Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Axium Infrastructure (Equity Investment / Strategic Partnership) · Healthcare Services · Canada
cards.description: An Axium-managed fund made a new equity investment in Groupe Santé Sedna, a Canadian healthcare and social-services platform. Advisor materials identified a June 11 closing, and the transaction was treated as in-period despite a prior Competition Bureau reference.

cards.title: Dauntless Air | Ridgewood Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Ridgewood Infrastructure (Acquisition) · Emergency Management / Wildfire Response · United States
cards.description: Ridgewood Infrastructure acquired Dauntless Air, a provider of emergency-management infrastructure for wildfire response. The business supports aerial firefighting and mission-critical public-safety operations across North America.

cards.title: Navitas Credit Corp. | Wafra
cards.metadata: Wafra (Acquisition / Definitive Agreement) · Infrastructure Services / Equipment Finance · United States
cards.description: Wafra announced a definitive agreement to acquire Navitas Credit Corp., an equipment finance business. Navitas provides equipment financing to small and mid-sized businesses through vendor programs, strategic partnerships, and direct origination channels.

cards.title: Helix Digital Infrastructure | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR (Platform Launch / Anchor Equity Capitalization) · AI Infrastructure / Data Centers · North America
cards.description: KKR launched Helix Digital Infrastructure with partners as a new company to finance and deliver AI infrastructure. The platform announced more than $10bn of commitments targeting data centers, power, transmission and distribution, fiber, and connectivity assets.

cards.title: Ansan Data Center Site / SEL5 | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak / Digital Edge (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Data Center Site · South Korea
cards.description: Stonepeak-backed Digital Edge secured a fully powered land parcel in Ansan, South Korea for its planned SEL5 data center. The site supports a 60 MW development in a power-constrained market and expands Digital Edge’s Seoul-area data-center pipeline.

cards.title: A25 Concession | La Caisse
cards.metadata: La Caisse (Acquisition) · Toll Road / Bridge Concession · Canada
cards.description: La Caisse agreed to acquire Transurban’s remaining 50% interest in the A25 Concession, increasing its ownership from 50% to 100%. The Montreal-area asset includes toll road and bridge infrastructure under a long-term concession framework.

cards.title: University of Kentucky Central Utility Plant | La Caisse
cards.target: University of Kentucky Central Utility Plant
cards.metadata: La Caisse / Plenary Americas (P3 Financial Close) · Campus Utility Infrastructure · United States
cards.description: Kentucky Infrastructure Partners reached financial close on the University of Kentucky Central Utility Plant P3 project. The deal includes sponsor equity alongside bond financing and is linked to La Caisse through Plenary Americas infrastructure-platform lineage.

cards.title: Anwim / MOYA Fuel Station Network | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak / Energy Equation Partners (Acquisition) · Fuel Distribution / Logistics · Poland
cards.description: Stonepeak and Energy Equation Partners agreed to acquire Anwim, operator of the MOYA fuel station network in Poland. The transaction gives Stonepeak direct exposure to fuel distribution and logistics infrastructure with a national retail and wholesale platform.

cards.title: Altavair Aircraft Leasing Portfolio | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR (Growth Investment / Platform Expansion) · Aircraft Leasing · Global / United States
cards.description: KKR committed US$1.4bn of equity to continue expanding its global leased commercial aircraft portfolio with Altavair. The new commitment builds on two prior aircraft leasing portfolios and is expected to be funded primarily through KKR's Infrastructure and Asset-Based Finance strategies.

cards.title: LOGISTEC Marine Terminal Division | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Marine Terminals · North America
cards.description: Stonepeak-backed Enstructure agreed to acquire LOGISTEC's marine terminal operations from Blue Wolf Capital Partners. The combination will create a North American terminal network spanning LOGISTEC, Gulf Stream Marine, and LOGISTEC Direct assets serving major trade corridors and industrial markets.

cards.title: Electrada Assets | Macquarie Asset Management
cards.metadata: Macquarie Asset Management (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Fleet Electrification / Charging · United States
cards.description: Macquarie-backed Inspiration Mobility Group acquired select assets of Electrada, adding fleet electrification technology, charging infrastructure development capabilities, and an experienced team to its Inspiration Energy platform. The acquisition expands Inspiration's end-to-end electric fuel solution for commercial fleets.

cards.title: Kinship Marina Ventura | Wafra
cards.metadata: Wafra (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Marina Infrastructure · United States
cards.description: Wafra-backed Suntex Marinas acquired Kinship Marina in Ventura, California, expanding its West Coast marina footprint. The coastal asset adds wet slips, dry storage, on-site service partnerships, and access to the Channel Islands boating market.

cards.title: Beatrice Offshore Wind Farm | Equitix / InfraRed Capital Partners
cards.metadata: Equitix / InfraRed Capital Partners (Minority Stake Acquisition / Divestiture) · Offshore Wind · United Kingdom
cards.description: The Renewables Infrastructure Group received a binding offer to sell its full 17.5% stake in the 588 MW Beatrice offshore wind farm to funds managed by Equitix for approximately £155mm. The transaction recycles capital from a mature Scottish offshore wind asset and is expected to reduce TRIG's revolving credit facility drawings.

cards.title: Greenlink Interconnector | Mubadala
cards.metadata: Mubadala (Minority Stake) · Power Transmission · United Kingdom / Ireland
cards.description: Mubadala acquired US$200mm of Equitix's stake in Greenlink, the 504 MW subsea electricity interconnector linking Great Britain and Ireland. The regulated HVDC asset spans approximately 190 km and supports cross-border power flows, renewables integration, and system flexibility.

cards.title: Inkia Energy | I Squared Capital
cards.metadata: I Squared Capital (Co-Investment) · Power Generation · Peru
cards.description: ALTERRA entered a co-investment in Inkia Energy alongside I Squared Capital through an I Squared-managed continuation vehicle. Inkia is Peru's largest independent power producer, operating 2.6 GW of generation capacity and supporting a 4 GW renewables pipeline, including approximately 1 GW of near-term solar and wind projects.

cards.title: CtrlS Datacenters | CPP Investments
cards.metadata: CPP Investments (Minority Stake / Joint Venture) · Data Centers · India
cards.description: CPP Investments committed up to C$1bn to CtrlS Datacenters, including INR 40bn, or approximately C$588mm, to acquire an 8.2% stake in the company. The partnership also includes a 48% CPP Investments interest in a new platform to develop hyperscale data center campuses across India.

cards.title: Transcend Towers Infrastructure | BCI
cards.metadata: BCI (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Telecom Towers · Philippines
cards.description: BCI-backed Frontier Towers completed its acquisition of American Tower's Philippine tower portfolio through Transcend Towers Infrastructure. The transaction adds approximately 400 towers and expands Frontier's nationwide footprint to more than 6,500 sites.

cards.title: KAPS Pipeline System | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak (Divestiture / Exit) · NGL Pipeline · Canada
cards.description: Keyera acquired Stonepeak's remaining 50% non-operating interest in the KAPS Pipeline System for C$1.215bn. KAPS is a natural gas liquids pipeline system connecting Montney and Duvernay production to downstream markets, and Keyera now owns 100% of the asset.

cards.title: Pinnacle Gas Services | Sixth Street
cards.metadata: Sixth Street (Minority Stake) · Natural Gas Gathering & Treating · United States
cards.description: Sixth Street invested US$600mm for a 27% minority equity interest in Comstock Resources' midstream subsidiary Pinnacle Gas Services. Pinnacle owns and operates natural gas gathering and treating systems supporting Comstock's Western Haynesville development.

cards.title: ThamesWey Central Milton Keynes | Ancala Partners
cards.metadata: Ancala Partners (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · District Heating / Electricity Network · United Kingdom
cards.description: Ancala-backed Leep Utilities acquired ThamesWey Central Milton Keynes from ThamesWey Energy. TCMK provides district heating and private-wire electricity network services to domestic and business customers in central Milton Keynes, including mixed-use developments and office assets.

cards.title: Waste Eliminator / Liberty Waste Solutions | TPG
cards.metadata: TPG (Buyout / Platform Acquisition) · Waste Infrastructure · United States
cards.description: TPG signed definitive agreements to acquire Waste Eliminator and Liberty Waste Solutions from Allied Industrial Partners through TPG Transition Infrastructure. The combination is expected to serve commercial, industrial, municipal, and residential customers across the Southeastern U.S. with 14 permitted facilities and more than 500 fleet vehicles.

cards.title: EDF Power Solutions U.S. and Canada operations | KKR
cards.target: EDF Power Solutions U.S. and Canada operations
cards.metadata: KKR (Acquisition) · Renewable Power / Storage / EV Charging · United States / Canada
cards.description: EDF signed an agreement for KKR to acquire EDF Power Solutions assets and operations in the U.S. and Canada, including renewable power, storage, EV charging, and microgrid activities. The transaction gives KKR a scaled North American clean power operating platform.

cards.title: Tormes Solar and Alamo BESS projects | TPG
cards.target: Tormes Solar and Alamo BESS projects
cards.metadata: TPG (Preferred Equity / Project-Level Minority Equity Investment) · Solar / Battery Storage · United States
cards.description: TPG-backed Matrix Renewables secured a $210mm preferred equity commitment from DESRI for the Tormes Solar and Alamo BESS construction portfolio. The financing supports U.S. solar and battery storage development through an existing renewable infrastructure platform.
cards.transactionType: Preferred Equity / Project-Level Minority Equity Investment

cards.title: Terra-Gen | Igneo Infrastructure Partners / Pantheon
cards.metadata: Igneo / Pantheon (Co-Investment) · Renewables Platform · United States
cards.description: Pantheon Infrastructure committed approximately $55mm to Terra-Gen through an Igneo-managed co-investment vehicle. Terra-Gen owns and develops utility-scale wind, solar, and battery storage assets across the U.S. power market.

cards.title: Gennaker offshore wind project | BlackRock / GIP
cards.metadata: BlackRock / GIP (Minority Stake Sale) · Offshore Wind · Germany
cards.description: Skyborn Renewables agreed to sell Stadtwerke München a 25% equity interest in the Gennaker offshore wind project. Skyborn is a GIP infrastructure portfolio company within BlackRock’s infrastructure platform, and Gennaker is positioned as a major German Baltic Sea offshore wind development.

cards.title: Yarnton BESS | Schroders Greencoat
cards.metadata: Schroders Greencoat (Asset Acquisition) · Battery Storage · United Kingdom
cards.description: A Schroders Greencoat / Wessex Gardens renewable infrastructure fund acquired the 50 MW Yarnton battery energy storage system in Oxfordshire from Rivington Energy. The transaction adds a grid-scale storage asset in a constrained UK power market.

cards.title: Gresham House UK solar portfolio | True Green Capital Management
cards.metadata: True Green Capital Management (Operating Asset Acquisition) · Solar · United Kingdom
cards.description: A UK entity managed by True Green Capital acquired a 20.3 MWdc operating solar portfolio from Gresham House Renewable Energy VCT 1 and VCT 2. The portfolio adds contracted operating solar assets to True Green’s European distributed generation footprint.

cards.title: TerraWind / Sym Energy Miyazaki wind JV | Stonepeak
cards.target: TerraWind / Sym Energy Miyazaki wind JV
cards.metadata: Stonepeak (Joint Venture via Portfolio Company) · Onshore Wind · Japan
cards.description: Stonepeak-backed TerraWind Renewables formed a jointly owned special purpose company with Sym Energy for wind development in Miyazaki, Japan. TerraWind is an onshore wind platform in which Stonepeak holds an 80% interest.

cards.title: Specialist Fleet Services | Astatine Investment Partners
cards.metadata: Astatine Investment Partners (Bolt-On) · Fleet Services · United Kingdom
cards.description: Astatine-backed NRG Riverside / NRG Fleet Services agreed to acquire the entire issued share capital of Specialist Fleet Services from Paragon Banking Group. SFS adds specialist contract hire, fleet management, and municipal fleet capabilities to NRG Riverside’s UK platform.

cards.title: Integmar Marine Technologies | Antin Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Antin Infrastructure Partners (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Marine Safety Technology · Türkiye
cards.description: Antin-backed Consilium Safety Group acquired Integmar Marine Technologies, expanding its presence in Türkiye and its marine safety technology offering. Consilium was acquired by an Antin Flagship Fund V affiliate, bringing the bolt-on into an infrastructure-backed safety platform.

cards.title: Southern Water | Asterion Industrial Partners / Macquarie Asset Management
cards.sponsor: Asterion Industrial Partners / Macquarie Asset Management
cards.metadata: Asterion / Macquarie (Minority Stake) · Regulated Water Utility · United Kingdom
cards.description: Asterion joined a Macquarie-led consortium committing £1.2bn of equity support to Southern Water, including Asterion’s approximately £300mm commitment for an approximately 20% minority shareholding. The transaction supports a regulated UK water and wastewater utility’s investment programme.

cards.title: Amprion indirect stake | Swiss Life Asset Managers
cards.metadata: Swiss Life Asset Managers (Sale) · Electricity Transmission · Germany
cards.description: Swiss Life Asset Managers signed an agreement to sell an indirect stake in Amprion, one of Germany’s major electricity transmission system operators. The sale recycles capital from a regulated power transmission asset held through the manager’s infrastructure platform.

cards.title: Eurofiber Netz Berlin | Antin Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Antin Infrastructure Partners (Portfolio Company Divestiture) · Fiber-to-the-Home · Germany
cards.description: Antin-backed Eurofiber sold Eurofiber Netz GmbH in Berlin to MIH Group, effective June 22, 2026. The business develops and operates fiber-to-the-home infrastructure in the Berlin metropolitan area with more than 150,000 homes passed.

cards.title: Roseton Generating Facility | Partners Group
cards.metadata: Partners Group / PowerTransitions (Add-On Acquisition) · Power Generation · United States
cards.description: Partners Group-backed PowerTransitions agreed to acquire the 1,242 MW Roseton Generating Facility in New York. The add-on expands the platform's operating power-generation footprint in a capacity-constrained U.S. market.

cards.title: Greenlight Electricity Centre | Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: MSIP / Pembina / Kineticor (Ownership Interest / Growth Equity) · Power Generation · Canada
cards.description: Pembina, MSIP, and Kineticor reached FID on the 932 MW Greenlight Electricity Centre in Alberta. MSIP acquired OPTrust's 50% interest, taking a 47.5% project stake, with remaining costs funded partly through owner equity contributions.

cards.title: Dion BESS | Macquarie Asset Management
cards.metadata: Macquarie Asset Management / Eku Energy (Project Acquisition / Development Agreement) · Battery Storage · Germany
cards.description: Eku Energy announced its German market entry through acquisition and development rights for the 400 MW / 1,600 MWh Dion battery storage project in Lamspringe. Eku is owned by BCI and a Macquarie Asset Management-managed fund.

cards.title: SK / KKR Korea renewables platform | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR / SK (Platform Joint Venture) · Renewable Power · South Korea
cards.description: KKR and SK signed definitive agreements to establish a renewable-energy platform in South Korea. The investment is tied to KKR's Asia Pacific infrastructure strategy and targets power-transition assets in a high-demand market.

cards.title: Kallista Energy | APG / Ardian
cards.metadata: APG / PKZH / Ardian (Minority Stake Acquisition / Exit) · Renewables Platform · France
cards.description: APG, on behalf of its infrastructure pool and alongside PKZH, acquired Ardian's remaining 38% interest in Kallista Energy. The transaction moves a French onshore wind, solar, and battery-storage platform from Ardian ownership to APG-led control.

cards.title: Klara Renewables | Actis / CVC DIF
cards.metadata: Actis / CVC DIF (Platform Acquisition / Divestiture) · Onshore Wind / Solar / BESS · Poland
cards.description: Actis agreed to acquire Klara Renewables from CVC DIF, launching a Polish renewables platform anchored by 171 MW of operating onshore wind assets. The portfolio also carries solar PV and battery-storage hybridization potential.

cards.title: Nordergrunde offshore wind farm | Global Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: GIP / Skyborn Renewables (Add-On Acquisition) · Offshore Wind · Germany
cards.description: GIP-backed Skyborn Renewables agreed to acquire the remaining 70% equity interest in the Nordergrunde offshore wind farm. The transaction gives Skyborn full ownership of the German operating asset and deepens its offshore wind platform.

cards.title: Enersol solar portfolio | La Caisse / Equitix
cards.metadata: Velto Renewables / Equitix (Minority Stake Acquisition / Sale) · Solar PV · Spain
cards.description: La Caisse-backed Velto Renewables agreed to acquire Equitix's minority stake in the Enersol solar portfolio in Andalusia. The deal gives Velto full ownership of nine operating PV assets totaling 45 MWp.

cards.title: Cobirgy biogas plant | CIP
cards.metadata: CIP (Final Investment Decision) · Biomethane / Biogas · Spain
cards.description: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners took FID on Cobirgy through Advanced Bioenergy Fund I. The project adds large-scale Spanish biomethane and biogas infrastructure to CIP's energy-transition portfolio.

cards.title: EQT AI Infrastructure / EdgeConneX | CPP Investments
cards.metadata: CPP Investments / EQT (Strategic Equity Investment) · Data Centers · Global
cards.description: CPP Investments closed a US$1.75bn investment alongside EQT to support global digital infrastructure growth led by EdgeConneX. The transaction provides scaled equity backing for AI-driven data-center expansion.

cards.title: Northern Virginia data centers | Blackstone
cards.metadata: Blackstone / Digital Realty (Partial Equity Interest Sale) · Data Centers · United States
cards.description: Digital Realty agreed to purchase Blackstone-affiliated funds' blended 64% equity interest in three fully leased Northern Virginia data centers. The facilities represent 288 MW of IT capacity in the leading U.S. data-center market.

cards.title: ITG Inc. | Oaktree Capital
cards.metadata: ITG / Oaktree Capital (IPO) · Digital Infrastructure · United States
cards.description: Oaktree-backed ITG priced its U.S. IPO and began public trading on Nasdaq during the target week. The listing crystallizes public-market equity access for a digital infrastructure platform backed by Oaktree's power and infrastructure strategy.

cards.title: Lefdal Mine Datacenter | 3i Infrastructure
cards.metadata: 3i Infrastructure (Incremental Stake Acquisition) · Data Centers · Norway
cards.description: 3i Infrastructure agreed to acquire a further 23% stake in Lefdal Mine Datacenter alongside 3i-managed co-investors. LMD is an operating Norwegian data-center campus built around low-cost renewable power and cavern-based infrastructure.

cards.title: Nippon Gateway Infrastructure | DigitalBridge
cards.metadata: DigitalBridge / JEXI (Platform Formation) · Data Centers · Japan
cards.description: DigitalBridge and JEXI formed Nippon Gateway Infrastructure, a new Japanese colocation data-center platform. NGI launched with data-center assets acquired from NEC and is positioned for Japan's digital infrastructure demand.

cards.title: Kao Data | Infratil
cards.metadata: Siemens Financial Services / Kao Data (Minority Stake Sale) · Data Centers · United Kingdom
cards.description: Siemens Financial Services made a minority equity investment in Kao Data, the UK data-center platform backed by Infratil and Legal & General. The capital supports expansion of Kao's high-performance computing and AI-ready campus footprint.

cards.title: I-2SEA submarine cable system | I Squared Capital
cards.metadata: Lightstorm / Microsoft (Joint Venture) · Subsea Cable · India / Southeast Asia
cards.description: I Squared-backed Lightstorm signed a joint build agreement with Microsoft for the I-2SEA submarine cable system. The project adds new India-to-Southeast Asia subsea capacity for cloud, AI, and enterprise connectivity demand.

cards.title: Volta Data Centres | Ardian
cards.metadata: Ardian / Verne / Arcus (Portfolio Company Sale) · Data Centers · United Kingdom
cards.description: Ardian-backed Verne agreed to sell 100% of Volta Data Centres to Arcus European Infrastructure Fund 4. Volta operates a central London data center and gives Arcus an established urban colocation asset.

cards.title: Ubiquity Southern California fiber network | Brookfield / Generate Capital
cards.metadata: Intrepid Fiber / Ubiquity (Portfolio Company Acquisition / Divestiture) · Fiber · United States
cards.description: Brookfield Infrastructure-backed Intrepid Fiber Networks agreed to acquire Ubiquity's Southern California fiber network. The deal transfers FTTP network assets from Generate-backed Ubiquity to an active U.S. fiber expansion platform.

cards.title: UK passenger rolling stock platform | Partners Group
cards.metadata: Partners Group (Infrastructure Secondaries Investment) · Rail Rolling Stock · United Kingdom
cards.description: Partners Group made a co-lead infrastructure secondaries investment in a UK passenger rolling stock leasing platform. The platform comprises more than 1,500 vehicles contracted into the UK rail system.

cards.title: Ocean Yield | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR / A.P. Moller Holding (Sale) · Maritime Leasing · Norway / Global
cards.description: A.P. Moller Holding agreed to acquire 100% of Ocean Yield from KKR-managed funds. Ocean Yield owns maritime infrastructure assets under long-term charters, making the sale a full exit from KKR's shipping-infrastructure platform.

cards.title: Avenue Capital aviation leasing portfolio | Partners Group
cards.metadata: Partners Group (Infrastructure Secondaries Investment) · Aviation Leasing · Global
cards.description: Partners Group invested US$250mm as sole lead investor in a continuation vehicle acquiring a global commercial aviation leasing portfolio. The contracted aircraft-leasing exposure fits the firm's infrastructure secondaries strategy.

cards.title: GeniePoint EV charging locations | EQT Infrastructure
cards.metadata: EQT Infrastructure / InstaVolt (Bolt-On Acquisition) · EV Charging · United Kingdom
cards.description: EQT-backed InstaVolt agreed to acquire 228 GeniePoint EV charging locations from Equans. The transaction adds more than 260 chargers and moves InstaVolt past 1,000 UK sites.

cards.title: InstaVolt Iberian EV charging business | Antin / EQT Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Powerdot / InstaVolt (Business Operations Sale) · EV Charging · Spain / Portugal
cards.description: Antin-backed Powerdot agreed to acquire InstaVolt's Spanish and Portuguese operations from EQT-backed InstaVolt. The divestiture transfers the Iberian charging network and related employees to a regional EV infrastructure platform.

cards.title: Genus Power Infrastructures | GIC
cards.metadata: GIC (Stake Sale) · Smart Metering / Utilities · India
cards.description: GIC sold an 11.03% equity stake in Genus Power Infrastructures through an open-market block transaction. Genus supplies smart-metering and utility digitalization infrastructure, making the sale a secondary equity rotation in the power distribution value chain.

cards.title: Drammen Fjernvarme | Vauban Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Oslofjord Varme / Vauban (Remaining Stake Acquisition) · District Heating · Norway
cards.description: Vauban-backed Oslofjord Varme agreed to acquire Å Energi's remaining 50% stake in Drammen Fjernvarme. The transaction moves the Norwegian district-heating business to full Oslofjord Varme ownership.

cards.title: Cardinal Midstream Delaware Basin assets | EnCap Flatrock Midstream
cards.metadata: EnCap Flatrock / Cardinal Midstream (Portfolio Company Sale) · Gas Gathering / Processing · United States
cards.description: EnCap Flatrock-backed Cardinal Midstream agreed to sell Cardinal Delaware Basin and Cardinal New Mexico to San Mateo Midstream for US$752mm. The assets include natural gas gathering and processing infrastructure in the Delaware Basin.

cards.title: Great Bay Renewables | Apollo
cards.metadata: Apollo / Northampton Capital Partners (Sale) · Renewable Energy Royalties · United States
cards.description: Apollo Infrastructure Funds signed an agreement to sell their 50% membership interests in Great Bay Renewables to Northampton Capital Partners for approximately US$390 million. The divestiture transfers Apollo's stake in the renewable-energy royalty platform.

cards.title: Copia Power | EQT Infrastructure / Carlyle Infrastructure
cards.metadata: EQT Infrastructure / Carlyle Infrastructure (Buyout / Sale) · Integrated Power & AI Infrastructure · United States
cards.description: EQT Infrastructure VII agreed to acquire Copia Power from Carlyle Infrastructure. The platform has 2.6 GW of generation and storage operating or under construction, with more than 9 GW of data-center development supported by over 25 GW of solar and storage and 7 GW of gas generation.

cards.title: Harmony Energy | Energy Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Energy Infrastructure Partners / Alpiq (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Battery Storage · Europe
cards.description: EIP-backed Alpiq agreed to acquire 90% of Harmony Energy, with co-founder and CEO Peter Kavanagh retaining 10%. The platform adds approximately 400 MW under construction and a pipeline exceeding 12 GW across the United Kingdom, France, Germany and Poland.

cards.title: Schwarzholz Agri-PV Park | EQT Infrastructure
cards.metadata: EQT Infrastructure / Tion Renewables / FEFA (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Solar / Agri-PV · Germany
cards.description: EQT Active Core Infrastructure-backed Tion Renewables acquired the operational Schwarzholz Agri-PV park from FEFA. The 69 MWp asset is expected to generate approximately 87 GWh annually, equivalent to the electricity needs of about 25,000 homes.

cards.title: NuGen C&I Solar Portfolio | Argo Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Argo Infrastructure Partners / NuGen (Portfolio Acquisition) · Commercial & Industrial Solar · United States
cards.description: Argo acquired eight operating commercial and industrial solar sites from NuGen, including six in Massachusetts and two in New Jersey. The add-on expands Argo's distributed-solar platform to 196 sites and approximately 270 MW of operating capacity.

cards.title: Lemvig Biogas | APG
cards.metadata: APG / Palisade / BioticNRG (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Biogas / Biomethane · Denmark
cards.description: APG-backed BioticNRG acquired Lemvig Biogas, an industrial-scale Danish facility operating since 1992. BioticNRG plans to upgrade the plant to produce biomethane for injection into Denmark's gas grid.

cards.title: Nicollin Environnement | Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: MSIP (Majority Stake) · Waste & Water Environmental Services · France
cards.description: MSIP committed to acquire a majority stake in Nicollin Environnement, with the Nicollin family remaining invested. The French platform serves approximately 360 public contracts and 8,000 private clients with 4,800 employees, 2,900 vehicles and a national network of environmental-infrastructure sites.

cards.title: Paprec Metabader | Swiss Life Asset Managers / UBS Asset Management
cards.sponsor: Swiss Life Asset Managers / UBS Asset Management
cards.metadata: Swiss Life Asset Managers / UBS Asset Management / Paprec (Business Combination) · Recycling & Environmental Services · Switzerland
cards.description: Paprec Swiss Group combined with Metabader to create Paprec Metabader, which has 31 plants and agencies across Switzerland. Jessy Bader became CEO and a shareholder; the combined company’s capital includes an infrastructure fund managed by Swiss Life Asset Managers and UBS Asset Management.

cards.title: Kundl Campus Infrastructure & Site Services | Swiss Life Asset Managers
cards.metadata: Swiss Life Asset Managers / Gelsenwasser / INNEXIS (Asset / Business Carve-Out) · Industrial Site Infrastructure & Services · Austria
cards.description: Swiss Life- and Gelsenwasser-backed INNEXIS agreed to acquire selected infrastructure facilities, assets and real estate-related services at the Kundl Life Science Campus from Novartis, with 30 employees transferring. The acquired perimeter spans approximately 264,000 square metres and more than 100 buildings; Novartis will retain the research and production facilities.

cards.title: Milestone Environmental | I Squared Capital
cards.metadata: I Squared Capital / SK Capital (Buyout) · Environmental Services · United States
cards.description: I Squared Capital's flagship fund agreed to acquire Milestone Environmental from SK Capital. The platform owns and operates 15 fully permitted disposal facilities across major U.S. energy basins and manages approximately one billion gallons of waste annually across the energy and industrial sectors.

cards.title: Sabey Data Center Properties | Ares Management
cards.metadata: Ares Management (Minority Equity Investment) · Data Centers · United States
cards.description: Ares Secondaries funds made a minority equity investment in Sabey Data Center Properties. The U.S. platform spans six energized campuses with approximately 251 MW of operating capacity and more than four million square feet of mission-critical space.

cards.title: Northern Fiber Holding | iCON Infrastructure
cards.metadata: iCON Infrastructure / Strategic Fiber Networks (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Fiber Networks · Germany
cards.description: iCON-backed Strategic Fiber Networks agreed to acquire Northern Fiber Holding in a share deal. Operating through the Lünecom and sewikom brands, Northern Fiber manages owned and leased networks serving rural and semi-urban communities across three German states.

cards.title: D-Marin | InfraVia Capital Partners
cards.metadata: InfraVia Capital Partners / CVC (Buyout / Sale) · Marina Infrastructure · Mediterranean / EMEA
cards.description: InfraVia European Fund VI agreed to acquire D-Marin from CVC alongside management. The premium-marina platform operates and develops 28 marinas with more than 14,300 berths across nine countries.

cards.title: Helen EV Charging Business | CVC DIF
cards.metadata: CVC DIF / Plugit / Helen (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · EV Charging · Finland
cards.description: CVC DIF-backed Plugit acquired Helen’s electric-vehicle charging business. The network includes 199 public charging stations and 798 charge points, with more than 55,000 registered users transferring to Plugit’s platform.

cards.title: Dresser Utility Solutions | Blackstone / First Reserve
cards.metadata: Blackstone Energy Transition Partners / First Reserve (Buyout / Sale) · Utility Infrastructure Technology · United States
cards.description: Funds managed by Blackstone Energy Transition Partners agreed to acquire Dresser Utility Solutions from First Reserve. The approximately 850-employee business supplies measurement, instrumentation and control products for natural-gas and water infrastructure globally; terms were not disclosed.

cards.title: MidOcean Energy | EIG
cards.metadata: EIG / Private Department (Primary Capital Raise / Minority Investment) · LNG · North America / Global
cards.description: The Private Department of Sheikh Mohammed bin Khalid Al Nahyan committed US$1.13 billion to MidOcean Energy, the global LNG company formed and managed by EIG. The investment expands MidOcean’s institutional shareholder base and supports the platform’s LNG growth strategy.

cards.title: Sprng Energy | GIP
cards.metadata: GIP / Aditya Birla Renewables (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Renewable Power · India
cards.description: GIP-backed Aditya Birla Renewables signed an agreement to acquire 100% of Solenergi, including the Sprng Energy group, from Shell for US$1.8 billion. The platform comprises 5.0 GWp of Indian solar and wind assets, including 3.3 GWp operating and 1.7 GWp contracted.

cards.title: Summit Ridge Energy | GIP
cards.metadata: GIP (Majority Stake) · Commercial Solar & Storage · United States
cards.description: GIP Mid-Market Funds agreed to acquire a majority and controlling interest in Summit Ridge Energy. The U.S. commercial solar and storage platform owns and operates more than 275 facilities serving over 60,000 businesses, homes and municipalities.

cards.title: Formosa 2 Offshore Wind Farm | PSP Investments
cards.metadata: PSP Investments / JERA Nex bp (Joint Control Acquisition) · Offshore Wind · Taiwan
cards.description: PSP Investments and JERA Nex bp will acquire joint control of Formosa 2 through a purchase of shares, according to an EU merger notice published July 16. The operating Taiwanese offshore wind farm has 376 MW of capacity.

cards.title: Tuscania BESS Portfolio | J.P. Morgan Asset Management
cards.metadata: J.P. Morgan Asset Management / Sonnedix (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Battery Storage · Italy
cards.description: J.P. Morgan Asset Management-backed Sonnedix acquired two adjacent standalone BESS projects in Tuscania from Sphera Energy. The 160 MW and 100 MW four-hour projects add 260 MW / 1,040 MWh to Sonnedix’s Italian portfolio.

cards.title: SELCHP | MEAG / iCON Infrastructure
cards.metadata: MEAG / iCON Infrastructure (Minority Stake / Sale) · Waste-to-Energy · United Kingdom
cards.description: MEAG acquired iCON Infrastructure Partners IV’s 49.78% stake in the South East London Combined Heat and Power plant. Veolia remains co-owner and operator of the facility, which receives contracted waste volumes and generates power-offtake revenue.

cards.title: ClearGen C&I Solar Portfolio | CBRE Investment Management
cards.metadata: CBRE Investment Management / ClearGen (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · C&I Solar · United States
cards.description: CBRE Investment Management-backed ClearGen acquired 100% of the equity interests in ten operating behind-the-meter solar projects from Tortoise Capital affiliates. The 19 MW portfolio spans California, Colorado, Florida, Massachusetts and New Jersey.

cards.title: EcoEridania | CVC DIF / iCON Infrastructure
cards.metadata: CVC DIF / iCON Infrastructure (Majority Stake / Sale) · Medical & Industrial Waste · Italy
cards.description: CVC DIF agreed to acquire a majority stake in EcoEridania through DIF Infrastructure VIII, including the indirect purchase of iCON’s 75% interest. The integrated Italian waste platform served approximately 27,000 clients through 22 facilities and managed 1.3 million tons of waste in 2025.

cards.title: All American Tire / Colt Tire Recycling / Genan | I Squared Capital
cards.target: All American Tire / Colt Tire Recycling / Genan
cards.metadata: I Squared Capital / Liberty Tire Recycling (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Tire Recycling · United States
cards.description: I Squared-backed Liberty Tire Recycling completed three acquisitions: All American Tire, Colt Tire Recycling and Genan Inc. The bolt-ons expand Liberty’s collection and recycling coverage across Gulf Coast markets and reinforce its environmental-infrastructure platform.

cards.title: Cyntox Biohazard Solutions | Igneo Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Igneo Infrastructure Partners (Buyout / Platform Formation) · Medical Waste · United States
cards.description: Igneo acquired Cyntox Biohazard Solutions as one of two initial investments forming a regulated U.S. medical-waste platform. The combined platform will integrate collection, treatment and disposal services across the Central, Midwest and Northeast regions.

cards.title: AdvoWaste Medical Services | Igneo Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Igneo Infrastructure Partners (Buyout / Platform Formation) · Medical Waste · United States
cards.description: Igneo separately acquired AdvoWaste Medical Services as the second founding business in its new North American medical-waste platform. AdvoWaste and Cyntox have complementary footprints and serve small and medium waste generators including clinics, veterinary practices and nursing homes.

cards.title: Raxio Group | Meridiam
cards.metadata: Meridiam / Roha (Follow-On Equity) · Data Centers · Africa
cards.description: Meridiam and Roha provided additional equity to Raxio and increased their stakes, lifting the African data-center platform’s committed capital from US$350 million to more than US$380 million. Raxio operates Tier III carrier-neutral facilities in six countries with Tanzania under development.

cards.title: TIP Group | I Squared Capital / IMCO / GCM Grosvenor
cards.sponsor: I Squared Capital / IMCO / GCM Grosvenor
cards.metadata: I Squared Capital / IMCO / GCM Grosvenor (Minority Stake / Sale) · Transportation Equipment Leasing · Europe
cards.description: I Squared agreed to sell a combined 25% stake in TIP Group to IMCO and GCM Grosvenor. TIP operates approximately 90,000 trailers, trucks and specialized assets from more than 130 service locations in 17 countries, serving over 15,000 European transportation and logistics customers.

cards.title: Delfin FLNG2 | EIG
cards.metadata: EIG / MidOcean Energy (Minority Stake) · Floating LNG · United States
cards.description: EIG-managed MidOcean Energy entered into agreements to acquire up to a 50% interest in Delfin’s second floating LNG vessel. The transaction remains subject to a positive final investment decision and customary conditions while advancing U.S. Gulf Coast LNG export capacity.

cards.title: Aypa Power | Brookfield / Blackstone
cards.metadata: Brookfield / Blackstone (Buyout / Sale) · Battery Storage · North America
cards.description: Brookfield agreed to acquire Aypa Power from Blackstone for approximately US$7 billion of enterprise value, including US$3 billion of equity value. Aypa has approximately 6.5 GW of operating, under-construction and contracted battery-storage capacity and a development pipeline exceeding 20 GW.
cards.scaleNote: Approximately US$7bn enterprise value; US$3bn equity value

cards.title: Cubico–CFE Mexico JV | Ontario Teachers / PSP
cards.metadata: Ontario Teachers / PSP / Cubico (Portfolio Company Joint Venture) · Renewable Power & Battery Storage · Mexico
cards.description: Ontario Teachers- and PSP-owned Cubico signed a 25-year joint venture agreement with CFE covering five renewable projects totaling 578 MWac plus 175.7 MW / 500 MWh of battery storage. The partnership is expected to unlock nearly US$1 billion of investment across Tamaulipas, Nuevo León, Campeche and the Yucatán Peninsula.
cards.scaleNote: Close to US$1bn projected total infrastructure investment; not disclosed committed equity

cards.title: Greenbacker Renewable Energy Company | Ridgewood
cards.metadata: Ridgewood / MN8 Energy (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Renewable Power · United States
cards.description: Ridgewood-backed MN8 Energy signed a definitive cash-and-equity agreement to acquire Greenbacker for up to approximately US$375 million. The combination would create a clean-power platform with more than 6 GW of operating and under-construction capacity across 33 states.
cards.scaleNote: Up to approximately US$375m cash-and-equity transaction value

cards.title: Yanara | Mirova
cards.metadata: Mirova (Growth Investment) · Renewable Power & Battery Storage · Australia
cards.description: Mirova committed €150 million to Yanara to accelerate more than 2 GW of utility-scale renewable infrastructure across Victoria, New South Wales and Western Australia. The portfolio includes the 450 MW solar and 600 MW / 2,400 MWh Mortlake Energy Hub.
cards.scaleNote: EUR150m investment

cards.title: Burton Wold & Winscales Moor Wind Farms | Tiger Infrastructure
cards.target: Burton Wold & Winscales Moor Wind Farms
cards.metadata: Tiger Infrastructure / Forsa Energy (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Onshore Wind · United Kingdom
cards.description: Tiger Infrastructure-backed Forsa Energy acquired the operational Burton Wold and Winscales Moor wind farms from GCP Infra for approximately £11 million. The 17-turbine portfolio totals approximately 26.5 MW and expands Forsa’s UK independent-power-producer platform to 324.5 MW.
cards.scaleNote: Approximately GBP11m total proceeds

cards.title: Vena Energy KN Wind Power | GIP
cards.metadata: GIP / Vena Energy / Orient Cement (Portfolio Company Minority Stake Acquisition) · Onshore Wind · India
cards.description: Orient Cement approved the acquisition of a 9.04% interest in both the ordinary and cumulative convertible preference share capital of GIP-backed Vena Energy KN Wind Power for ₹1.234 million. The target owns a 46 MW wind project in Karnataka that will supply contracted renewable power for captive use.
cards.scaleNote: INR1.23435m cash consideration for a 9.04% stake

cards.title: Five Virginia Community Solar Projects | ECP / TPG
cards.metadata: ECP / TPG / New Leaf Energy / Altus Power (Portfolio Company Acquisition / Divestiture) · Community Solar · United States
cards.description: TPG-backed Altus Power acquired five under-development Virginia community-solar projects totaling 32 MW from ECP-backed New Leaf Energy. The projects will serve Appalachian Power’s shared-solar program and are expected to provide power equivalent to the needs of approximately 5,000 homes.
cards.scaleNote: Five under-development community-solar projects totaling 32 MW

cards.title: Caruna | KKR / Ontario Teachers
cards.metadata: KKR / Ontario Teachers / Iberdrola (Sale) · Electricity Distribution · Finland
cards.description: Iberdrola agreed to acquire KKR’s and Ontario Teachers’ respective 40% holdings in Caruna for approximately €2 billion, valuing the Finnish electricity distributor at about €5 billion including debt. Caruna operates roughly 89,000 km of network and serves 1.5 million people.
cards.scaleNote: Approximately EUR5bn enterprise value; approximately EUR2bn paid for 80% equity

cards.title: Uluğ Enerji | Actis
cards.metadata: Actis / IFC / Proparco (Minority Investment) · Electricity Distribution · Türkiye
cards.description: IFC and Proparco agreed to become minority equity investors in Actis-controlled Uluğ Enerji, with Actis retaining a majority stake. The electricity distribution and retail group serves more than three million customers across four provinces under an exclusive concession through 2036.
cards.scaleNote: Undisclosed minority investment; more than three million customers

cards.title: OIL! Tankstellen | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR / Enilive (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Fuel Distribution & Mobility Retail · Germany / Denmark / Austria / Switzerland
cards.description: KKR-backed Enilive signed a binding agreement to acquire 100% of OIL! Tankstellen from Prax. The network comprises approximately 320 service stations across four European markets and expands Enilive’s retail platform for conventional and lower-emission fuels, electric charging and related mobility services.
cards.scaleNote: Approximately 320 service stations across four countries

cards.title: GO.FARM Permanent Crops Platform | La Caisse
cards.metadata: La Caisse / GO.FARM (Platform Launch / Minority Stake) · Agricultural Infrastructure · Australia
cards.description: La Caisse committed A$300 million and GO.FARM A$30 million to launch an Australian irrigated permanent-crops platform, while La Caisse will also acquire a minority stake in GO.FARM. The manager oversees approximately A$1.6 billion of assets focused on institutional-scale land and water operations.
cards.scaleNote: AUD330m initial total equity commitment

cards.title: California Solar & BESS Portfolio | Ares
cards.metadata: Ares (Acquisition) · Solar & Battery Storage · United States
cards.description: Ares agreed to acquire an 80% common-equity interest in a California portfolio totaling 384 MW, comprising 200 MW of solar and 184 MW of battery storage. EDPR reported an approximately US$800mm enterprise value and US$450mm of expected proceeds.
cards.scaleNote: US$800mm enterprise value; US$450mm proceeds to EDPR

cards.title: RWE U.S. Distributed Clean Energy | GSAM
cards.metadata: GSAM / RWE (Acquisition / Divestiture) · Distributed Solar & Storage · United States
cards.description: GSAM agreed to acquire RWE’s U.S. distributed clean-energy business, including 348 MWdc of operating assets and a 1.2 GW development pipeline. The transaction transfers an established commercial-and-industrial generation platform to GSAM’s infrastructure strategy.
cards.scaleNote: 348 MWdc operating portfolio plus 1.2 GW development pipeline

cards.title: U.S. Distributed Solar Portfolio | ArcLight
cards.metadata: ArcLight / REC Power (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Distributed Solar · United States
cards.description: ArcLight-backed REC Power completed the acquisition of 15 operating distributed-generation solar projects totaling 68 MW from Adapture Renewables. The portfolio broadens REC Power’s contracted operating base across U.S. power markets.
cards.scaleNote: Fifteen operating distributed-generation solar projects totaling 68 MW

cards.title: Green Squares / Vertis Rooftop Solar | Igneo
cards.metadata: Igneo / Vertis (Platform Launch / Portfolio Acquisition) · Rooftop Solar · Australia
cards.description: Igneo launched Vertis Energy with the acquisition of Green Squares Energy and two follow-on portfolios totaling 46 MW of rooftop solar. The assets establish an operating distributed-energy platform serving Australian commercial and industrial customers.
cards.scaleNote: Initial rooftop-solar portfolio totals 46 MW

cards.title: Fukushima Wind Project | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak / TerraWind (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Onshore Wind · Japan
cards.description: Stonepeak-backed TerraWind acquired an approximately 25 MW onshore-wind project in Fukushima Prefecture. The purchase expands TerraWind’s Japanese development pipeline to 376 MW.
cards.scaleNote: Approximately 25 MW onshore-wind project

cards.title: Múlavirkjun | Ancala
cards.metadata: Ancala / HS Orka (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Hydropower · Iceland
cards.description: Ancala-backed HS Orka acquired the 3.2 MW Múlavirkjun hydropower plant in Iceland. The bolt-on adds an operating renewable asset to HS Orka’s domestic generation portfolio.
cards.scaleNote: 3.2 MW operating hydro plant

cards.title: Wayu Energy | IFM
cards.metadata: IFM / Nala / Kaffee Energy (Portfolio Company Divestiture) · Renewable Power Platform · Southeast Asia
cards.description: IFM Net Zero Infrastructure Fund-backed Nala Renewables sold its 80% interest in Wayu Energy to Kaffee Energy Limited. The divestiture advances Nala’s geographic refocus while transferring the Vietnam- and Philippines-focused renewable-power platform to a new owner.
cards.scaleNote: Sale of an 80% platform stake; consideration not disclosed

cards.title: Meta El Paso Data Center Campus | BlackRock / GIP
cards.target: Meta El Paso Data Center Campus
cards.metadata: BlackRock / GIP / Meta (Joint Venture) · Data Centers · United States
cards.description: Meta formed a strategic venture with a BlackRock-led investor group to develop a 1 GW data-center campus in El Paso, Texas. The investor group will own 80% of the approximately US$14bn project, providing direct capital for hyperscale digital infrastructure.
cards.scaleNote: Approximately US$14bn total campus development cost

cards.title: Westconnect | Igneo
cards.metadata: Igneo (Equity Investment) · Fiber Networks · Germany
cards.description: Igneo contributed new shareholder equity to Westconnect alongside a €1.2bn financing package supporting the company’s fiber rollout. Westconnect has passed more than 1mm households; the equity component was not separately disclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Network has passed more than 1mm households and raised an aggregate EUR1.2bn financing package; equity amount not separately disclosed

cards.title: Yondr Slough Campus | La Caisse / DigitalBridge
cards.metadata: La Caisse / DigitalBridge / GLIL (Sale / Joint Venture) · Data Centers · United Kingdom
cards.description: La Caisse- and DigitalBridge-owned Yondr brought GLIL Infrastructure into its Slough data-center campus through an investment in two operational buildings. The buildings represent more than 60 MW within the campus’ greater-than-100 MW footprint.
cards.scaleNote: Two operational buildings represent more than 60 MW within a 100 MW-plus campus

cards.title: Greenergy Data Centers | Amber
cards.metadata: Amber / 3SIIF (Minority Stake) · Data Centers · Estonia
cards.description: Amber-managed 3SIIF admitted Tensor Ventures as a minority investor in MCF Group, the owner of Greenergy Data Centers, while retaining majority control. The investment adds growth capital to the operator of the Baltics’ largest data center.
cards.scaleNote: Minority growth investment; value not disclosed

cards.title: Cube Highways Trust | ADIA / BCI / I Squared
cards.metadata: ADIA / BCI / I Squared (IPO) · Toll Roads · India
cards.description: ADIA-, BCI- and I Squared-backed Cube Highways Trust began public trading following a ₹5,000 crore issue. The infrastructure investment trust owns 27 operational road assets and debuted with a reported market capitalization of ₹21,045 crore.
cards.scaleNote: INR50bn public issue, roughly US$600mm equivalent; 27 operational road assets

cards.title: Crosby Marine Transportation | Tallvine
cards.metadata: Tallvine (Stalking-Horse Acquisition) · Marine Transportation & Dredging · United States
cards.description: Tallvine affiliate Breakwater Buyer LLC signed a US$75mm stalking-horse agreement for Crosby Marine Transportation’s marine-transportation and dredging business. The proposed purchase remains subject to the bankruptcy auction process and court approval.
cards.scaleNote: US$75mm stalking-horse purchase agreement, subject to auction and court approval

cards.title: Contracted Container Portfolio | Brookfield
cards.metadata: Brookfield (Portfolio Company Divestiture) · Intermodal Containers · North America / Global
cards.description: Brookfield Infrastructure disclosed the completed sale of a 67% interest across contracted intermodal-container programs representing more than one-quarter of the related fleet. The transaction generated US$60mm of proceeds at Brookfield Infrastructure’s share.
cards.scaleNote: US$60mm proceeds at Brookfield Infrastructure's share

cards.title: Sølvtrans | Antin
cards.metadata: Antin / GLIL (Minority Stake Sale) · Wellboat Transportation · Norway
cards.description: Antin agreed to sell a 30% interest in Sølvtrans to GLIL Infrastructure while retaining majority control. The aquaculture wellboat operator has expanded from 21 vessels at Antin’s investment to a 48-vessel fleet.
cards.scaleNote: Sølvtrans fleet has grown to 48 vessels; transaction value undisclosed

cards.title: Kuwait Oil Pipeline Network | Blackstone / Brookfield / KKR
cards.metadata: Blackstone / Brookfield / KKR (Joint Venture / Leaseback) · Crude-Oil Pipelines · Kuwait
cards.description: A Blackstone-, Brookfield- and KKR-led consortium agreed a US$16bn partnership over Kuwait Oil Company’s 13-pipeline, 320-kilometer crude-oil network. The investors will own 49% of a newly formed infrastructure company, generating US$7.85bn of proceeds for KOC while operations remain with the state producer.
cards.scaleNote: US$16bn infrastructure partnership; US$7.85bn proceeds to KOC

cards.title: SeaSeaS Amsterdam CO₂ Terminal | IMCO
cards.metadata: IMCO / Exolum (Portfolio Company Minority Stake) · CO₂ Transportation & Storage · Netherlands
cards.description: IMCO-backed Exolum acquired a minority interest in the SeaSeaS Amsterdam CO₂ terminal project. The planned terminal is designed to handle 3.5mm tonnes of CO₂ annually and is expected to begin operations in 2030.
cards.scaleNote: Planned terminal capacity of 3.5mm tonnes of CO2 per year

cards.title: Epic Energy | MSIP / QIC
cards.metadata: MSIP / QIC (Buyout / Sale) · Gas Pipelines · Australia
cards.description: MSIP agreed to acquire Epic Energy from QIC Infrastructure. The transaction transfers an established Australian gas-pipeline and energy-infrastructure operator with a 50-year operating history; financial terms were not disclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Acquisition of Australian gas-pipeline operator; value not disclosed

cards.title: DCC Energy | ECP / KKR
cards.metadata: ECP / KKR (Buyout) · Energy Distribution · United Kingdom
cards.description: ECP and KKR announced a recommended acquisition of DCC Energy valuing its equity at £5.75bn. The take-private would transfer a diversified energy-distribution platform serving customers across multiple European markets to infrastructure ownership.
cards.scaleNote: GBP5.75bn equity value, materially above the C$1bn Tarchon commitment

cards.title: Tarchon Interconnector | CPP Investments / CIP
cards.metadata: CPP Investments / CIP / WindGrid (Majority Stake) · Power Interconnector · United Kingdom / Germany
cards.description: CPP Investments agreed to commit approximately C$1bn for a majority interest in Tarchon, a proposed 1.4 GW electricity interconnector between the United Kingdom and Germany. WindGrid will hold a 25% look-through minority interest, and Copenhagen Infrastructure V, managed by CIP, is the seller.
cards.scaleNote: C$1bn commitment by CPP Investments; 1.4 GW interconnector

cards.title: TotalEnergies European Renewables Portfolio | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR (Co-Investment) · Onshore Solar & Wind · Germany / Spain / France / Poland
cards.description: KKR agreed to acquire a 50% interest in TotalEnergies’ largely developed 1.2 GW European onshore solar and wind portfolio at a €1.8bn enterprise value. TotalEnergies will retain 50%, continue operating the assets and market their power.
cards.scaleNote: €1.8bn portfolio enterprise value; KKR is acquiring a 50% interest

cards.title: AVK Power Solutions | Partners Group
cards.metadata: Partners Group (Majority Stake) · Data Center Power Infrastructure · United Kingdom
cards.description: Partners Group agreed to acquire a majority stake in AVK through its fourth direct infrastructure program, with management retaining a minority interest, and plans to invest more than US$1bn of equity. AVK has delivered more than 20,000 projects representing c.3.5 GW of installed power and has a pipeline above 2 GW.
cards.scaleNote: More than US$1bn of committed equity

cards.title: Enpal Residential Energy Systems Portfolio | Equitix
cards.metadata: Equitix / Keppel Infrastructure Trust / MM Capital Partners (Majority Stake) · Distributed Solar & Battery Storage · Germany
cards.description: The infrastructure-fund consortium, also including Mizuho Leasing, acquired 90% of Enpal subsidiaries holding more than 20,000 operating residential energy systems; Enpal retains 10% and remains the operator. Up to €65mm of new capital will support a portfolio with projected capacity of c.240 MW.
cards.scaleNote: Up to €65mm of fresh capital; c.240 MW portfolio

cards.title: Verdant Energy / Aura Power | CVC DIF
cards.metadata: CVC DIF (Merger) · Solar & Battery Storage · United Kingdom
cards.description: CVC DIF-backed Verdant Energy and Aura Power merged to form a UK independent power producer with c.1 GW of operating and under-construction solar and battery assets and a c.10 GW development pipeline. CVC DIF invested through DIF Infrastructure VII, while Aura Power’s founder retains a minority stake.
cards.scaleNote: c.1 GW operating and under construction plus c.10 GW development pipeline

cards.title: Bioforce | Amber Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Amber Infrastructure / 3SIIF (Primary Capital Raise) · Biomethane · Estonia
cards.description: Amber-advised Three Seas Initiative Investment Fund invested expansion capital in Bioforce, Estonia’s leading biomethane producer. Bioforce has three operating plants and a fourth commissioning toward combined output above 250 GWh, with a plan to reach 1 TWh by 2032 through Baltic and Polish expansion.
cards.scaleNote: Over 250 GWh across four plants, targeting 1 TWh by 2032

cards.title: Cella | I Squared Capital
cards.metadata: I Squared Capital (Buyout) · Logistics & Cold Storage · Indonesia
cards.description: I Squared entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Cella, an Indonesian industrial-logistics and cold-storage platform. Cella owns and operates five facilities totaling approximately 231,000 square meters across major Indonesian distribution markets.
cards.scaleNote: Five logistics and cold-storage facilities totaling c.231,000 square meters

cards.title: Rail Modal Group | InfraRed Capital Partners
cards.metadata: InfraRed Capital Partners (Majority Stake) · Inland Intermodal Rail & Export Logistics · United States
cards.description: InfraRed acquired a majority stake in Rail Modal Group through its value-add infrastructure strategy, with founder Greg Oberting remaining invested and serving as CEO.
