The platform operates four U.S. inland intermodal terminals and has shipped more than 1,200 full-length unit trains, equivalent to approximately 200mm truck miles.
cards.scaleNote: Four U.S. inland intermodal terminals; more than 1,200 unit trains shipped

cards.title: Massachusetts Central Railroad / Wildwood Reload | 3i
cards.metadata: 3i / Regional Rail (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Short-Line Freight Rail & Transloading · Massachusetts, United States
cards.description: 3i-backed Regional Rail acquired the 28-mile Massachusetts Central Railroad and Wildwood Reload’s warehousing and transloading operations. The bolt-on extends a network that now reaches 18 railroads across 10 U.S. states and two Canadian provinces.
cards.scaleNote: 28-mile short-line railroad plus warehousing and transloading operations

cards.title: Hainesport Transportation Group | Terramont Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Terramont Infrastructure Partners (Majority Stake) · Short-Line Rail & Rail-Served Waste Logistics · New Jersey, United States
cards.description: Terramont acquired a majority stake in Hainesport Transportation Group, which combines a short-line railroad with rail-served waste transfer and recycling facilities in New Jersey. The investment provides growth capital for an integrated regional rail-and-environmental-logistics platform.
cards.scaleNote: Majority acquisition; financial terms not disclosed

cards.title: Great Sea Interconnector | Meridiam
cards.metadata: Meridiam (Majority Stake) · Power Interconnector · Greece / Cyprus
cards.description: Meridiam signed an agreement to become the majority shareholder of the Great Sea Interconnector SPV. The approximately €1.9bn, c.900 km subsea link is designed to transfer 1,000 MW between Greece and Cyprus and end Cyprus’ electrical isolation.
cards.scaleNote: €1.9bn project; c.900 km and 1,000 MW

cards.title: Maverick Water Group | Apollo
cards.metadata: Apollo (Buyout) · Non-Potable Water Systems · Texas, United States
cards.description: Apollo-managed funds acquired Maverick Water Group from Crosstimbers-managed funds, with management retaining a minority stake. Maverick develops, owns and operates long-term contracted non-potable water systems for communities, data centers and industrial customers across Texas.
cards.scaleNote: Platform acquisition; financial terms not disclosed

cards.title: MP Power | EQT Infrastructure
cards.metadata: EQT Infrastructure / Osmose (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Electric Utility Infrastructure Services · United Kingdom
cards.description: EQT Infrastructure-backed Osmose acquired MP Power, an Ely-based provider of overhead-line inspection, pole assessment, cable-condition and clearance services to UK electricity network operators. The bolt-on expands Osmose’s utility-infrastructure assessment capabilities in Europe.
cards.scaleNote: Portfolio-company bolt-on; financial terms not disclosed

cards.title: Fallowfield Campus Student Accommodation | Equitix
cards.metadata: Equitix / GRAHAM (Joint Venture) · Student Accommodation · Manchester, United Kingdom
cards.description: Equitix and GRAHAM reached financial close on a £530mm, 50-year partnership with the University of Manchester to redevelop the Fallowfield campus. The project will deliver 3,300 student rooms in what the partners describe as the world’s largest single-phase Passivhaus student-accommodation scheme.
cards.scaleNote: £530mm project; 3,300 rooms under a 50-year partnership

cards.title: MBI | Basalt Infrastructure Partners
cards.metadata: Basalt Infrastructure Partners (Buyout) · Waste Transportation & Transfer-Station Management · United States
cards.description: Basalt-advised funds acquired MBI from Fortress-managed funds; Basalt announced the transaction on August 3 after its July 31 closing. MBI operates more than 5,000 long-lived specialized assets and serves waste operators and municipalities across more than 40 terminals nationwide.
cards.scaleNote: More than 5,000 specialized assets serving customers across more than 40 terminals

cards.title: Momentum Midstream (M6) | EnCap Flatrock Midstream
cards.metadata: EnCap Flatrock / M6 Midstream (Portfolio Company Sale) · Natural Gas Gathering & Transmission · Louisiana, United States
cards.description: Williams agreed to acquire 100% of EnCap Flatrock-backed Momentum Midstream for US$3.5bn in cash and assumed debt plus approximately US$2bn in Williams equity, for total consideration of up to US$5.5bn. The system spans more than 4,000 miles and connects Haynesville production to Gulf Coast LNG and power demand.
cards.scaleNote: Up to US$5.5bn for 100% of the company

cards.title: ReNew Energy Global | CPP / ADIA
cards.metadata: CPP / ADIA (Buyout / Rollover) · Renewable Power Platform · India
cards.description: CPP and founder Sumant Sinha signed a binding agreement to acquire ReNew’s remaining shares for US$7.02 per share, implying approximately US$2.8bn of equity value and US$10.2bn of enterprise value; ADIA-controlled Platinum Cactus will roll its stake. ReNew operates an approximately 20.2 GW clean-energy portfolio.
cards.scaleNote: US$2.8bn equity value and approximately US$10.2bn enterprise value; US$7.02 per share

cards.title: ReNew Solar Portfolio | ADIA / CPP
cards.metadata: ADIA / CPP / ReNew (PortCo Divestiture) · Solar Generation · India
cards.description: ADIA- and CPP-backed ReNew signed a definitive agreement to sell six operating solar-project companies totaling 1,055 MW to Purvah Green Power for approximately US$532mm. The transaction advances ReNew’s capital-recycling program.
cards.scaleNote: US$532mm sale of six project companies totaling 1,055 MW

cards.title: Anesco | Ara
cards.metadata: Ara / Nature Infrastructure Capital (Co-Investment) · Solar & Battery Storage · United Kingdom / Northern Europe
cards.description: Nature Infrastructure Capital invested in Anesco alongside existing shareholder Ara to accelerate the renewable developer and operator’s growth. Anesco has delivered more than 1.3 GW and manages more than 1.3 GW across solar and battery assets, with a development pipeline above 7 GW.
cards.scaleNote: More than 1.3 GW delivered and more than 1.3 GW under management; 7 GW+ development pipeline

cards.title: Hussung Mechanical / HMC Service | Bernhard Capital
cards.metadata: Bernhard Capital / Optimum Energy (PortCo Acquisition) · Mechanical & Energy Infrastructure Services · Kentucky, United States
cards.description: Bernhard-backed Optimum Energy acquired Hussung Mechanical Contractors and HMC Service Company, adding HVAC, plumbing, building-automation and mechanical-infrastructure capabilities. The businesses serve healthcare, education, industrial and other mission-critical facilities.
cards.scaleNote: Two-company PortCo bolt-on; financial terms not disclosed

cards.title: MarineMax | Blackstone
cards.metadata: Blackstone / Safe Harbor (PortCo Acquisition) · Marinas & Recreational Marine · United States
cards.description: Blackstone Infrastructure-backed Safe Harbor agreed to acquire all outstanding MarineMax shares for US$53.00 per share in cash, valuing the transaction at approximately US$1.5bn. The combination adds MarineMax’s boat dealerships and marine-service operations to Safe Harbor’s marina platform.
cards.scaleNote: US$1.5bn all-cash transaction; US$53 per share

cards.title: LEAP India | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR (IPO) · Pallet Pooling & Supply-Chain Logistics · India
cards.description: KKR-backed LEAP India began public trading on August 14 following a US$260mm IPO comprising newly issued shares and a larger offer for sale led by KKR-backed Vertical Holdings II. The pallet-pooling platform was valued at approximately US$725mm at debut.
cards.scaleNote: US$260mm IPO; approximately US$725mm value at trading debut

cards.title: Tosca | GSAM
cards.metadata: GSAM (Buyout) · Reusable Packaging & Supply-Chain Pooling · United States
cards.description: Infrastructure at Goldman Sachs Alternatives agreed to acquire Tosca from Apax funds. The Atlanta-based platform owns and manages reusable containers, pallets and bulk bins across a global wash-and-service network serving perishable-food supply chains.
cards.scaleNote: Global reusable-packaging network with approximately 50 service centers; financial terms not disclosed

cards.title: SkyPlace FBO | Tallvine
cards.metadata: Tallvine / Velocity FBO Network (PortCo Acquisition) · Fixed-Base Aviation Services · San Antonio, Texas
cards.description: Tallvine-backed Velocity FBO Network acquired SkyPlace FBO, expanding its airport-services platform into San Antonio. The bolt-on adds fueling, hangar, ramp and passenger-support capabilities at San Antonio International Airport.
cards.scaleNote: Single-location PortCo bolt-on; financial terms not disclosed

cards.title: oOh!media Limited | I Squared
cards.metadata: I Squared (Buyout) · Out-of-Home Media Infrastructure · Australia / New Zealand
cards.description: I Squared entered into a binding scheme agreement to acquire all oOh!media shares, implying an A$898mm equity value and approximately A$1.04bn enterprise value. The platform operates roughly 30,000 digital and static assets across roadside, transit, airport and other locations.
cards.scaleNote: A$898mm equity value and approximately A$1.04bn enterprise value

cards.title: Neumann Group | Igneo Infra
cards.metadata: Igneo Infra (Majority Stake) · Waste Recycling & Resource Recovery · Germany
cards.description: Igneo signed a binding agreement to acquire a majority stake in Neumann through its European Diversified Infrastructure strategy. Neumann operates six German sites and provides incinerator-bottom-ash recycling, logistics and related services to energy-from-waste facilities.
cards.scaleNote: Six operating sites and approximately 320 employees; financial terms not disclosed

cards.title: Capstec | EQT Infra
cards.metadata: EQT Infra / SK Shieldus (PortCo Divestiture) · Integrated Security Services · South Korea
cards.description: Genesis Private Equity signed to acquire 100% of Capstec, including EQT Infrastructure VI-backed SK Shieldus’s 80.02% interest. The sale divests an integrated security-services business from the broader SK Shieldus platform.
cards.scaleNote: Sale of 100% of Capstec equity, including SK Shieldus's 80.02% stake; value not disclosed

cards.title: Elysium Cymru | Ancala
cards.metadata: Ancala / Iris Care Group (PortCo Acquisition) · Specialist Care & Supported Living · Wales, United Kingdom
cards.description: Ancala-backed Iris Care Group acquired Elysium Cymru and its two supported-living services. The bolt-on expands Iris’s specialist complex-care pathway in Wales and adds services for adults with mental-health and learning-disability needs.
cards.scaleNote: Two supported-living services; financial terms not disclosed

cards.title: Theseus Infrastructure | GIC / Macquarie AM
cards.metadata: GIC / Macquarie AM (Joint Venture) · Hyperscale Data Centers · United States
cards.description: GIC and Macquarie-managed funds formed and will co-own Theseus Infrastructure to develop, operate and lease purpose-built U.S. data centers to Anthropic as anchor tenant. The sponsors will fund the majority of each project’s equity under the multi-site platform.
cards.scaleNote: Multi-site U.S. data-center platform; project equity commitments and financial terms not disclosed

cards.title: firstcolo | CVC DIF / Cube Infra
cards.metadata: CVC DIF / Cube Infra (Buyout / Sale) · Colocation Data Centers · Germany
cards.description: CVC DIF agreed to acquire a significant majority stake in firstcolo through DIF Value Add IV from Cube Infrastructure Fund III. The Frankfurt-area operator hosts approximately 20,000 server systems and is developing an AI-ready Rosbach facility with up to 24 MW of capacity.
cards.scaleNote: Approximately 20,000 hosted server systems plus a planned 24 MW Rosbach facility

cards.title: Lackawanna Energy Center | GIP
cards.metadata: BlackRock / GIP (Sale) · Gas-Fired Power Generation · Pennsylvania, United States
cards.description: Funds managed by GIP, a part of BlackRock, signed a definitive agreement to sell 87.71% of Lackawanna’s Class A shares to Equinor for US$940mm. The 1,483 MW combined-cycle plant serves PJM and will continue to be managed and operated by Invenergy.
cards.scaleNote: US$940mm for 87.71% of the Class A shares in the 1,483 MW Lackawanna Energy Center

cards.title: Horse Creek / Electra Wind Farms | Ardian / MEAG
cards.metadata: Ardian / MEAG (Minority Stake Acquisition / Sale) · Onshore Wind Generation · Texas, United States
cards.description: MEAG, on behalf of Munich Re, completed the sale of its minority interests in Horse Creek and Electra to existing co-owner Ardian, giving Ardian full ownership. The two operating ERCOT wind farms have 460 MW of combined installed capacity.
cards.scaleNote: Two operating Texas wind farms with 460 MW of combined installed capacity; financial terms not disclosed

cards.title: Power Planet | EIG
cards.metadata: EIG (Growth Investment) · Enhanced Geothermal Systems · Nevada, United States
cards.description: EIG Geothermal Catalyst Partners completed its inaugural investment in Power Planet to advance the Star Peak enhanced-geothermal project and a broader Nevada portfolio. Power Planet expects Star Peak to begin delivering power in 2027 / 2028.
cards.scaleNote: Development investment in Star Peak and a broader enhanced-geothermal portfolio; terms undisclosed

cards.title: Nine UK School PPP Projects | Amber / APG / InfraRed
cards.metadata: Amber Infrastructure / InfraRed / APG (Sale / Acquisition) · Education PPPs · United Kingdom
cards.description: Amber-advised INPP agreed to sell interests in nine UK PPP projects comprising 15 schools to an InfraRed-managed account backed by APG on behalf of ABP. Gross proceeds are expected to exceed £58mm, representing a premium to the portfolio’s June valuation.
cards.scaleNote: Gross proceeds expected to exceed £58mm for nine project-company interests comprising 15 schools

cards.title: InfraMed Properties | Pantheon
cards.metadata: Pantheon (Platform Launch / Seed Equity) · Medical Outpatient Facilities · United States
cards.description: Pantheon led the institutional LP support for One Orchard’s investment in newly launched InfraMed Properties. The healthcare-infrastructure platform was seeded with 25 medical-outpatient assets across 16 states and is targeting more than US$1bn of investments.
cards.scaleNote: Seeded with 25 properties across 16 states; platform targets more than US$1bn of investments

cards.title: Bryant Hammett & Associates | Bernhard Capital
cards.metadata: Bernhard Capital / Aventia (PortCo Acquisition) · Civil Engineering & Infrastructure Services · Louisiana, United States
cards.description: Bernhard-backed Aventia acquired Bryant Hammett & Associates, adding civil engineering, surveying and hazard-mitigation capabilities across four Louisiana offices. The combination extends Aventia’s 400-plus-person infrastructure-services platform, which serves clients in more than 40 states.
cards.scaleNote: Four-office PortCo bolt-on; financial terms undisclosed

cards.title: Fiberhost / INEA | Macquarie AM
cards.metadata: Macquarie AM / MEIF5 (Sale) · Fibre Network & Telecommunications · Poland
cards.description: Macquarie AM, on behalf of MEIF5, agreed to sell Fiberhost and INEA to Deutsche Telekom for integration into T-Mobile Polska. Fiberhost’s open-access network passes 1.4mm homes across more than 9,700 towns and villages and serves more than 160 providers.
cards.scaleNote: Fiberhost network passes 1.4mm homes across more than 9,700 towns and villages; financial terms not disclosed

cards.title: FlightServ FBO | Igneo
cards.metadata: Igneo / Infinity Aviation (PortCo Acquisition) · Fixed-Base Aviation Services · Trenton, New Jersey
cards.description: Igneo-backed Infinity Aviation acquired FlightServ’s fixed-base operations at Trenton-Mercer Airport, its third location and second bolt-on. The acquired assets include fueling services, approximately 80,000 square feet of modern hangarage and a development parcel for expansion.
cards.scaleNote: Approximately 80,000 square feet of modern hangarage plus a development parcel; financial terms not disclosed

cards.title: Mid-Georgia Cogen | Harbert
cards.metadata: Harbert (Buyout) · Cogeneration Power Plant · Georgia, United States
cards.description: Harbert Power Fund VII acquired the 317 MW Mid-Georgia Cogen dual-fuel combined-cycle facility in Kathleen. The plant operates under a power purchase agreement with Georgia Power, with a new 20-year agreement scheduled to begin in 2028.
cards.scaleNote: 317 MW operating dual-fuel combined-cycle cogeneration facility; financial terms undisclosed

cards.title: Olpe-Rehringhausen Wind Project | CIP
cards.metadata: CIP / Perigus Energy (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Onshore Wind Development · Germany
cards.description: Copenhagen Infrastructure V-backed Perigus Energy acquired the rights to the fully permitted Olpe-Rehringhausen onshore wind project in North Rhine-Westphalia. The three-turbine project has 21 MW of planned capacity and is targeted to enter operation in 2028.
cards.scaleNote: Three permitted turbines with 21 MW of planned capacity; financial terms undisclosed

cards.title: SK Horizon | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR (Minority Stake) · AI Data Centers & Subsea Cables · South Korea
cards.description: Funds managed by KKR and an IMM Investment-Stonebridge consortium entered a definitive agreement for a combined KRW3.08tn equity investment in SK Horizon, a new SK Telecom digital-infrastructure platform. KKR will own 29%, and the platform will encompass eight operating data centers, projects under construction and subsea-cable assets totaling 318 MW.
cards.scaleNote: KRW3.08tn combined equity investment by KKR and the IMM consortium; KKR will own 29%

cards.title: American Tower Canada Portfolio | CVC DIF
cards.metadata: CVC DIF / Aurora Towers (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Wireless Towers · Canada
cards.description: DIF Infra VIII-backed Aurora Towers agreed to acquire American Tower’s Canadian portfolio of approximately 255 communications sites. The bolt-on will expand Aurora’s portfolio to more than 650 towers across Canada.
cards.scaleNote: Approximately 255 communications sites acquired; Aurora portfolio to exceed 650 towers after closing

cards.title: Anchor Point Transmission | ArcLight
cards.metadata: ArcLight (Platform Launch) · High-Voltage Transmission · United States
cards.description: ArcLight committed US$1bn of equity to launch Anchor Point Transmission, an independent platform formed to develop, finance, own and operate high-voltage transmission infrastructure. The company will partner with utilities to address grid investment required by electrification, manufacturing and AI load growth.
cards.scaleNote: US$1bn equity commitment from ArcLight funds to launch the transmission platform

cards.title: PLUS ES | DigitalBridge / AustralianSuper
cards.metadata: DigitalBridge / AustralianSuper / Ausgrid (Sale / Acquisition) · Smart Metering · Australia
cards.description: AustralianSuper-backed Ausgrid entered an agreement to sell PLUS ES’s unregulated digital-metering business to DigitalBridge. PLUS ES has 2mm installed electricity and water meters and a further installation pipeline; its contestable-infrastructure business is excluded from the sale.
cards.scaleNote: 2mm installed digital meters plus a further installation pipeline; financial terms undisclosed

cards.title: Atlantic Aviation | Apollo / KKR
cards.metadata: Apollo / KKR (Minority Stake) · Fixed-Base Aviation Services · United States
cards.description: Apollo-managed infrastructure funds agreed to acquire a significant interest in Atlantic Aviation from KKR, which will remain a substantial investor alongside management. The transaction values the 100-plus-location fixed-base-operator platform at nearly US$10bn.
cards.scaleNote: Transaction values Atlantic Aviation at nearly US$10bn across more than 100 locations

cards.title: EDGE LNG | Antin
cards.metadata: Antin / Sapphire Gas Solutions (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Mobile LNG Infrastructure · United States
cards.description: Antin-backed Sapphire Gas Solutions acquired EDGE LNG from Blue Water Energy, adding modular liquefaction, delivery and vaporization capabilities. EDGE contributes approximately 200,000 gallons of daily LNG liquefaction capacity serving customers across the southern United States.
cards.scaleNote: Approximately 200,000 gallons per day of mobile LNG liquefaction capacity; financial terms undisclosed

cards.title: Gawara Baya | CIP
cards.metadata: CIP (Buyout) · Wind & Battery Storage · Australia
cards.description: CIP’s CI V acquired 100% of Gawara Baya from Windlab, comprising 408MW of onshore wind and 104MW of battery storage in North Queensland. The project secured A$1.7bn of financing and targets full operations in 2030; the acquisition price was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: A$1.7bn project financing, not acquisition consideration; 408MW wind and 104MW battery storage.

cards.title: Azura Power | Actis
cards.metadata: Actis (Sale) · Power Generation · Nigeria / Senegal / Mozambique
cards.description: ePointZero agreed to acquire the combined 90% interest in Azura held by Actis and Africa50, with Amaya retaining 10%. The platform has 752MW of operating generation across Nigeria, Senegal and Mozambique and a development pipeline exceeding 1.5GW; consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 752MW operating portfolio; more than 1.5GW development pipeline; consideration undisclosed.

cards.title: Silkstead | Equitix
cards.metadata: Equitix (Bolt-On) · Battery Storage · United Kingdom
cards.description: Equitix-backed Eelpower Energy acquired the 50MW/200MWh Silkstead battery-storage project near Winchester from Balanced Grid Works. Construction is expected to begin in 2027, with operations targeted for 2028; consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 50MW/200MWh development-stage battery project; consideration undisclosed.

cards.title: Kelvion | Apollo
cards.metadata: Apollo (Sale) · Data Center Cooling · Germany / Global
cards.description: SLB agreed to acquire 100% of Kelvion from Apollo-managed funds for US$3.4bn in cash plus US$700mm of assumed debt, implying ~US$4.1bn enterprise value. The Germany-based heat-exchange business serves data centers and industrial markets, with closing expected in the first half of 2027.
cards.scaleNote: ~US$4.1bn enterprise value: US$3.4bn cash plus US$700mm assumed debt.

cards.title: Tokyo DC4 / DC5 | GIC
cards.metadata: GIC (Sale) · Data Centers · Japan
cards.description: Keppel DC REIT and Keppel agreed to acquire a combined 90% of two fully occupied Inzai data centers at ¥190bn on a 100% basis. GIC reportedly exits its 80% interest while Equinix retains 10%; the two facilities provide 163,294 sq ft of net lettable area.
cards.scaleNote: ¥190bn consideration on a 100% basis; combined 90% acquisition; GIC-specific proceeds undisclosed.

cards.title: Peregrine–Sinar Primera JV | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak (Joint Venture) · Cold Storage · Indonesia
cards.description: Stonepeak-backed Peregrine Cold Logistics formed a JV with Sinar Primera to acquire an existing Pluit cold-storage facility and develop a second site in Narogong. The two sites are expected to provide ~35,000 sq m of combined capacity; consideration and ownership percentages were undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: ~35,000 sq m combined expected capacity across an existing asset and a development; broader two-site JV ranked before regional student-transportation add-on.

cards.title: Safe-Way Bus / Safe-Way Wisconsin | Tiger Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Tiger Infrastructure (Bolt-On) · Student Transportation · United States
cards.description: Tiger Infrastructure-backed Reliant Transportation agreed to acquire all equity in Safe-Way Bus and Safe-Way Wisconsin, subject to STB approval. The businesses serve five school districts from four terminals across Minnesota and Wisconsin; the purchase price was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Five school-district contracts and four terminals across Minnesota and Wisconsin; price undisclosed.

cards.title: Brazos Midland | EnCap Flatrock
cards.metadata: EnCap Flatrock (Portfolio Company Divestiture) · Gas Gathering & Processing · United States
cards.description: ONEOK agreed to acquire 100% of Brazos Midland from EnCap Flatrock-backed Brazos Midstream Holdings III for US$4.425bn. The Permian business has ~600,000 dedicated acres and fixed-fee contracts with an average remaining term exceeding 12 years.
cards.scaleNote: US$4.425bn acquisition of all membership interests in Brazos Midland.

cards.title: WL Bau | Swiss Life
cards.metadata: Swiss Life (Bolt-On) · Modular Buildings · Switzerland
cards.description: Swiss Life-backed Condecta acquired modular-building specialist WL Bau, with completion on August 31 first disclosed on September 1. WL Bau’s 25-person team will move from Meggen to Condecta’s Wikon facility, expanding its Swiss modular-construction capabilities; consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 25 target employees; buyer facility dimensions excluded from target scale; price undisclosed.

cards.title: Adani Airport Holdings | BlackRock / Temasek
cards.metadata: BlackRock / Temasek Consortium (Primary Capital Raise) · Airports · India
cards.description: Adani Airport Holdings signed binding agreements to raise approximately US$1bn from BlackRock-managed funds, Temasek, Alpha Wave Global and Premji Invest for a combined approximately 5.54% stake. The eight-airport operator plans to fund airport expansion, airport-city development and ancillary businesses; subscriptions are scheduled in three tranches through July 2027.
cards.scaleNote: Approximately US$1bn primary equity investment; ranked by capital raised rather than US$18bn pre-money valuation.

cards.title: VTG Rail UK | USS
cards.metadata: USS (Buyout) · Railcar Leasing · United Kingdom
cards.description: USS agreed to acquire all shares in VTG Rail UK from VTG, whose infrastructure investors include GIP, ADIA Infra and OMERS Infra. The business leases approximately 4,500 freight rail vehicles in the UK; financial terms were not disclosed and completion is expected in Q4 2026.
cards.scaleNote: Approximately 4,500 freight rail vehicles; larger disclosed fleet than SNTA; direct USS acquisition and portfolio-company seller counted once.

cards.title: SNTA / Transports Auran | Cube Infra
cards.metadata: Cube Infra / CFTR (PortCo Acquisition) · Bus & Coach Transport · France
cards.description: Cube Infra-backed CFTR signed an agreement to acquire 100% of SNTA, expanding across southern France. The group operates nearly 450 vehicles under nine brands, providing scheduled, school and tourism services, and generated €46.5mm of revenue in 2025; the purchase price was not disclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Nearly 450 vehicles; €46.5mm is annual revenue, not transaction value.

cards.title: Invenergy 2.7 GW Renewables Portfolio | CDPQ
cards.metadata: CDPQ / Invenergy (Joint Venture) · Solar, Storage & Wind · United States
cards.description: CDPQ-backed Invenergy and HASI closed an equity partnership covering 10 solar, solar-plus-storage and wind projects totaling 2.7 GW across seven U.S. states. More than 850 MW is operating, with the remaining projects expected online by Q1 2027; Invenergy retains majority ownership and HASI funds its investments as projects reach commercial operation.
cards.scaleNote: 2.7 GW across ten projects; multi-project generation portfolio precedes the single grid-stability asset; equity amount undisclosed.

cards.title: Blackhillock Synchronous Condenser | Foresight
cards.metadata: Foresight (Buyout) · Grid Stability · United Kingdom
cards.description: A Foresight-managed fund acquired the operational Blackhillock synchronous condenser in northeast Scotland from GIP-managed funds. Operating since July 2025, the asset provides approximately 2 GVA of short-circuit capacity to support electricity-system stability as renewable generation expands; terms were not disclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Single operational grid-stability asset providing approximately 2 GVA; not directly comparable with generation MW; price undisclosed.

cards.title: Tallgrass Crude Transportation Business | Blackstone
cards.metadata: Blackstone / Tallgrass (PortCo Divestiture) · Crude Pipelines & Storage · United States
cards.description: Blackstone-backed Tallgrass agreed to sell its crude transportation business to Enbridge for US$2.55bn, including 75% of Pony Express, 51% of Powder River Gateway and approximately 8.4mm barrels of storage. The assets connect Rockies production to Cushing and include the contracted Pony Express expansion; closing is expected later in 2026, subject to approvals.
cards.scaleNote: US$2.55bn cash consideration; largest disclosed Midstream transaction.

cards.title: Spectrum LNG Assets | Antin Infra
cards.metadata: Antin Infra / Sapphire Gas Solutions (PortCo Acquisition) · Distributed LNG · United States
cards.description: Antin Infra-backed Sapphire Gas Solutions acquired Spectrum LNG's assets, including the Desert Gas LNG plant in Ehrenberg, Arizona, and an expansion site in Stroud, Oklahoma. The operating plant produces up to 76,000 gallons per day and provides 100,000 gallons of storage, extending Sapphire's distributed LNG supply footprint; terms were not disclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 76,000 gallons per day of operating LNG production; purchase price undisclosed.

cards.title: Secure Electronic Registries Victoria | Macquarie AM
cards.metadata: Macquarie AM (Joint Venture) · Land Registry Concession · Australia
cards.description: Macquarie AM's Global Infrastructure Fund agreed to acquire 50% of Secure Electronic Registries Victoria from Aware Super, which retains the remaining half. SERV administers Victoria's land register under a 40-year concession granted in 2018 and processes more than 9mm transactions annually; completion is expected in Q4 2026, subject to approvals.
cards.scaleNote: Statewide land-registry concession handling more than 9mm transactions annually; breadth of essential public service ranks ahead of narrower site portfolios; consideration undisclosed.

cards.title: Westerleigh Group | ICG Infra
cards.metadata: ICG Infra (Buyout) · Crematoria · United Kingdom
cards.description: ICG Infra agreed to acquire Westerleigh Group from Ontario Teachers and USS, alongside the existing management team. The UK's largest private crematorium operator and developer has 42 sites, including 21 opened since 2016; financial terms were not disclosed and completion is expected in Q4 2026.
cards.scaleNote: 42 UK crematoria; nationwide operating-platform footprint; transaction value undisclosed.

cards.title: VodafoneZiggo Towers | DigitalBridge / L&G / TD AM
cards.metadata: DigitalBridge / L&G / TD AM (Buyout) · Telecom Towers · Netherlands
cards.description: Funds managed by DigitalBridge, L&G and TD AM agreed to acquire VodafoneZiggo's Dutch tower assets for €669mm. The consortium plans to combine the assets with Belgium Tower Partners, creating an independent platform with more than 6,600 sites across the Netherlands and Belgium, subject to regulatory approvals and consultation.
cards.scaleNote: €669mm consideration disclosed by Liberty Global; more than 6,600 sites refers to the combined platform, not the acquired portfolio alone.

cards.title: Onuba Green Hydrogen Project | Hy24
cards.metadata: Hy24 (Minority Stake) · Green Hydrogen · Spain
cards.description: Hy24, a 50:50 joint venture between Ardian and FiveT Hydrogen, and COFIDES agreed to acquire a combined 29% stake in Moeve’s Onuba project in Huelva, with Hy24 investing through its Clean Hydrogen Infrastructure Fund. The 300 MW first phase involves more than €1bn of total project investment, with a further 105 MW expansion option; that figure is project cost, not the price of the minority stake.
cards.scaleNote: More than €1bn total project investment; 300 MW first phase, with 105 MW optional expansion. Disclosed project economics precede the unpriced Astoria stake sale.

cards.title: Astoria Energy II | Harbert
cards.metadata: Harbert (Sale) · Gas-Fired Power · U.S.
cards.description: Harbert-managed Gulf Pacific Power agreed to sell its 45.0549% indirect interest in Astoria Energy II to EGCO New York, with terms undisclosed. The 615 MW combined-cycle gas plant in Queens supplies energy, capacity and ancillary services under a tolling agreement with the New York Power Authority; the sale remains subject to closing conditions.
cards.scaleNote: 615 MW whole-plant capacity; 45.0549% indirect stake being sold. Sponsor exit, not new Harbert deployment.

cards.title: Risti Kampus | Mirova
cards.metadata: Mirova (Joint Venture) · Data Centers · Estonia
cards.description: Mirova-backed Sunly agreed to sell 50% of the Risti Kampus project to Magnora Data Center, forming a 50:50 development joint venture. The campus targets 180 MW in its first phase and up to 400 MW following substation upgrades, with access to Sunly’s adjacent renewable-energy park; transaction value was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 180 MW phase one; potential 400 MW requires upgrades. Quantified development scale ranks ahead of unpriced, unquantified platform acquisitions.

cards.title: Epic Communications | GSAM
cards.metadata: GSAM (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Telecom Networks · Malta
cards.description: GSAM-backed Melita agreed to acquire 100% of Epic Communications from Monaco Telecom, combining two of Malta’s leading fixed and mobile network operators. The transaction, whose value was undisclosed, aims to support further network investment and remains subject to merger-control and other regulatory approvals.
cards.scaleNote: National operating-network acquisition; no disclosed transaction value or target-specific customer quantum. Ranked after the quantified Risti development project.

cards.title: OPAL Pipeline | Hy24
cards.metadata: Hy24 (Minority Stake) · Hydrogen Transmission · Germany
cards.description: Hy24, a 50:50 joint venture between Ardian and FiveT Hydrogen, agreed through its Clean Hydrogen Infrastructure Fund to acquire Uniper’s 20% interest in OPAL through the purchase of Lubmin-Brandov Assets. The 470 km pipeline corridor is being repurposed for Germany’s hydrogen core network, connecting the Baltic coast with the Czech border; financial terms were undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 470 km whole-corridor length; 20% indirect interest acquired. Financial terms undisclosed.

cards.title: BauWatch | CVC DIF
cards.metadata: CVC DIF (Majority Stake) · Security Infrastructure · Europe
cards.description: CVC DIF’s Value-Add IV fund and Carlyle Europe Partners agreed to acquire BauWatch from Haniel, which will retain 10%. The Netherlands-based security platform operates more than 15,000 surveillance systems across 12 European markets, serving construction sites and critical infrastructure; closing is expected in Q1 2027, subject to regulatory approvals.
cards.scaleNote: More than 15,000 active surveillance systems across 12 European markets. Value undisclosed; CVC DIF infrastructure fund is the qualification trigger.

cards.title: Nordic Storage Platform | Mirova
cards.metadata: Mirova (Equity Investment) · Battery Storage · Finland / Sweden
cards.description: Mirova committed €65mm of equity to two Ingrid Capacity battery projects totaling 145 MW / 290 MWh. The 45 MW Finnish project is ready to build; the 100 MW Swedish project is expected to reach that stage in 2027, with Ingrid developing, operating and optimizing both systems.
cards.scaleNote: €65mm equity investment; largest disclosed new capital commitment.

cards.title: Puerta de Oro | Patria
cards.metadata: Patria (Sale) · Solar · Colombia
cards.description: Patria agreed to sell its entire stake in Puerta de Oro to ISAGEN through Infrastructure Fund V. The operating 360 MWp solar project in Cundinamarca is expected to generate 728 GWh annually; the sale remains subject to regulatory approvals and financial terms were not disclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 360 MWp operating solar project; sale consideration undisclosed.

cards.title: AMPYR Distributed Energy | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak (Growth Investment) · Distributed Renewables · United Kingdom / Europe
cards.description: Stonepeak agreed an equity investment in AMPYR Distributed Energy, with AGP retaining an interest. The platform has contracted 250 MW across 200 commercial and industrial sites and has a pipeline exceeding 1 GW, providing a base for further onsite renewable-energy deployment across the UK and Europe.
cards.scaleNote: 250 MW contracted across 200 sites; pipeline exceeds 1 GW; equity value undisclosed.

cards.title: Enerfarm | Macquarie
cards.metadata: Macquarie (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Bioenergy · Italy
cards.description: Macquarie-backed VORN Bioenergy acquired Enerfarm from Equitix, adding five biogas and biomethane plants and a composting facility in northern Italy. The portfolio is expected to produce more than 215 GWh annually once fully operational, with conversion permits secured for four plants; financial terms were not disclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Five biogas/biomethane plants plus composting; expected annual production above 215 GWh after conversion.

cards.title: Generate Upcycle UK | Asterion
cards.metadata: Asterion (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Bioenergy · United Kingdom
cards.description: Asterion-backed ABIO, through Pinta Energy, acquired Generate Upcycle’s seven UK anaerobic-digestion facilities from Generate Capital. The transaction transfers the UK operating portfolio to a European biogas platform; consideration was not disclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Seven UK facilities; largest disclosed site count among this week’s bioenergy portfolios; separate from North American sale.

cards.title: Generate Upcycle North America | GIP
cards.metadata: GIP (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Renewable Natural Gas · United States / Canada
cards.description: GIP-backed Vanguard Renewables agreed to acquire Generate Upcycle’s five operating facilities in upstate New York and Ontario from Generate Capital. The portfolio adds 565,000 tons of annual food-waste processing capacity and 1.1bn cubic feet of annual renewable natural gas production, expanding Vanguard’s footprint to 19 sites; closing is expected October 1.
cards.scaleNote: Five North American organic-waste facilities with 1.1bn cubic feet annual RNG capacity; separate from the seven-site UK sale.

cards.title: Burgess Diagnostics | CVC DIF
cards.metadata: CVC DIF (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Diagnostic Imaging · United Kingdom / Ireland
cards.description: CVC DIF-backed Medneo UK acquired Burgess Diagnostics, extending its imaging platform into veterinary services across the UK and Ireland. Burgess brings more than 20 years of specialist experience, adding a new customer segment to Medneo’s existing diagnostic-imaging operations; consideration was not disclosed.
cards.scaleNote: No transaction value or comparable asset quantum disclosed.

cards.title: WestConnex / NorthWestern Roads Group | CPP
cards.metadata: CPP (Sale) · Toll roads · Australia
cards.description: CPP agreed to sell its 10.5% interest in WestConnex and 25% interest in NorthWestern Roads Group to Transurban for expected gross proceeds of A$4.5bn. The Sydney assets include Westlink M7 and NorthConnex.
cards.scaleNote: A$4.5bn expected gross proceeds for the bundled stake sale

cards.title: Hector Rail | InfraRed / Ancala
cards.metadata: InfraRed (Buyout) · Rail freight · Scandinavia / Germany
cards.description: InfraRed-managed funds agreed to acquire 100% of Hector Rail from Ancala. The independent rail-freight operator runs around 100 electric locomotives across Scandinavia and Germany.
cards.scaleNote: Around 100 electric locomotives across Scandinavia and Germany; value undisclosed

cards.title: Liberty Development Partners | Wafra
cards.metadata: Wafra (Platform Acquisition) · Rail infrastructure · U.S.
cards.description: Wafra-advised funds invested in Liberty and its Gulf Inland Logistics Park and CMC Railroad assets near Houston. The 3,900-acre park connects to Union Pacific and BNSF through CMC, which provides switching and storage capacity for over 1,000 railcars.
cards.scaleNote: 3,900-acre integrated platform with operating railroad and storage capacity for over 1,000 railcars; value undisclosed

cards.title: Omni Air International | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak (PortCo Divestiture) · Passenger aviation · U.S.
cards.description: Stonepeak-backed ATSG agreed to sell Omni Air International to OAI Holdings. The Tulsa-based airline provides passenger charter and aircraft, crew, maintenance and insurance services in over 80 countries annually; ATSG will focus on cargo aviation after closing.
cards.scaleNote: Global passenger charter and ACMI platform serving over 80 countries annually; value undisclosed

cards.title: HP Helicopters | Antin Infra
cards.metadata: Antin Infra (Majority Stake) · Specialty aviation · U.S.
cards.description: Antin Infra's NextGen Infrastructure Fund I acquired a majority stake in HP Helicopters, with founder Brad Bauder retaining a minority interest. The operator provides heavy-lift services for utilities, firefighting and other customers across ten Western U.S. states.
cards.scaleNote: Specialty aviation operating across ten Western U.S. states; value undisclosed

cards.title: AJ Myers and Sons | CVC DIF
cards.metadata: CVC DIF (PortCo Acquisition) · Student transportation · U.S.
cards.description: CVC DIF-backed American Student Transportation Partners acquired AJ Myers and Sons through Krise Transportation. The acquisition adds an established student-transport operator in western Pennsylvania to ASTP's contracted school-bus platform.
cards.scaleNote: Regional student-transport add-on; transaction value and target fleet size undisclosed

cards.title: Hardisty DRU / Port Arthur Terminal | ECP
cards.metadata: ECP (PortCo Divestiture) · Crude-oil logistics · Canada / U.S.
cards.description: A Jefferson Energy affiliate agreed to acquire a 50% stake in the Hardisty Diluent Recovery Unit from ECP-backed USD Group, alongside Port Arthur Terminal, for US$255mm total cash consideration. The bundled assets connect Alberta crude supply with Gulf Coast refining; the disclosed price covers the entire package.
cards.scaleNote: US$255mm total bundled consideration, including the qualifying 50% Hardisty DRU stake and accompanying Port Arthur Terminal

cards.title: Cisternina Logistics | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR (Majority Stake) · Liquid storage / Logistics · India
cards.description: KKR signed definitive agreements for a majority investment in Cisternina through its Asia Pacific infrastructure strategy. The investment supports the proposed acquisition of GBL's terminal and rail businesses, with around 500,000 KL of operating and under-construction storage capacity, as the platform's anchor assets.
cards.scaleNote: Anchor terminal business has around 500,000 KL operating and under-construction capacity; majority-investment amount undisclosed

cards.title: Central Tank Terminal | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR (Sale) · Tank storage · Japan
cards.description: KKR agreed to sell Central Tank Terminal to an institutional investor. The Japanese platform operates 12 terminals, more than 450 tanks and over 420,000 KL of storage capacity; financial terms were not disclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 12 Japanese terminals, over 450 tanks and over 420,000 KL of storage capacity; value undisclosed

cards.title: Central Terminal Korea | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR (Sale) · Tank storage / Grain logistics · South Korea
cards.description: Under a separate agreement, KKR will sell Central Terminal Korea to an institutional investor. The business operates a tank-terminal complex in Ulsan and grain-silo facilities in Ulsan and Pyeongtaek; financial terms were not disclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Ulsan tank-terminal complex and grain-silo facilities in Ulsan and Pyeongtaek; value undisclosed

cards.title: Vector Renewables | J.P. Morgan AM
cards.metadata: J.P. Morgan AM (PortCo Divestiture) · Renewable-energy services · Spain
cards.description: IIF-backed Nadara sold its entire stake in Madrid-based Vector Renewables to Algebris Green Transition Fund. The global renewable-energy services business manages over 6 GW of assets and provides technical advisory, legal advisory and digital solutions.
cards.scaleNote: Global renewable-energy services platform with over 6 GW of assets under management, distinct from owned generation; value undisclosed

cards.title: Pinnacle IV | Ares
cards.metadata: Ares (PortCo Divestiture) · Wind / Solar · U.S.
cards.description: Ares-backed Apex sold a 49% interest in Pinnacle IV to EGCO, retaining 51%. The 339 MW operating portfolio comprises 189 MW Timbermill Wind in North Carolina and 150 MW Coldwater Solar in Michigan.
cards.scaleNote: 339 MW operating portfolio; 49% equity stake sold and value undisclosed

cards.title: Mesa View BESS | EnCap
cards.metadata: EnCap (Project Equity) · Battery storage · U.S.
cards.description: EnCap-backed Linea secured a preferred-equity commitment from DESRI for the 250 MW / 500 MWh Mesa View battery project in Upton County, Texas. The project is expected online in 2027; the equity investment amount was not disclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 250 MW / 500 MWh battery project; preferred-equity commitment undisclosed and debt excluded

cards.title: Vicinity Energy | Harrison Street / Antin Infra
cards.metadata: Harrison Street (Majority Stake) · District energy · U.S.
cards.description: Antin Infra's Flagship Fund IV agreed to sell a majority interest in Vicinity Energy to Harrison Street at a US$2.92bn enterprise value for the whole company. Vicinity operates 19 district-energy systems across 12 U.S. cities; the valuation is distinct from the undisclosed majority-stake purchase price.
cards.scaleNote: US$2.92bn whole-company enterprise value; majority-stake price undisclosed

cards.title: Wärme Moselbogen | Asterion
cards.metadata: Asterion (Joint Venture) · District heating · Germany
cards.description: Asterion-backed Iqony Energies signed a 50:50 district-heating joint venture with evm in Koblenz. Wärme Moselbogen combines existing networks and plans to connect around 500 additional buildings by 2034, with operations starting October 1.
cards.scaleNote: Existing-network district-heating JV with around 500 additional buildings planned by 2034; value undisclosed

cards.title: Honeycomb 2 Utah storage portfolio | GIP
cards.metadata: GIP (Portfolio Company Acquisition) · Battery Storage · United States
cards.description: GIP-backed Clearway Energy agreed to acquire Class A interests in three Utah battery storage projects totaling 210MW for ~US$119mm from an affiliated Clearway seller. The private agreement was signed October 1 and first publicly filed October 7; closing is expected in Q4 2027.
cards.scaleNote: US$119mm base price for Class A equity interests; 210MW development portfolio; first public disclosure October 7

cards.title: Spanish solar development portfolio | Ardian
cards.metadata: Ardian (Portfolio Company Divestiture) · Solar · Spain
cards.description: Ardian-backed Akuo agreed to sell three early-stage solar projects totaling over 500MW to Dos Grados. Located in Castilla y León and Andalucía, the projects expand the buyer’s Iberian development portfolio; consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Over 500MW across three early-stage projects; largest disclosed MW quantum among the week’s renewable portfolios without a price

cards.title: Papago Storage | Harbert
cards.metadata: Harbert (Buyout) · Battery Storage · United States
cards.description: Harbert Power acquired the 300MW Papago battery storage project in Maricopa County, Arizona. The acquisition expands its contracted power infrastructure footprint alongside the 150MW Justice storage project in the same county; transaction value was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 300MW acquired project, excluding the separate 150MW Justice asset; consideration undisclosed

cards.title: Polish battery storage portfolio | Actis
cards.metadata: Actis (Buyout) · Battery Storage · Poland
cards.description: Actis acquired DRI’s 112MW / 518MWh Kozienice project at ready-to-build stage and signed the purchase of 132MW / 623MWh Trzebinia, with completion expected upon operation. The combined 244MW / 1,141MWh portfolio benefits from 17-year inflation-indexed capacity contracts; consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 244MW / 1,141MWh bundled portfolio: one ready-to-build acquisition and one signed forward purchase

cards.title: Via Verde | CIP
cards.metadata: CIP (Primary Capital Raise) · Biomethane · Italy
cards.description: CIP’s Advanced Bioenergy Fund II invested in Via Verde, an Italian biomethane platform with 20 development projects across regions including Lombardy, Abruzzo and Campania. At full operation, the portfolio is expected to produce ~1TWh annually; the investment amount and ownership stake were undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 20-project biomethane platform targeting ~1TWh annual output; cross-technology scale measured by platform breadth, ahead of the smaller two-plant solar package

cards.title: Italian operating solar portfolio | J.P. Morgan AM
cards.metadata: J.P. Morgan AM (Bolt-On) · Solar · Italy
cards.description: Sonnedix, backed by the Infrastructure Investments Fund advised by J.P. Morgan AM, acquired ~54MWp of operating solar assets from EOS ReNewable Infrastructure Fund II. The two plants comprise 46.5MWp in Sardinia and 7.4MWp in Lazio, with most Sardinian capacity supported by a 20-year incentive tariff; consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: ~54MWp across two operating plants; distinct from EOS’s separate 194MWp March disposal

cards.title: Accelergen Energy | Fengate
cards.metadata: Fengate (Buyout) · Solar & Storage · United States
cards.description: Fengate Infrastructure Fund V and affiliates acquired Accelergen Energy and seven solar-plus-storage and standalone battery development projects in SPP and WECC markets. The management team will advance the acquired portfolio and pursue further development and acquisitions; project capacity and purchase price were undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Seven-project development platform; capacity undisclosed, so ranked after portfolios with quantified output or capacity

cards.title: Forged Fiber 37 / Gigapower JV | GIP / CPP
cards.metadata: GIP / CPP (Joint Venture) · Fiber Networks · United States
cards.description: GIP and CPP agreed with AT&T to combine Forged Fiber 37 and Gigapower into a U.S. wholesale fiber JV spanning nearly 5mm locations and over 1mm AT&T fiber subscribers across 16 states. AT&T will own 50%, with GIP and CPP collectively holding 50%; closing is expected in H1 2027 and investment value was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Nearly 5mm fiber locations across 16 states; widest disclosed operating network footprint in the week’s digital activity

cards.title: Zerra DC | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak (Primary Capital Raise) · Data Centers · Asia-Pacific
cards.description: Macquarie Capital invested in Zerra DC, the hyperscale data center platform established by Stonepeak-backed AGP, which remains the majority shareholder. The funding supports a pipeline exceeding 2GW of planned IT capacity across Australia, Japan and India; the investment amount and new stake were undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Over 2GW planned IT capacity across three countries; platform equity investment, distinct from the earlier Western Downs project arrangement

cards.title: Sabey Data Center Properties | Ares
cards.metadata: Ares (Minority Stake) · Data Centers · United States
cards.description: Ares made an additional equity commitment to Sabey Data Center Properties, expanding its July minority investment in the U.S. platform. Sabey owns and operates 275MW, with an expansion pipeline targeting ~737MW by 2033; Ares’ cumulative commitment exceeds US$500mm, while the new increment was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 275MW operating platform; 737MW expansion target and US$500mm-plus cumulative commitment are not this week’s incremental transaction size

cards.title: IBM VMware enterprise customer business | Tiger Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Tiger Infrastructure (Bolt-On) · Managed Cloud Infrastructure · United States / Global
cards.description: Tiger Infrastructure-backed 11:11 Systems acquired selected IBM VMware Cloud Service Provider enterprise customers. Its eighth VMware-related acquisition broadens the platform’s cloud infrastructure and migration services across global markets; transaction terms and the acquired customer count were undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Global customer-business carve-out from U.S.-headquartered IBM; region assigned to North America by seller origin; acquired customer count undisclosed

cards.title: Perth Airport | AustralianSuper
cards.metadata: AustralianSuper (Minority Stake) · Airports · Australia
cards.description: AustralianSuper confirmed an increased investment in Perth Airport, reported as a 9.14% stake purchase for more than A$600mm, taking its ownership to ~29.4%. The airport is planning a new runway and terminal under a major expansion program; the stake and price figures are reported rather than officially quantified.
cards.scaleNote: Reported consideration above A$600mm for an additional 9.14% stake; ownership reportedly ~29.4%; not the airport expansion budget

cards.title: C3 Limited | InfraRed
cards.metadata: InfraRed (Buyout) · Port Logistics · New Zealand / Australia
cards.description: An InfraRed value-add fund agreed to acquire C3 from Brookfield. The port logistics and materials-handling platform operates 15 strategic port and inland sites across New Zealand and Australia, handles around half of New Zealand’s log exports and about half of containers at Tauranga; consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 15 strategic port and inland sites; national export infrastructure platform; value undisclosed

cards.title: Xcel Michigan electric utilities | Axium
cards.metadata: Axium (Bolt-On) · Regulated Electric Utilities · United States
cards.description: Axium-owned UPPCO agreed to acquire Xcel Energy’s regulated electric transmission and distribution operations in Michigan. The assets serve ~9,000 customers and include 470 miles of distribution and 110 miles of transmission lines in Gogebic and Ontonagon counties; closing is expected in 2027 subject to regulatory approval.
cards.scaleNote: ~9,000 acquired customers and 580 miles of wires; excludes UPPCO’s existing customer base; price undisclosed

cards.title: Leppäkosken Lämpö | CVC DIF
cards.metadata: CVC DIF (Bolt-On) · District Heating · Finland
cards.description: CVC DIF-backed Loimua signed the acquisition of Leppäkosken Lämpö from Leppäkoski Group. The target supplies district heating in six Finnish municipalities and also distributes natural gas, with ~250GWh of heat sales in 2025; consideration was undisclosed and completion is expected by year-end.
cards.scaleNote: Six acquired district-heating municipalities and ~250GWh annual heat sales; the buyer’s enlarged 100,000-plus end-user base is excluded from target scale

cards.title: Degotte | GSAM
cards.metadata: GSAM (Bolt-On) · Modular Social Infrastructure · Belgium / Luxembourg
cards.description: GSAM-backed Adapteo signed the acquisition of Belgian modular-space provider Degotte, with closing expected at the end of October. Degotte has delivered over 6,000 modules across more than 2,000 projects in Belgium and Luxembourg, serving public-sector, defense, education and healthcare customers; consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Over 6,000 modules delivered historically across more than 2,000 projects, not a current rental fleet; regional platform footprint; consideration undisclosed

cards.title: Texas / Ohio solar portfolio | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR (Joint Venture) · Solar · United States
cards.description: KKR and TotalEnergies signed an agreement to add three U.S. solar assets totaling 700MW to their existing 50/50 JV at US$1.2bn enterprise value. The projects are expected to enter commercial operation by Q1 2027; TotalEnergies will remain operator and completion is expected in 2026.
cards.scaleNote: US$1.2bn enterprise value for the new 700MW portfolio; excludes the earlier 1.4GW JV transaction

cards.title: Five UK wind farm minority interests | Schroders Greencoat
cards.target: Five UK wind farm minority interests
cards.metadata: Schroders Greencoat (Minority Stake) · Onshore Wind · United Kingdom
cards.description: Greencoat UK Wind acquired EDF Invest’s remaining 20% interests in five operating wind farms with 96.4MW of total capacity for ~£10.5mm, increasing ownership to 100%. Full control supports life-extension and potential repowering work; the acquired capacity interest is 19.28MW.
cards.scaleNote: £10.5mm consideration for 20% interests; 96.4MW gross portfolio, 19.28MW acquired proportion

cards.title: Statera operating energy portfolio | Ares
cards.metadata: Ares (Minority Stake) · Storage & Flexible Generation · United Kingdom
cards.description: Ares Infrastructure Equity funds acquired a significant minority stake in EQT Infrastructure VI-backed Statera’s ~1.9GW operating storage and flexible-generation portfolio. Assets include 680MW Carrington Storage and 750MW Thurrock Flexible Generation; the stake percentage and consideration were undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 1.9GW operating portfolio underlying the minority investment; excludes Statera’s 16GW development pipeline

cards.title: Five Estuaries | CIP / Macquarie AM
cards.metadata: CIP / Macquarie AM (Minority Stake / Sale) · Offshore Wind · United Kingdom
cards.description: CIP’s Infrastructure V acquired the Macquarie-led consortium’s 25% interest in Five Estuaries, an up-to-1,080MW offshore wind development off Essex and Suffolk. The project received development consent in December 2025; the acquired interest represents up to 270MW and consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Up to 1,080MW gross consented development; 25% acquired, equivalent to up to 270MW

cards.title: Ixus Bugallon solar project | GIP
cards.metadata: GIP (Minority Stake Sale) · Solar · Philippines
cards.description: GIP-backed Vena Energy signed agreements for Norfund and Impact Fund Denmark to invest a combined 49% in its 500MWp Ixus Bugallon solar project. Vena retains ownership and operational involvement; completion requires Philippine competition approval and customary conditions, and equity consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 500MWp project capacity underlying 49% stake; earlier US$310mm project debt is not equity consideration

cards.title: Korean industrial rooftop solar JV | Stonepeak
cards.metadata: Stonepeak (Joint Venture) · Solar · South Korea
cards.description: Stonepeak-owned Peak Energy formed a JV with the Hyundai Motor Securities-backed Vencore Rooftop Equity Fund to develop industrial rooftop solar for automotive suppliers. The platform targets 100MW within two years and identifies five initial supplier projects; investment value was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 100MW deployment target, not operating capacity; five initial supplier projects; October 13 report followed by October 14 issuer release

cards.title: Swedish / Finnish wind portfolio | Ardian
cards.metadata: Ardian (Bolt-On) · Onshore Wind · Sweden / Finland
cards.description: Enordic Evergreen, wholly owned by Ardian Clean Energy Evergreen Fund, acquired three operating wind farms totaling 73.2MW. The portfolio comprises Anneberg and Sötterfällan in Sweden and Silovuori in Finland; consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 73.2MW acquired operating capacity across three wind farms

cards.title: Hynamics | Hy24
cards.metadata: Hy24 (Buyout) · Low-Carbon Hydrogen · France / United Kingdom
cards.description: Hy24’s Clean Hydrogen Infrastructure Fund signed an agreement to acquire Hynamics from EDF Pulse Ventures. The platform develops and supplies low-carbon hydrogen for industry and heavy mobility in France and the UK; consideration was undisclosed and closing is expected in Q1 2027, subject to approvals.
cards.scaleNote: Corporate hydrogen platform acquisition; no comparable acquired capacity or purchase price disclosed

cards.title: Pacific Ag | Ara Partners
cards.metadata: Ara Partners (Majority Stake) · Agricultural Feedstock Logistics · United States
cards.description: Ara Infrastructure Fund I acquired a majority interest in Pacific Ag. The business operates a national crop-residue harvesting, storage and logistics network supplying dairies, animal-protein producers and other end markets; the investment supports expansion and consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: National harvesting, storage and logistics platform breadth; asset count and economics undisclosed, ranked ahead of a single-depot add-on

cards.title: De Gunst SSAN logistics operations | Macquarie AM
cards.metadata: Macquarie AM (Bolt-On) · Specialist Bulk Logistics · Australia
cards.description: Macquarie infrastructure-backed Qube acquired De Gunst Transport’s security-sensitive ammonium nitrate logistics operations, including a depot in Gracemere, Queensland. Completion on October 9 was first publicly confirmed in October 12 coverage, expanding Qube’s mine-resupply and dangerous-goods platform; consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: One identified acquired depot and specialist logistics operations; national-platform scale not attributed to the target

cards.title: Marius Pedersen Czech / Slovak operations | Vauban
cards.metadata: Vauban (Bolt-On) · Waste Management · Czech Republic / Slovakia
cards.description: Vauban-backed Paprec signed the acquisition of Marius Pedersen’s Czech and Slovak waste-management operations. The acquired network comprises 49 subsidiaries and JVs handling nearly 3mm tonnes annually and serving over 2,000 municipalities; consideration was undisclosed and competition approvals remain pending.
cards.scaleNote: Nearly 3mm tonnes annual acquired throughput across 49 subsidiaries and JVs; excludes Paprec’s enlarged group footprint

cards.title: Orchard Healthcare Group | Wren House
cards.metadata: Wren House (Bolt-On) · Specialist Dementia Care · United Kingdom
cards.description: Wren House-owned Voyage Care completed the acquisition of Orchard Healthcare Group, expanding its specialist dementia and complex mental-health care capabilities. Orchard will continue operating separately within the group; purchase price and acquired bed capacity were undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Specialist care add-on; acquired bed capacity and consideration undisclosed

cards.title: PISCES subsea cable JV | Equitix
cards.metadata: Equitix (Joint Venture) · Subsea Fiber · Ireland / France / Spain / Portugal
cards.description: Equitix Infra Ireland formed PISCES Cable System Limited with MDM and Orange to deliver a ~3,125km, 16-fiber-pair subsea cable linking Ireland directly with continental Europe. The greenfield system targets deployment in 2028 and benefits from EU co-funding; the partners’ equity commitment was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: ~3,125km greenfield cable with 16 fiber pairs; equity commitment undisclosed

cards.title: Ashtead Technology | Ember Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Ember Infrastructure (Buyout) · Subsea Technology · United Kingdom
cards.description: Ember Infrastructure agreed to acquire Ashtead Technology for 615p per share, valuing its equity at ~£505mm. The subsea equipment and services platform supports offshore energy infrastructure; the recommended cash offer follows September’s non-binding approach and is subject to shareholder and other approvals.
cards.scaleNote: £505mm equity value; exceeds the other disclosed consideration amounts in this sector

cards.title: Oklahoma wind portfolio — 49% stake | Ares
cards.metadata: Ares (Minority Stake) · Onshore Wind · United States
cards.description: Ares Infrastructure funds acquired 49% of TransAlta’s 500MW Oklahoma wind portfolio for US$305mm. The three operating wind farms have long-term contracts with investment-grade counterparties, while TransAlta retains operational oversight under an asset-management agreement.
cards.scaleNote: US$305mm consideration for 49%; 500MW gross portfolio and 245MW proportionate acquired capacity

cards.title: Electrip Global — Zorlu stake | Wren House
cards.metadata: Wren House (Minority Stake) · EV Charging · Europe / Turkey
cards.description: Wren House and Kuwait Investment Authority signed an agreement to acquire Zorlu Enerji’s remaining Electrip holding for US$147.6mm. The interest represents 41.28% of voting A ordinary shares in the EV-charging infrastructure business; Zorlu will fully exit its shareholding.
cards.scaleNote: US$147.6mm total consideration; the 41.28% figure refers specifically to voting A shares

cards.title: Ełk / Turośń Kościelna battery projects | KKR
cards.metadata: KKR (Portfolio Company Divestiture) · Battery Storage · Poland
cards.description: KKR infrastructure-backed Greenvolt Power agreed to sell two completed Polish battery projects totaling 400MW / 1.6GWh to A&R Investments. Each asset has a 17-year capacity-market contract starting in 2028 and a 10-year tolling agreement; consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 400MW / 1.6GWh across two completed battery projects; consideration undisclosed

cards.title: Lundsby Renewable Solutions business | CIP
cards.metadata: CIP (Co-Investment) · Biogas Engineering · Denmark
cards.description: CIP’s Advanced Bioenergy Fund joined majority investor CoreCapital in acquiring Lundsby’s business from its bankruptcy estate. The re-established Danish platform preserves more than 30 years of experience developing and building Nordic biogas plants; the investment amount was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: No transaction value or acquired capacity disclosed; engineering platform follows the measured operating-asset disposals

cards.title: Infinity Transportation | Ares
cards.metadata: Ares (Buyout) · Railcar Leasing · North America
cards.description: Ares Infrastructure Equity and Insurance Solutions funds agreed to acquire Infinity Transportation from KKR’s Global Atlantic for ~US$2.9bn enterprise value. Infinity owns and manages ~50,000 railcars serving more than 350 lessees across the United States, Canada and Mexico; closing is expected in Q1 2027.
cards.scaleNote: US$2.9bn enterprise value; railcar platform with ~50,000 railcars and 350+ lessees

cards.title: Associated British Ports | IFM Investors / CPP Investments / OMERS
cards.metadata: IFM Investors / CPP Investments / OMERS (Majority Stake / Sale) · Ports · United Kingdom
cards.description: An IFM Global Infrastructure Fund subsidiary signed a binding agreement to acquire CPP Investments’ and OMERS’ combined 63.88% interest in Associated British Ports. The UK’s largest ports group operates 19 facilities handling ~25% of UK seaborne trade; financial terms were undisclosed and approvals remain pending.
cards.scaleNote: 19 port facilities and ~25% of UK seaborne trade; national gateway platform ranks ahead of the regional trucking add-on

cards.title: Monson Logistics | Igneo
cards.metadata: Igneo (Bolt-On) · Freight Logistics · Australia
cards.description: Igneo’s ADIF-backed Strait Link agreed to acquire Monson Logistics from founder Bruce Monson. Monson adds 65 prime movers, four depots and ~100 employees across Tasmania and Victoria, extending Strait Link’s integrated Bass Strait freight network; consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 65 acquired prime movers and four depots; excludes Strait Link’s existing fleet

cards.title: Pilot Fiber / Boldyn NY–NJ fiber network | Fengate
cards.target: Pilot Fiber / Boldyn NY–NJ fiber network
cards.metadata: Fengate (Primary Capital Raise / Acquisition) · Fiber Networks · United States
cards.description: Fengate Infrastructure Fund V agreed to invest in Pilot Fiber and fund its acquisition of Boldyn’s New York / New Jersey metro fiber business, providing over US$330mm in total financing. The combined owned network will span more than 1,600 route miles, 1,200 buildings and 50 data centers; the equity amount was not separately disclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Over US$330mm total financing for the integrated package; this is not a disclosed equity amount

cards.title: Cleanaway Waste Management | EQT
cards.metadata: EQT (Buyout) · Waste Management · Australia
cards.description: EQT Infrastructure VI signed a binding scheme implementation deed to acquire Cleanaway for A$3.095 per share, implying ~A$9.3bn enterprise value. Cleanaway’s national network spans collection, recycling, treatment and disposal; the board-recommended transaction remains subject to shareholder, court and other conditions.
cards.scaleNote: A$9.3bn enterprise value; largest disclosed transaction in this sector

cards.title: Plenum Power | EIG
cards.metadata: EIG (Joint Venture) · Power Generation & Storage · United States
cards.description: EIG and Acwa entered definitive agreements to establish Plenum Power, a U.S. power investment platform targeting ~US$4bn of initial equity at launch. The partnership plans to pursue acquisitions and new development across conventional generation, renewables and storage; the launch target is not capital already deployed.
cards.scaleNote: ~US$4bn targeted initial launch equity; prospective commitment rather than completed investment or acquisition consideration

cards.title: Six UK biogas plants — remaining 49% | 3i Infrastructure
cards.metadata: 3i Infrastructure (Bolt-On) · Biogas · United Kingdom
cards.description: 3i Infrastructure-backed Future Biogas acquired Foresight Environmental Infrastructure’s remaining 49% interest in six gas-to-grid biogas facilities for £104mm, taking full ownership. The purchase follows its initial 51% investment in 2024 and allows capacity expansion and operational improvements across the portfolio.
cards.scaleNote: £104mm consideration for the remaining 49% interest in six facilities

cards.title: Qwello | Tiger Infrastructure
cards.metadata: Tiger Infrastructure (Primary Capital Raise) · EV Charging · Europe
cards.description: Tiger Infrastructure participated alongside ABN AMRO Sustainable Impact Fund and other existing investors in up to €55mm of growth equity for Qwello. The public charging operator has more than 19,500 charge points across eight European countries; the funding supports network expansion and selective acquisitions, and Tiger’s individual contribution was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Up to €55mm total growth equity across all participants; not Tiger’s individual commitment

cards.title: 550+ MW Greek solar project | Mubadala
cards.metadata: Mubadala (Bolt-On) · Solar Generation · Greece
cards.description: Mubadala-backed Masdar, through TERNA ENERGY, signed an agreement to acquire and develop a 550+ MW solar project from Lightsource bp, including two substations. The project is expected to operate by year-end 2026, with battery storage planned; consideration was undisclosed and closing remains subject to approvals.
cards.scaleNote: 550+ MW solar project and two substations; largest disclosed generation capacity among the week’s unpriced acquisitions

cards.title: Wind2 | Brookfield
cards.metadata: Brookfield (Bolt-On) · Onshore Wind Development · United Kingdom
cards.description: Brookfield infrastructure-backed Boralex acquired Wind2, a UK renewables developer with ~350MW of advanced wind projects across Scotland, England and Wales. The acquisition also brings teams in two UK offices, expanding Boralex’s development capacity; transaction value was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: ~350MW of advanced wind projects in a development platform; precedes smaller unpriced generation/project portfolios

cards.title: Baixas / Coquainvilliers battery projects | BlackRock
cards.metadata: BlackRock (Portfolio Company Divestiture) · Battery Storage · France
cards.description: BlackRock infrastructure-backed Recurrent Energy sold two French battery projects totaling 200MW / 800MWh to BW ESS. Recurrent will advance remaining development milestones before BW ESS takes the projects through construction and long-term operation; consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 200MW / 800MWh across two development-stage battery projects; no transaction value disclosed

cards.title: Bettyhill Phase 2 Wind Farm | J.P. Morgan AM
cards.metadata: J.P. Morgan AM (Bolt-On) · Onshore Wind · United Kingdom
cards.description: IIF-backed Nadara acquired the consented 48MW Bettyhill Phase 2 wind project in Scotland from Eden Renewables. Nadara will finance, build and operate the project, with construction expected in Q1 2027 and operation in Q4 2028; consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 48MW consented wind project; publication date October 28, with an October 27 press-release dateline

cards.title: Tallgrass community-solar portfolio | Brookfield
cards.metadata: Brookfield (Bolt-On) · Community Solar · United States
cards.description: Brookfield-backed Standard Solar acquired 13 Illinois community-solar projects totaling ~43.3MW from Trajectory Energy Partners. Standard Solar will construct, own and operate the portfolio, with commercial operation expected in phases during 2027–2028; financial terms were undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 43.3MW across 13 development projects; acquired capacity excludes the buyer’s existing portfolio

cards.title: Kore HVAC Services | Basalt
cards.metadata: Basalt (Bolt-On) · HVAC & Energy Services · Canada
cards.description: Basalt-backed Go Lime acquired Kore HVAC Services, extending its home and commercial energy-services platform into Greater Sudbury and Northern Ontario. Kore’s local brand, technicians and existing service agreements will continue; transaction terms were undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Local HVAC services bolt-on with no acquired customer count, capacity or transaction value disclosed

cards.title: Bell wireless TowerCo — 49.9% stake | La Caisse
cards.metadata: La Caisse (Minority Stake) · Wireless Towers · Canada
cards.description: La Caisse agreed to acquire 49.9% of Bell Canada’s new wireless TowerCo for C$2.45bn, implying a ~C$4.91bn valuation. The platform will own more than 5,000 sites, with Bell retaining control and leasing tower capacity under long-term agreements; closing is expected in Q1 2027, subject to approvals.
cards.scaleNote: ~C$4.91bn implied platform value and C$2.45bn consideration for 49.9%; largest disclosed digital transaction

cards.title: Gabia / KINX shareholdings | Macquarie AM
cards.metadata: Macquarie AM (Acquisition) · Digital Infrastructure · South Korea
cards.description: Macquarie Asia-Pacific Infrastructure Fund 4 signed agreements to acquire major shareholders’ Gabia and KINX stakes at KRW53,000 and KRW190,000 per share, respectively, with management rolling part of its holdings. The transaction aims to simplify the dual-listed ownership structure; further tender offers are intended after approvals, and aggregate consideration was undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: Two-company digital platform transaction; per-share prices are disclosed but aggregate consideration is not

cards.title: Mobico Group | Asterion
cards.metadata: Asterion (Buyout) · Passenger Transport · United Kingdom / International
cards.description: Asterion Fund III-backed AdL, jointly held with CMC Group, agreed a 46p-per-share cash offer for Mobico through Leita Mobility, implying ~£308mm equity value and ~£2.3bn enterprise value. The coach, bus and rail operator serves 40 cities across 11 countries; the recommended scheme is expected to complete in H1 2027, subject to approvals.
cards.scaleNote: £2,323mm enterprise value and £308mm equity value; formal publication October 30, document dateline October 29

cards.title: Cernaval | CVC DIF
cards.metadata: CVC DIF (Majority Stake) · Ship Repair Infrastructure · Spain
cards.description: CVC DIF acquired a majority stake in Cernaval, a ship-repair business operating under a long-term concession at the Port of Algeciras Bay. Its facilities include a 400-metre dry dock and a 230-metre floating dock; CVC DIF plans to modernise the shipyard, with consideration undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: 400-metre dry dock and 230-metre floating dock under a long-term port concession; value undisclosed

cards.title: Iron Horse Midstream | Sixth Street
cards.metadata: Sixth Street (Sale) · Gas Gathering & Processing · United States
cards.description: Sixth Street agreed to sell Iron Horse Midstream to Howard Energy Partners. The Oklahoma business includes ~400 miles of gas pipelines and 425mm cubic feet/day of processing capacity, supported by multidecade customer contracts; the transaction is expected to close by year-end 2026, with consideration undisclosed.
cards.scaleNote: ~400 miles of pipelines and 425mm cubic feet/day of processing capacity; the buyer’s US$2.5bn two-year acquisition total is not this deal’s value
